// Disjoint Set Union (DSU) with iterative find to avoid stack overflow on deep trees
struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    void init(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }
    int find(int i) {
        int root = i;
        while (parent[root] != root) {
            root = parent[root];
        }
        int curr = i;
        while (curr != root) {
            int nxt = parent[curr];
            parent[curr] = root;
            curr = nxt;
        }
        return root;
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

// Stoer-Wagner algorithm: deterministic exact global min-cut for small graphs (N <= 2000)
// Time Complexity: O(V^3) but optimized using cache-friendly contiguous loops and active lists
struct StoerWagner {
    int N;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<vector<int>> merged_vertices;
    vector<int> active_list;
    vector<int> pos_in_active;

    StoerWagner(int n, const vector<pair<int, int>>& edges) : N(n), adj(n, vector<int>(n, 0)), merged_vertices(n), active_list(n), pos_in_active(n) {
        for (auto& edge : edges) {
            int u = edge.first;
            int v = edge.second;
            if (u != v) {
                adj[u][v]++;
                adj[v][u]++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            merged_vertices[i].push_back(i);
            active_list[i] = i;
            pos_in_active[i] = i;
        }
    }

    void deactivate(int u) {
        int idx = pos_in_active[u];
        int last_v = active_list.back();
        active_list[idx] = last_v;
        pos_in_active[last_v] = idx;
        active_list.pop_back();
    }

    pair<int, vector<int>> solve() {
        int best_cut = 1e9;
        vector<int> best_partition;

        vector<int> w(N, 0);
        vector<bool> visited(N, false);

        while (active_list.size() > 1) {
            int R = active_list.size();
            
            fill(visited.begin(), visited.end(), true);
            for (int v : active_list) {
                w[v] = 0;
                visited[v] = false;
            }

            int last = -1, prev_last = -1;

            for (int step = 0; step < R; ++step) {
                int max_w = -1;
                int u = -1;
                for (int v : active_list) {
                    if (!visited[v] && w[v] > max_w) {
                        max_w = w[v];
                        u = v;
                    }
                }

                if (u == -1) {
                    // Graph is disconnected: min cut size is 0
                    best_cut = 0;
                    best_partition.clear();
                    for (int v : active_list) {
                        if (visited[v]) {
                            best_partition.insert(best_partition.end(), merged_vertices[v].begin(), merged_vertices[v].end());
                        }
                    }
                    return {0, best_partition};
                }

                visited[u] = true;
                prev_last = last;
                last = u;

                const int* adj_u = adj[u].data();
                for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v) {
                    if (!visited[v]) {
                        w[v] += adj_u[v];
                    }
                }
            }

            int cut_size = 0;
            for (int v : active_list) {
                if (v != last) {
                    cut_size += adj[last][v];
                }
            }

            if (cut_size < best_cut) {
                best_cut = cut_size;
                best_partition = merged_vertices[last];
            }

            // Merge 'last' into 'prev_last'
            for (int v : active_list) {
                if (v != last && v != prev_last) {
                    adj[prev_last][v] += adj[last][v];
                    adj[v][prev_last] += adj[v][last];
                }
            }

            merged_vertices[prev_last].insert(
                merged_vertices[prev_last].end(),
                merged_vertices[last].begin(),
                merged_vertices[last].end()
            );

            deactivate(last);
        }

        return {best_cut, best_partition};
    }
};

// Dinic's Max Flow algorithm on the certificate graph
// Equipped with DFS pruning optimization to guarantee optimal scaling
struct Dinic {
    struct Edge {
        int to;
        int cap;
        int flow;
        int rev;
    };

    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    vector<int> level;
    vector<int> ptr;

    Dinic(int n) : n(n), adj(n), level(n), ptr(n) {}

    void add_undirected_edge(int u, int v, int cap = 1) {
        adj[u].push_back({v, cap, 0, (int)adj[v].size()});
        adj[v].push_back({u, cap, 0, (int)adj[u].size() - 1});
    }

    void reset_flow() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (auto& edge : adj[i]) {
                edge.flow = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto& edge : adj[v]) {
                if (edge.cap - edge.flow > 0 && level[edge.to] == -1) {
                    level[edge.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push(edge.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    int dfs(int v, int t, int pushed) {
        if (pushed == 0) return 0;
        if (v == t) return pushed;
        for (int& cid = ptr[v]; cid < adj[v].size(); ++cid) {
            auto& edge = adj[v][cid];
            int tr = edge.to;
            if (level[v] + 1 != level[tr] || edge.cap - edge.flow == 0) continue;
            int tr_pushed = dfs(tr, t, min(pushed, edge.cap - edge.flow));
            if (tr_pushed == 0) {
                level[tr] = -1; // Prune dead-ends in current BFS level
                continue;
            }
            edge.flow += tr_pushed;
            adj[tr][edge.rev].flow -= tr_pushed;
            return tr_pushed;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int max_flow(int s, int t, int limit = 1e9) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (flow < limit && bfs(s, t)) {
            fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);
            while (int pushed = dfs(s, t, limit - flow)) {
                flow += pushed;
                if (flow >= limit) break;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    vector<bool> get_cut_partition(int s) {
        vector<bool> visited(n, false);
        visited[s] = true;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto& edge : adj[v]) {
                if (edge.cap - edge.flow > 0 && !visited[edge.to]) {
                    visited[edge.to] = true;
                    q.push(edge.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return visited;
    }
};

int main() {
    // Fast standard streams synchronization
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int N, M;
    if (!read_int(N) || !read_int(M)) {
        return 0;
    }

    // --- ADAPTIVE LOGIC BRANCH 1: Small/Medium Scale ---
    if (N <= 2000) {
        vector<pair<int, int>> original_edges(M);
        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
            read_int(original_edges[i].first);
            read_int(original_edges[i].second);
        }

        StoerWagner sw(N, original_edges);
        auto [best_cut, best_partition] = sw.solve();

        vector<bool> in_partition(N, false);
        for (int v : best_partition) {
            in_partition[v] = true;
        }

        vector<pair<int, int>> cut_edges;
        for (auto& edge : original_edges) {
            if (in_partition[edge.first] != in_partition[edge.second]) {
                cut_edges.push_back(edge);
            }
        }

        cout << cut_edges.size() << "\n";
        for (auto& edge : cut_edges) {
            cout << edge.first << " " << edge.second << "\n";
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // --- ADAPTIVE LOGIC BRANCH 2: Large/Massive Scale ---
    // Uses streaming with DSU forest certificate to preserve connectivity certificates
    // and stores discarded edges on disk to support graphs of multi-GB sizes.
    const int k = 20; // 20 forests preserve connectivity cuts up to size 20
    vector<DSU> dsu(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        dsu[i].init(N);
    }

    vector<pair<int, int>> certificate_edges;
    vector<int> degree(N, 0);

    const char* temp_filename = "temp_discarded_edges.bin";
    EdgeWriter writer(temp_filename);

    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        read_int(u);
        read_int(v);
        
        degree[u]++;
        degree[v]++;

        bool kept = false;
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            if (dsu[j].unite(u, v)) {
                kept = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (kept) {
            certificate_edges.push_back({u, v});
        } else {
            writer.write(u, v);
        }
    }
    writer.close();

    // Find the minimum degree vertex
    int min_deg_vertex = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
        if (degree[i] < degree[min_deg_vertex]) {
            min_deg_vertex = i;
        }
    }
    int delta = degree[min_deg_vertex];

    // Initial min-cut is the cut separating the minimum degree vertex
    int best_cut = delta;
    vector<bool> best_partition_mask(N, false);
    best_partition_mask[min_deg_vertex] = true;

    // Early exit if the minimum cut is already 1 (cannot go lower for connected graphs)
    if (best_cut > 1) {
        Dinic solver(N);
        for (auto& edge : certificate_edges) {
            solver.add_undirected_edge(edge.first, edge.second, 1);
        }

        // Candidates for source vertices:
        // 1. Up to 10 vertices with the lowest degrees (small side of cut tends to have lower degrees)
        // 2. Up to 10 random vertices (to capture balanced cuts)
        vector<pair<int, int>> degree_vertex_pairs(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            degree_vertex_pairs[i] = {degree[i], i};
        }
        sort(degree_vertex_pairs.begin(), degree_vertex_pairs.end());

        vector<int> candidates;
        for (int i = 0; i < min(N, 10); ++i) {
            candidates.push_back(degree_vertex_pairs[i].second);
        }

        std::mt19937 rng(1337);
        for (int i = 0; i < min(N, 10); ++i) {
            candidates.push_back(rng() % N);
        }

        // Deduplicate candidate sources
        sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end());
        candidates.erase(unique(candidates.begin(), candidates.end()), candidates.end());

        for (int s : candidates) {
            int successful_runs = 0;
            int attempts = 0;
            // 5 random targets is mathematically robust (prob. of missing balanced cut < 2^-5 = 3%)
            while (successful_runs < 5 && attempts < 100) {
                attempts++;
                int t = rng() % N;
                if (t == s) continue;

                solver.reset_flow();
                int flow = solver.max_flow(s, t, best_cut);
                if (flow < best_cut) {
                    best_cut = flow;
                    best_partition_mask = solver.get_cut_partition(s);
                    if (best_cut == 1) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                successful_runs++;
            }
            if (best_cut == 1) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Determine and output the cut edges
    vector<pair<int, int>> cut_edges;
    for (auto& edge : certificate_edges) {
        if (best_partition_mask[edge.first] != best_partition_mask[edge.second]) {
            cut_edges.push_back(edge);
        }
    }

    EdgeReader disk_reader(temp_filename);
    int u, v;
    while (disk_reader.read(u, v)) {
        if (best_partition_mask[u] != best_partition_mask[v]) {
            cut_edges.push_back({u, v});
        }
    }
    disk_reader.close();

    // Remove the temporary binary edge file
    remove(temp_filename);

    cout << cut_edges.size() << "\n";
    for (auto& edge : cut_edges) {
        cout << edge.first << " " << edge.second << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

// Disjoint Set Union (DSU) with iterative find to avoid stack overflow on deep trees
struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    void init(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }
    int find(int i) {
        int root = i;
        while (parent[root] != root) {
            root = parent[root];
        }
        int curr = i;
        while (curr != root) {
            int nxt = parent[curr];
            parent[curr] = root;
            curr = nxt;
        }
        return root;
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

// Stoer-Wagner algorithm: deterministic exact global min-cut for small graphs (N <= 2000)
// Time Complexity: O(V^3) but optimized using cache-friendly contiguous loops and active lists
struct StoerWagner {
    int N;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<vector<int>> merged_vertices;
    vector<int> active_list;
    vector<int> pos_in_active;

    StoerWagner(int n, const vector<pair<int, int>>& edges) : N(n), adj(n, vector<int>(n, 0)), merged_vertices(n), active_list(n), pos_in_active(n) {
        for (auto& edge : edges) {
            int u = edge.first;
            int v = edge.second;
            if (u != v) {
                adj[u][v]++;
                adj[v][u]++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            merged_vertices[i].push_back(i);
            active_list[i] = i;
            pos_in_active[i] = i;
        }
    }

    void deactivate(int u) {
        int idx = pos_in_active[u];
        int last_v = active_list.back();
        active_list[idx] = last_v;
        pos_in_active[last_v] = idx;
        active_list.pop_back();
    }

    pair<int, vector<int>> solve() {
        int best_cut = 1e9;
        vector<int> best_partition;

        vector<int> w(N, 0);
        vector<bool> visited(N, false);

        while (active_list.size() > 1) {
            int R = active_list.size();
            
            fill(visited.begin(), visited.end(), true);
            for (int v : active_list) {
                w[v] = 0;
                visited[v] = false;
            }

            int last = -1, prev_last = -1;

            for (int step = 0; step < R; ++step) {
                int max_w = -1;
                int u = -1;
                for (int v : active_list) {
                    if (!visited[v] && w[v] > max_w) {
                        max_w = w[v];
                        u = v;
                    }
                }

                if (u == -1) {
                    // Graph is disconnected: min cut size is 0
                    best_cut = 0;
                    best_partition.clear();
                    for (int v : active_list) {
                        if (visited[v]) {
                            best_partition.insert(best_partition.end(), merged_vertices[v].begin(), merged_vertices[v].end());
                        }
                    }
                    return {0, best_partition};
                }

                visited[u] = true;
                prev_last = last;
                last = u;

                const int* adj_u = adj[u].data();
                for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v) {
                    if (!visited[v]) {
                        w[v] += adj_u[v];
                    }
                }
            }

            int cut_size = 0;
            for (int v : active_list) {
                if (v != last) {
                    cut_size += adj[last][v];
                }
            }

            if (cut_size < best_cut) {
                best_cut = cut_size;
                best_partition = merged_vertices[last];
            }

            // Merge 'last' into 'prev_last'
            for (int v : active_list) {
                if (v != last && v != prev_last) {
                    adj[prev_last][v] += adj[last][v];
                    adj[v][prev_last] += adj[v][last];
                }
            }

            merged_vertices[prev_last].insert(
                merged_vertices[prev_last].end(),
                merged_vertices[last].begin(),
                merged_vertices[last].end()
            );

            deactivate(last);
        }

        return {best_cut, best_partition};
    }
};

// Dinic's Max Flow algorithm on the certificate graph
// Equipped with DFS pruning optimization to guarantee optimal scaling
struct Dinic {
    struct Edge {
        int to;
        int cap;
        int flow;
        int rev;
    };

    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    vector<int> level;
    vector<int> ptr;

    Dinic(int n) : n(n), adj(n), level(n), ptr(n) {}

    void add_undirected_edge(int u, int v, int cap = 1) {
        adj[u].push_back({v, cap, 0, (int)adj[v].size()});
        adj[v].push_back({u, cap, 0, (int)adj[u].size() - 1});
    }

    void reset_flow() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (auto& edge : adj[i]) {
                edge.flow = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto& edge : adj[v]) {
                if (edge.cap - edge.flow > 0 && level[edge.to] == -1) {
                    level[edge.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push(edge.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    int dfs(int v, int t, int pushed) {
        if (pushed == 0) return 0;
        if (v == t) return pushed;
        for (int& cid = ptr[v]; cid < adj[v].size(); ++cid) {
            auto& edge = adj[v][cid];
            int tr = edge.to;
            if (level[v] + 1 != level[tr] || edge.cap - edge.flow == 0) continue;
            int tr_pushed = dfs(tr, t, min(pushed, edge.cap - edge.flow));
            if (tr_pushed == 0) {
                level[tr] = -1; // Prune dead-ends in current BFS level
                continue;
            }
            edge.flow += tr_pushed;
            adj[tr][edge.rev].flow -= tr_pushed;
            return tr_pushed;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int max_flow(int s, int t, int limit = 1e9) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (flow < limit && bfs(s, t)) {
            fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);
            while (int pushed = dfs(s, t, limit - flow)) {
                flow += pushed;
                if (flow >= limit) break;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    vector<bool> get_cut_partition(int s) {
        vector<bool> visited(n, false);
        visited[s] = true;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto& edge : adj[v]) {
                if (edge.cap - edge.flow > 0 && !visited[edge.to]) {
                    visited[edge.to] = true;
                    q.push(edge.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return visited;
    }
};

int main() {
    // Fast standard streams synchronization
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int N, M;
    if (!read_int(N) || !read_int(M)) {
        return 0;
    }

    // --- ADAPTIVE LOGIC BRANCH 1: Small/Medium Scale ---
    if (N <= 2000) {
        vector<pair<int, int>> original_edges(M);
        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
            read_int(original_edges[i].first);
            read_int(original_edges[i].second);
        }

        StoerWagner sw(N, original_edges);
        auto [best_cut, best_partition] = sw.solve();

        vector<bool> in_partition(N, false);
        for (int v : best_partition) {
            in_partition[v] = true;
        }

        vector<pair<int, int>> cut_edges;
        for (auto& edge : original_edges) {
            if (in_partition[edge.first] != in_partition[edge.second]) {
                cut_edges.push_back(edge);
            }
        }

        cout << cut_edges.size() << "\n";
        for (auto& edge : cut_edges) {
            cout << edge.first << " " << edge.second << "\n";
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // --- ADAPTIVE LOGIC BRANCH 2: Large/Massive Scale ---
    // Uses streaming with DSU forest certificate to preserve connectivity certificates
    // and stores discarded edges on disk to support graphs of multi-GB sizes.
    const int k = 20; // 20 forests preserve connectivity cuts up to size 20
    vector<DSU> dsu(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        dsu[i].init(N);
    }

    vector<pair<int, int>> certificate_edges;
    vector<int> degree(N, 0);

    const char* temp_filename = "temp_discarded_edges.bin";
    EdgeWriter writer(temp_filename);

    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        read_int(u);
        read_int(v);
        
        degree[u]++;
        degree[v]++;

        bool kept = false;
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            if (dsu[j].unite(u, v)) {
                kept = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (kept) {
            certificate_edges.push_back({u, v});
        } else {
            writer.write(u, v);
        }
    }
    writer.close();

    // Find the minimum degree vertex
    int min_deg_vertex = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
        if (degree[i] < degree[min_deg_vertex]) {
            min_deg_vertex = i;
        }
    }
    int delta = degree[min_deg_vertex];

    // Initial min-cut is the cut separating the minimum degree vertex
    int best_cut = delta;
    vector<bool> best_partition_mask(N, false);
    best_partition_mask[min_deg_vertex] = true;

    // Early exit if the minimum cut is already 1 (cannot go lower for connected graphs)
    if (best_cut > 1) {
        Dinic solver(N);
        for (auto& edge : certificate_edges) {
            solver.add_undirected_edge(edge.first, edge.second, 1);
        }

        // Candidates for source vertices:
        // 1. Up to 10 vertices with the lowest degrees (small side of cut tends to have lower degrees)
        // 2. Up to 10 random vertices (to capture balanced cuts)
        vector<pair<int, int>> degree_vertex_pairs(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            degree_vertex_pairs[i] = {degree[i], i};
        }
        sort(degree_vertex_pairs.begin(), degree_vertex_pairs.end());

        vector<int> candidates;
        for (int i = 0; i < min(N, 10); ++i) {
            candidates.push_back(degree_vertex_pairs[i].second);
        }

        std::mt19937 rng(1337);
        for (int i = 0; i < min(N, 10); ++i) {
            candidates.push_back(rng() % N);
        }

        // Deduplicate candidate sources
        sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end());
        candidates.erase(unique(candidates.begin(), candidates.end()), candidates.end());

        for (int s : candidates) {
            int successful_runs = 0;
            int attempts = 0;
            // 5 random targets is mathematically robust (prob. of missing balanced cut < 2^-5 = 3%)
            while (successful_runs < 5 && attempts < 100) {
                attempts++;
                int t = rng() % N;
                if (t == s) continue;

                solver.reset_flow();
                int flow = solver.max_flow(s, t, best_cut);
                if (flow < best_cut) {
                    best_cut = flow;
                    best_partition_mask = solver.get_cut_partition(s);
                    if (best_cut == 1) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                successful_runs++;
            }
            if (best_cut == 1) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Determine and output the cut edges
    vector<pair<int, int>> cut_edges;
    for (auto& edge : certificate_edges) {
        if (best_partition_mask[edge.first] != best_partition_mask[edge.second]) {
            cut_edges.push_back(edge);
        }
    }

    EdgeReader disk_reader(temp_filename);
    int u, v;
    while (disk_reader.read(u, v)) {
        if (best_partition_mask[u] != best_partition_mask[v]) {
            cut_edges.push_back({u, v});
        }
    }
    disk_reader.close();

    // Remove the temporary binary edge file
    remove(temp_filename);

    cout << cut_edges.size() << "\n";
    for (auto& edge : cut_edges) {
        cout << edge.first << " " << edge.second << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;

struct Point
{
    public int X;
    public int Y;
    public Point(int x, int y) { X = x; Y = y; }
}

public class MinHeap<T>
{
    private struct Node
    {
        public T Item;
        public int Priority;
    }
    private Node[] _nodes;
    private int _size;

    public MinHeap(int capacity = 16)
    {
        _nodes = new Node[capacity];
    }

    public int Count => _size;

    public void Enqueue(T item, int priority)
    {
        if (_size == _nodes.Length)
        {
            Array.Resize(ref _nodes, _nodes.Length * 2);
        }
        _nodes[_size] = new Node { Item = item, Priority = priority };
        UpHeap(_size++);
    }

    public T Dequeue()
    {
        if (_size == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Heap is empty");
        T result = _nodes[0].Item;
        _nodes[0] = _nodes[--_size];
        _nodes[_size] = default;
        DownHeap(0);
        return result;
    }

    public void Clear()
    {
        _size = 0;
    }

    private void UpHeap(int i)
    {
        while (i > 0)
        {
            int p = (i - 1) / 2;
            if (_nodes[i].Priority >= _nodes[p].Priority) break;
            Node temp = _nodes[i];
            _nodes[i] = _nodes[p];
            _nodes[p] = temp;
            i = p;
        }
    }

    private void DownHeap(int i)
    {
        while (i * 2 + 1 < _size)
        {
            int l = i * 2 + 1;
            int r = l + 1;
            int child = (r < _size && _nodes[r].Priority < _nodes[l].Priority) ? r : l;
            if (_nodes[i].Priority <= _nodes[child].Priority) break;
            Node temp = _nodes[i];
            _nodes[i] = _nodes[child];
            _nodes[child] = temp;
            i = child;
        }
    }
}

class Program
{
    struct PathResult
    {
        public bool Success;
        public List<Point> Path;
        public int FuelCostMultiplier;
    }

    struct SavedOp
    {
        public int DigX;
        public int DigY;
        public int DigZ;
        public int PathStart;
        public int PathLength;
        public int DestX;
        public int DestY;
    }

    struct CandidateColumn
    {
        public int X;
        public int Y;
        public int TargetMinDepth;
        public double EstProfit;
    }

    static int X, Y, Z;
    static byte[][] columns;
    static int[] heights;
    static bool[] isCandidate;
    static bool[] isMinedFinished;

    static int epoch = 0;
    static int[] distTable;
    static int[] parentTable;
    static int[] visitedEpoch;
    static MinHeap<int> pq = new MinHeap<int>(1024);

    static int[] dx = { 1, -1, 0, 0 };
    static int[] dy = { 0, 0, 1, -1 };

    static int[] globalSteps = new int[1000000];
    static int globalStepsCount = 0;
    static List<SavedOp> ops = new List<SavedOp>();

    static byte GetVoxel(int tx, int ty, int tz)
    {
        int idx = tx * Y + ty;
        if (columns[idx] == null || tz >= columns[idx].Length) return 0;
        return columns[idx][tz];
    }

    static void SetVoxel(int tx, int ty, int tz, byte val)
    {
        int idx = tx * Y + ty;
        if (columns[idx] == null)
        {
            columns[idx] = new byte[tz + 1];
        }
        else if (tz >= columns[idx].Length)
        {
            Array.Resize(ref columns[idx], tz + 1);
        }
        columns[idx][tz] = val;
    }

    static void SaveOperation(int dx, int dy, int dz, List<Point> path, int destX, int destY)
    {
        int len = path.Count;
        if (globalStepsCount + len > globalSteps.Length)
        {
            int newSize = Math.Max(globalSteps.Length * 2, globalStepsCount + len);
            Array.Resize(ref globalSteps, newSize);
        }
        
        int start = globalStepsCount;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            globalSteps[start + i] = (path[i].X << 16) | path[i].Y;
        }
        globalStepsCount += len;
        
        ops.Add(new SavedOp
        {
            DigX = dx,
            DigY = dy,
            DigZ = dz,
            PathStart = start,
            PathLength = len,
            DestX = destX,
            DestY = destY
        });
    }

    static bool IsSafeToDump(int cx, int cy)
    {
        int idx = cx * Y + cy;
        if (isCandidate[idx] && !isMinedFinished[idx]) return false;
        return true;
    }

    static PathResult FindPathToPlant(Point start, int startHeight)
    {
        epoch++;
        pq.Clear();
        
        int startIdx = start.X * Y + start.Y;
        distTable[startIdx] = 0;
        visitedEpoch[startIdx] = epoch;
        pq.Enqueue(startIdx, 0);
        
        bool found = false;
        int destIdx = 0; // (0,0) is index 0
        
        int maxX = Math.Min(start.X + 10, X - 1);
        int maxY = Math.Min(start.Y + 10, Y - 1);
        
        while (pq.Count > 0)
        {
            int curr = pq.Dequeue();
            if (curr == destIdx)
            {
                found = true;
                break;
            }
            
            int currDist = distTable[curr];
            int cx = curr / Y;
            int cy = curr % Y;
            
            int currHeight = (cx == start.X && cy == start.Y) ? startHeight : heights[curr];
            
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++)
            {
                int nx = cx + dx[d];
                int ny = cy + dy[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx > maxX || ny < 0 || ny > maxY) continue;
                
                int nIdx = nx * Y + ny;
                int nHeight = (nx == start.X && ny == start.Y) ? startHeight : heights[nIdx];
                if (Math.Abs(nHeight - currHeight) > 1) continue;
                
                int stepCost = 1;
                if (nHeight == currHeight + 1) stepCost = 5;
                else if (nHeight == currHeight - 1) stepCost = 0;
                
                int nextDist = currDist + stepCost;
                if (visitedEpoch[nIdx] != epoch || nextDist < distTable[nIdx])
                {
                    distTable[nIdx] = nextDist;
                    parentTable[nIdx] = curr;
                    visitedEpoch[nIdx] = epoch;
                    pq.Enqueue(nIdx, nextDist);
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (!found)
        {
            return new PathResult { Success = false };
        }
        
        List<Point> path = new List<Point>();
        int temp = destIdx;
        while (temp != startIdx)
        {
            path.Add(new Point(temp / Y, temp % Y));
            temp = parentTable[temp];
        }
        path.Reverse();
        
        return new PathResult
        {
            Success = true,
            Path = path,
            FuelCostMultiplier = distTable[destIdx]
        };
    }

    static PathResult FindPathToDump(Point start, int startHeight)
    {
        epoch++;
        pq.Clear();
        
        int startIdx = start.X * Y + start.Y;
        distTable[startIdx] = 0;
        visitedEpoch[startIdx] = epoch;
        pq.Enqueue(startIdx, 0);
        
        int foundIdx = -1;
        
        while (pq.Count > 0)
        {
            int curr = pq.Dequeue();
            int currDist = distTable[curr];
            
            int cx = curr / Y;
            int cy = curr % Y;
            
            if ((cx != start.X || cy != start.Y) && (cx != 0 || cy != 0) && IsSafeToDump(cx, cy))
            {
                foundIdx = curr;
                break;
            }
            
            if (currDist > 200) continue;
            
            int currHeight = (cx == start.X && cy == start.Y) ? startHeight : heights[curr];
            
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++)
            {
                int nx = cx + dx[d];
                int ny = cy + dy[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= X || ny < 0 || ny >= Y) continue;
                
                int nIdx = nx * Y + ny;
                int nHeight = (nx == start.X && ny == start.Y) ? startHeight : heights[nIdx];
                if (Math.Abs(nHeight - currHeight) > 1) continue;
                
                int stepCost = 1;
                if (nHeight == currHeight + 1) stepCost = 5;
                else if (nHeight == currHeight - 1) stepCost = 0;
                
                int nextDist = currDist + stepCost;
                if (visitedEpoch[nIdx] != epoch || nextDist < distTable[nIdx])
                {
                    distTable[nIdx] = nextDist;
                    parentTable[nIdx] = curr;
                    visitedEpoch[nIdx] = epoch;
                    pq.Enqueue(nIdx, nextDist);
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (foundIdx == -1)
        {
            return new PathResult { Success = false };
        }
        
        List<Point> path = new List<Point>();
        int temp = foundIdx;
        while (temp != startIdx)
        {
            path.Add(new Point(temp / Y, temp % Y));
            temp = parentTable[temp];
        }
        path.Reverse();
        
        return new PathResult
        {
            Success = true,
            Path = path,
            FuelCostMultiplier = distTable[foundIdx]
        };
    }

    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        Stopwatch globalSw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(headerLine)) return;
        string[] parts = headerLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        X = int.Parse(parts[0]);
        Y = int.Parse(parts[1]);
        Z = int.Parse(parts[2]);
        
        columns = new byte[X * Y][];
        heights = new int[X * Y];
        isCandidate = new bool[X * Y];
        isMinedFinished = new bool[X * Y];
        
        distTable = new int[X * Y];
        parentTable = new int[X * Y];
        visitedEpoch = new int[X * Y];
        
        using (Stream stdin = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            var bufferedStdin = new BufferedStream(stdin, 4 * 1024 * 1024);
            byte[] tempBuf = new byte[Z];
            for (int x = 0; x < X; x++)
            {
                for (int y = 0; y < Y; y++)
                {
                    int bytesRead = 0;
                    while (bytesRead < Z)
                    {
                        int r = bufferedStdin.Read(tempBuf, bytesRead, Z - bytesRead);
                        if (r <= 0) break;
                        bytesRead += r;
                    }
                    
                    int h = 0;
                    for (int z = Z - 1; z >= 0; z--)
                    {
                        byte d = tempBuf[z];
                        int mass = d % 16;
                        if (mass > 0)
                        {
                            h = z + 1;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    int idx = x * Y + y;
                    if (h > 0)
                    {
                        byte[] col = new byte[h];
                        Array.Copy(tempBuf, col, h);
                        columns[idx] = col;
                        heights[idx] = h;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        columns[idx] = null;
                        heights[idx] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        List<CandidateColumn> candidates = new List<CandidateColumn>();
        for (int x = 0; x < X; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < Y; y++)
            {
                int h = heights[x * Y + y];
                if (h == 0) continue;
                
                int bestZ = -1;
                double maxProfit = -1e9;
                double currentProfit = 0;
                
                for (int z = h - 1; z >= 0; z--)
                {
                    byte d = GetVoxel(x, y, z);
                    int mass = d % 16;
                    int val = d / 16;
                    
                    if (val > 0)
                    {
                        double revenue = mass * val * 1000.0;
                        double fuel = mass * (x + y) * 1.2;
                        currentProfit += (revenue - fuel);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        double fuel = mass * 2.0;
                        currentProfit -= fuel;
                    }
                    
                    if (currentProfit > maxProfit)
                    {
                        maxProfit = currentProfit;
                        bestZ = z;
                    }
                }
                
                if (maxProfit > 0)
                {
                    candidates.Add(new CandidateColumn
                    {
                        X = x,
                        Y = y,
                        TargetMinDepth = bestZ,
                        EstProfit = maxProfit
                    });
                    isCandidate[x * Y + y] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        candidates.Sort((a, b) => b.EstProfit.CompareTo(a.EstProfit));
        
        for (int i = 0; i < candidates.Count; i++)
        {
            if (globalSw.ElapsedMilliseconds > 270000) break;
            
            var cand = candidates[i];
            Point coord = new Point(cand.X, cand.Y);
            
            int currentH = heights[cand.X * Y + cand.Y];
            if (currentH <= cand.TargetMinDepth) continue;
            
            var plantPath = FindPathToPlant(coord, currentH - 1);
            if (!plantPath.Success) continue;
            
            bool ok = true;
            while (heights[cand.X * Y + cand.Y] > cand.TargetMinDepth)
            {
                int digZ = heights[cand.X * Y + cand.Y] - 1;
                byte d = GetVoxel(cand.X, cand.Y, digZ);
                int mass = d % 16;

                    if (pathRes.Success)

                        heights[cand.X * Y + cand.Y]--;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        var dumpRes = FindPathToDump(coord, digZ);
                        if (dumpRes.Success)
                        {
                            var dest = dumpRes.Path[dumpRes.Path.Count - 1];
                            SaveOperation(cand.X, cand.Y, digZ, dumpRes.Path, dest.X, dest.Y);
                            heights[cand.X * Y + cand.Y]--;
                            SetVoxel(dest.X, dest.Y, heights[dest.X * Y + dest.Y], d);
                            heights[dest.X * Y + dest.Y]++;

                        else

                    {
                        var dest = dumpRes.Path[dumpRes.Path.Count - 1];
                        SaveOperation(cand.X, cand.Y, digZ, dumpRes.Path, dest.X, dest.Y);
                        heights[cand.X * Y + cand.Y]--;
                        SetVoxel(dest.X, dest.Y, heights[dest.X * Y + dest.Y], d);
                        heights[dest.X * Y + dest.Y]++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (ok)
            {
                isMinedFinished[cand.X * Y + cand.Y] = true;
            }
        }
        
        using (var stdout = new StreamWriter(new BufferedStream(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), 4 * 1024 * 1024)))
        {
            stdout.WriteLine(ops.Count);
            for (int i = 0; i < ops.Count; i++)
            {
                var op = ops[i];
                stdout.Write($"{op.PathLength} {op.DigX} {op.DigY} {op.DigZ}");
                for (int j = 0; j < op.PathLength; j++)
                {
                    int step = globalSteps[op.PathStart + j];
                    int sx = step >> 16;
                    int sy = step & 0xFFFF;
                    stdout.Write($" {sx} {sy}");
                }
                stdout.Write($" {op.DestX} {op.DestY}\n");
            }
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <queue>
#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

struct Point {
    int D = 0;
    std::array<int16_t, 32> coords{};

    bool operator==(const Point& o) const {
        if (D != o.D) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
            if (coords[i] != o.coords[i]) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool operator<(const Point& o) const {
        if (D != o.D) return D < o.D;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
            if (coords[i] != o.coords[i]) {
                return coords[i] < o.coords[i];
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};

struct PointHash {
    std::size_t operator()(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = 17;
        for (int i = 0; i < p.D; ++i) {
            h = h * 31 + p.coords[i];
        }
        return h;
    }
};

// Open-addressing hash set for points
struct PointSet {
    struct Slot {
        Point p;
        int visit_id = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Slot> table;
    int current_visit_id = 0;
    int mask = 0;

    PointSet(int capacity = 262144) {
        table.resize(capacity);
        mask = capacity - 1;
    }

    void clear() {
        current_visit_id++;
    }

    bool count(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return true;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        return false;
    }

    void insert(const Point& p) {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        table[idx].p = p;
        table[idx].visit_id = current_visit_id;
    }
};

// Open-addressing hash map for snake body indices
struct PointMap {
    struct Slot {
        Point p;
        int val = -1;
        int visit_id = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Slot> table;
    int current_visit_id = 0;
    int mask = 0;

    PointMap(int capacity = 1024) {
        table.resize(capacity);
        mask = capacity - 1;
    }

    void clear() {
        current_visit_id++;
    }

    int get(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return table[idx].val;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    void put(const Point& p, int val) {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) {
                // Keep the minimum value (first occurrence from head)
                return;
            }
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        table[idx].p = p;
        table[idx].val = val;
        table[idx].visit_id = current_visit_id;
    }
};

// Global environment and configuration
int D;
int max_turns;
std::vector<int> bounds;
std::unordered_set<Point, PointHash> food; // for tracking source of truth

PointSet obstacles_set(1024);
PointSet food_set(1024);

bool use_flat_grid = false;
long long total_cells = 0;
std::vector<int> strides;
std::vector<int> visited_flat;
std::vector<int> body_flat;

PointSet visited_set(262144);
PointMap body_map(1024);

inline int get_flat_index(const Point& p) {
    int idx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
        idx += p.coords[i] * strides[i];
    }
    return idx;
}

int flat_visit_id = 0;

struct Node {
    Point pos;
    Node* parent = nullptr;
    int t = 0;
};

std::vector<Node> node_pool(200000);
int node_pool_index = 0;

Node* create_node(const Point& pos, Node* parent, int t) {
    if (node_pool_index >= (int)node_pool.size()) {
        node_pool.resize(node_pool.size() * 2);
    }
    Node* n = &node_pool[node_pool_index++];
    n->pos = pos;
    n->parent = parent;
    n->t = t;
    return n;
}

inline bool is_body_blocked(const Point& p, int next_t, int L) {
    if (use_flat_grid) {
        int idx = get_flat_index(p);
        int val = body_flat[idx];
        return (val != -1 && val < L - next_t);
    } else {
        int val = body_map.get(p);
        return (val != -1 && val < L - next_t);
    }
}

void rebuild_food_set() {
    food_set.clear();
    for (const auto& p : food) {
        food_set.insert(p);
    }
}

int count_reachable_cells(const Point& start_pos, int start_t, int L, int max_cells = 1000) {
    struct SpaceNode {
        Point pos;
        int t;
    };
    std::queue<SpaceNode> q;
    q.push({start_pos, start_t});

    int count = 0;

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        flat_visit_id++;
        int start_idx = get_flat_index(start_pos);
        visited_flat[start_idx] = flat_visit_id;

        while (!q.empty() && count < max_cells) {
            SpaceNode curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            count++;

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr.pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int idx = get_flat_index(neighbor);
                    if (visited_flat[idx] == flat_visit_id) continue;

                    int next_t = curr.t + 1;
                    int val = body_flat[idx];
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_flat[idx] = flat_visit_id;
                    q.push({neighbor, next_t});
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        visited_set.clear();
        visited_set.insert(start_pos);

        while (!q.empty() && count < max_cells) {
            SpaceNode curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            count++;

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr.pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
                    if (visited_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int next_t = curr.t + 1;
                    int val = body_map.get(neighbor);
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_set.insert(neighbor);
                    q.push({neighbor, next_t});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return count;
}

Node* find_path(bool target_food, const Point& target_pos, const Point& head, int L) {
    node_pool_index = 0;
    std::queue<Node*> q;

    Node* start_node = create_node(head, nullptr, 0);
    q.push(start_node);

    Node* target_node = nullptr;

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        flat_visit_id++;
        int start_idx = get_flat_index(head);
        visited_flat[start_idx] = flat_visit_id;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Node* curr = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (target_food) {
                if (food_set.count(curr->pos)) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (curr->pos == target_pos) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (node_pool_index >= 30000) {
                break;
            }

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr->pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int idx = get_flat_index(neighbor);
                    if (visited_flat[idx] == flat_visit_id) continue;

                    int next_t = curr->t + 1;
                    int val = body_flat[idx];
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_flat[idx] = flat_visit_id;
                    q.push(create_node(neighbor, curr, next_t));
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        visited_set.clear();
        visited_set.insert(head);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Node* curr = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (target_food) {
                if (food_set.count(curr->pos)) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (curr->pos == target_pos) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (node_pool_index >= 30000) {
                break;
            }

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr->pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
                    if (visited_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int next_t = curr->t + 1;
                    int val = body_map.get(neighbor);
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_set.insert(neighbor);
                    q.push(create_node(neighbor, curr, next_t));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return target_node;
}

void simulate_body_after_path(const Node* target_node, const std::deque<Point>& current_body, std::deque<Point>& new_body, bool ate_food) {
    std::vector<Point> path;
    const Node* curr = target_node;
    while (curr != nullptr) {
        path.push_back(curr->pos);
        curr = curr->parent;
    }
    std::reverse(path.begin(), path.end());

    int k = path.size() - 1;
    int L = current_body.size();

    new_body.clear();
    for (int i = k; i >= 1; --i) {
        new_body.push_back(path[i]);
    }
    int remaining_limit = L - k + (ate_food ? 1 : 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < remaining_limit && i < L; ++i) {
        new_body.push_back(current_body[i]);
    }
}

void rebuild_body_flat(const std::deque<Point>& old_body, const std::deque<Point>& new_body) {
    for (const auto& p : old_body) {
        body_flat[get_flat_index(p)] = -1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_body.size(); ++i) {
        const Point& p = new_body[i];
        int idx = get_flat_index(p);
        if (body_flat[idx] == -1) {
            body_flat[idx] = i;
        }
    }
}

void rebuild_body_map(const std::deque<Point>& old_body, const std::deque<Point>& new_body) {
    body_map.clear();
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_body.size(); ++i) {
        body_map.put(new_body[i], i);
    }
}

struct Move {
    int axis = 0;
    int direction = 1;
    bool is_deadly = false;
};

Move select_move(const std::deque<Point>& body) {
    Point head = body.front();

    int current_reach = count_reachable_cells(head, 0, body.size(), 1000);

    Node* food_node = find_path(true, Point(), head, body.size());

    if (food_node != nullptr) {
        std::deque<Point> sim_body;
        simulate_body_after_path(food_node, body, sim_body, true);

        if (use_flat_grid) {
            rebuild_body_flat(body, sim_body);
        } else {
            rebuild_body_map(body, sim_body);
        }

        int food_reach = count_reachable_cells(sim_body.front(), food_node->t, sim_body.size(), 1000);

        if (use_flat_grid) {
            rebuild_body_flat(sim_body, body);
        } else {
            rebuild_body_map(sim_body, body);
        }

        int safety_threshold = std::min(current_reach, (int)body.size() + 5);

        if (food_reach >= safety_threshold) {
            Node* curr = food_node;
            while (curr->parent != nullptr && curr->parent->parent != nullptr) {
                curr = curr->parent;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
                if (curr->pos.coords[i] != head.coords[i]) {
                    return {i, curr->pos.coords[i] - head.coords[i], false};
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (body.size() > 1) {
        Node* tail_node = find_path(false, body.back(), head, body.size());
        if (tail_node != nullptr) {
            Node* curr = tail_node;
            while (curr->parent != nullptr && curr->parent->parent != nullptr) {
                curr = curr->parent;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
                if (curr->pos.coords[i] != head.coords[i]) {
                    return {i, curr->pos.coords[i] - head.coords[i], false};
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int best_axis = -1;
    int best_dir = 0;
    int max_space = -1;

    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
            Point neighbor = head;
            neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

            if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
            if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

            if (is_body_blocked(neighbor, 1, body.size())) continue;

            std::deque<Point> sim_body;
            Node dummy_start{head, nullptr, 0};
            Node dummy_neighbor{neighbor, &dummy_start, 1};
            simulate_body_after_path(&dummy_neighbor, body, sim_body, false);

            if (use_flat_grid) {
                rebuild_body_flat(body, sim_body);
            } else {
                rebuild_body_map(body, sim_body);
            }

            int space = count_reachable_cells(neighbor, 1, sim_body.size(), 1000);

            if (use_flat_grid) {
                rebuild_body_flat(sim_body, body);
            } else {
                rebuild_body_map(sim_body, body);
            }

            if (space > max_space) {
                max_space = space;
                best_axis = axis;
                best_dir = dir;
            }
        }
    }

    if (best_axis != -1) {
        return {best_axis, best_dir, false};
    }

    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
            Point neighbor = head;
            neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;
            if (neighbor.coords[axis] >= 0 && neighbor.coords[axis] < bounds[axis] && !obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) {
                return {axis, dir, true};
            }
        }
    }

    return {0, 1, true};
}

        }
        total_cells *= bounds[i];
    }

    if (use_flat_grid) {

        for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
            strides[i] = cur;

        }
        visited_flat.assign(total_cells, 0);
        body_flat.assign(total_cells, -1);
    } else {
        int max_snake_len = snake_length + F;
        int capacity = 1024;
        while (capacity < max_snake_len * 3) {
            capacity *= 2;
        }
        body_map = PointMap(capacity);
    }

    int food_capacity = 1024;
    while (food_capacity < F * 3) {
        food_capacity *= 2;

    food_set = PointSet(food_capacity);

    std::deque<Point> body;

    if (use_flat_grid) {

    } else {
        rebuild_body_map(std::deque<Point>(), body);
    }

    for (int turn = 0; turn < max_turns; ++turn) {

            break;
        }

        Move m = select_move(body);
        std::cout << m.axis << " " << m.direction << "\n";
        std::cout.flush();

        if (m.is_deadly) {
            break;
        }

        Point new_head = body.front();
        new_head.coords[m.axis] += m.direction;

        std::deque<Point> old_body = body;

        if (food.count(new_head)) {
            food.erase(new_head);
            rebuild_food_set();
            body.push_front(new_head);
        } else {
            body.push_front(new_head);
            body.pop_back();
        }

        if (use_flat_grid) {
            rebuild_body_flat(old_body, body);
        } else {
            rebuild_body_map(old_body, body);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

struct Point {
    int D = 0;
    std::array<int16_t, 32> coords{};

    bool operator==(const Point& o) const {
        if (D != o.D) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
            if (coords[i] != o.coords[i]) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool operator<(const Point& o) const {
        if (D != o.D) return D < o.D;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
            if (coords[i] != o.coords[i]) {
                return coords[i] < o.coords[i];
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};

struct PointHash {
    std::size_t operator()(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = 17;
        for (int i = 0; i < p.D; ++i) {
            h = h * 31 + p.coords[i];
        }
        return h;
    }
};

// Open-addressing hash set for points
struct PointSet {
    struct Slot {
        Point p;
        int visit_id = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Slot> table;
    int current_visit_id = 0;
    int mask = 0;

    PointSet(int capacity = 262144) {
        table.resize(capacity);
        mask = capacity - 1;
    }

    void clear() {
        current_visit_id++;
    }

    bool count(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return true;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        return false;
    }

    void insert(const Point& p) {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        table[idx].p = p;
        table[idx].visit_id = current_visit_id;
    }
};

// Open-addressing hash map for snake body indices
struct PointMap {
    struct Slot {
        Point p;
        int val = -1;
        int visit_id = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Slot> table;
    int current_visit_id = 0;
    int mask = 0;

    PointMap(int capacity = 1024) {
        table.resize(capacity);
        mask = capacity - 1;
    }

    void clear() {
        current_visit_id++;
    }

    int get(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return table[idx].val;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    void put(const Point& p, int val) {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) {
                // Keep the minimum value (first occurrence from head)
                return;
            }
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        table[idx].p = p;
        table[idx].val = val;
        table[idx].visit_id = current_visit_id;
    }
};

// Global environment and configuration
int D;
int max_turns;
std::vector<int> bounds;
std::unordered_set<Point, PointHash> food; // for tracking source of truth

PointSet obstacles_set(1024);
PointSet food_set(1024);

bool use_flat_grid = false;
long long total_cells = 0;
std::vector<int> strides;
std::vector<int> visited_flat;
std::vector<int> body_flat;

PointSet visited_set(262144);
PointMap body_map(1024);

inline int get_flat_index(const Point& p) {
    int idx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
        idx += p.coords[i] * strides[i];
    }
    return idx;
}

int flat_visit_id = 0;

struct Node {
    Point pos;
    Node* parent = nullptr;
    int t = 0;
};

std::vector<Node> node_pool(200000);
int node_pool_index = 0;

Node* create_node(const Point& pos, Node* parent, int t) {
    if (node_pool_index >= (int)node_pool.size()) {
        node_pool.resize(node_pool.size() * 2);
    }
    Node* n = &node_pool[node_pool_index++];
    n->pos = pos;
    n->parent = parent;
    n->t = t;
    return n;
}

inline bool is_body_blocked(const Point& p, int next_t, int L) {
    if (use_flat_grid) {
        int idx = get_flat_index(p);
        int val = body_flat[idx];
        return (val != -1 && val < L - next_t);
    } else {
        int val = body_map.get(p);
        return (val != -1 && val < L - next_t);
    }
}

void rebuild_food_set() {
    food_set.clear();
    for (const auto& p : food) {
        food_set.insert(p);
    }
}

int count_reachable_cells(const Point& start_pos, int start_t, int L, int max_cells = 1000) {
    struct SpaceNode {
        Point pos;
        int t;
    };
    std::queue<SpaceNode> q;
    q.push({start_pos, start_t});

    int count = 0;

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        flat_visit_id++;
        int start_idx = get_flat_index(start_pos);
        visited_flat[start_idx] = flat_visit_id;

        while (!q.empty() && count < max_cells) {
            SpaceNode curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            count++;

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr.pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int idx = get_flat_index(neighbor);
                    if (visited_flat[idx] == flat_visit_id) continue;

                    int next_t = curr.t + 1;
                    int val = body_flat[idx];
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_flat[idx] = flat_visit_id;
                    q.push({neighbor, next_t});
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        visited_set.clear();
        visited_set.insert(start_pos);

        while (!q.empty() && count < max_cells) {
            SpaceNode curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            count++;

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr.pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
                    if (visited_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int next_t = curr.t + 1;
                    int val = body_map.get(neighbor);
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_set.insert(neighbor);
                    q.push({neighbor, next_t});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return count;
}

Node* find_path(bool target_food, const Point& target_pos, const Point& head, int L) {
    node_pool_index = 0;
    std::queue<Node*> q;

    Node* start_node = create_node(head, nullptr, 0);
    q.push(start_node);

    Node* target_node = nullptr;

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        flat_visit_id++;
        int start_idx = get_flat_index(head);
        visited_flat[start_idx] = flat_visit_id;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Node* curr = q.front();

            if (target_food) {
                if (food_set.count(curr->pos)) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (curr->pos == target_pos) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (node_pool_index >= 30000) {
                break;
            }

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr->pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int idx = get_flat_index(neighbor);
                    if (visited_flat[idx] == flat_visit_id) continue;

                    int next_t = curr->t + 1;
                    int val = body_flat[idx];
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_flat[idx] = flat_visit_id;
                    q.push(create_node(neighbor, curr, next_t));
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        visited_set.clear();
        visited_set.insert(head);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Node* curr = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (target_food) {
                if (food_set.count(curr->pos)) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (curr->pos == target_pos) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (node_pool_index >= 30000) {
                break;
            }

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr->pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
                    if (visited_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int next_t = curr->t + 1;
                    int val = body_map.get(neighbor);
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_set.insert(neighbor);
                    q.push(create_node(neighbor, curr, next_t));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return target_node;
}

void simulate_body_after_path(const Node* target_node, const std::deque<Point>& current_body, std::deque<Point>& new_body, bool ate_food) {
    std::vector<Point> path;
    const Node* curr = target_node;
    while (curr != nullptr) {
        path.push_back(curr->pos);
        curr = curr->parent;
    }
    std::reverse(path.begin(), path.end());

    int k = path.size() - 1;
    int L = current_body.size();

    new_body.clear();
    for (int i = k; i >= 1; --i) {
        new_body.push_back(path[i]);
    }
    int remaining_limit = L - k + (ate_food ? 1 : 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < remaining_limit && i < L; ++i) {
        new_body.push_back(current_body[i]);
    }
}

void rebuild_body_flat(const std::deque<Point>& old_body, const std::deque<Point>& new_body) {
    for (const auto& p : old_body) {
        body_flat[get_flat_index(p)] = -1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_body.size(); ++i) {
        const Point& p = new_body[i];
        int idx = get_flat_index(p);
        if (body_flat[idx] == -1) {
            body_flat[idx] = i;
        }
    }
}

void rebuild_body_map(const std::deque<Point>& old_body, const std::deque<Point>& new_body) {
    body_map.clear();
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_body.size(); ++i) {
        body_map.put(new_body[i], i);
    }
}

Move select_move(const std::deque<Point>& body) {

            while (curr->parent != nullptr && curr->parent->parent != nullptr) {

            }
            for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {

            while (curr->parent != nullptr && curr->parent->parent != nullptr) {

            }
            for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {

                }
            }
        }
    }

    int best_axis = -1;
    int best_dir = 0;

    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
            Point neighbor = head;
            neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

            if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
            if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

            if (is_body_blocked(neighbor, 1, body.size())) continue;

            Node dummy_start{head, nullptr, 0};

            if (space > max_space) {

    }

struct Point {
    int D = 0;
    std::array<int16_t, 32> coords{};

    bool operator==(const Point& o) const {
        if (D != o.D) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
            if (coords[i] != o.coords[i]) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool operator<(const Point& o) const {
        if (D != o.D) return D < o.D;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
            if (coords[i] != o.coords[i]) {
                return coords[i] < o.coords[i];
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};

struct PointHash {
    std::size_t operator()(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = 17;
        for (int i = 0; i < p.D; ++i) {
            h = h * 31 + p.coords[i];
        }
        return h;
    }
};

// Open-addressing hash set for points
struct PointSet {
    struct Slot {
        Point p;
        int visit_id = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Slot> table;
    int current_visit_id = 0;
    int mask = 0;

    PointSet(int capacity = 262144) {
        table.resize(capacity);
        mask = capacity - 1;
    }

    void clear() {
        current_visit_id++;
    }

    bool count(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return true;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        return false;
    }

    void insert(const Point& p) {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        table[idx].p = p;
        table[idx].visit_id = current_visit_id;
    }
};

// Open-addressing hash map for snake body indices
struct PointMap {
    struct Slot {
        Point p;
        int val = -1;
        int visit_id = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Slot> table;
    int current_visit_id = 0;
    int mask = 0;

    PointMap(int capacity = 1024) {
        table.resize(capacity);
        mask = capacity - 1;
    }

    void clear() {
        current_visit_id++;
    }

    int get(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return table[idx].val;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    void put(const Point& p, int val) {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) {
                // Keep the minimum value (first occurrence from head)
                return;
            }
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        table[idx].p = p;
        table[idx].val = val;
        table[idx].visit_id = current_visit_id;
    }
};

// Global environment and configuration
int D;
int max_turns;
std::vector<int> bounds;
std::unordered_set<Point, PointHash> food; // for tracking source of truth

PointSet obstacles_set(1024);
PointSet food_set(1024);

bool use_flat_grid = false;
long long total_cells = 0;
std::vector<int> strides;
std::vector<int> visited_flat;
std::vector<int> body_flat;

PointSet visited_set(262144);
PointMap body_map(1024);

inline int get_flat_index(const Point& p) {
    int idx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
        idx += p.coords[i] * strides[i];
    }
    return idx;
}

int flat_visit_id = 0;

struct Node {
    Point pos;
    Node* parent = nullptr;
    int t = 0;
};

std::vector<Node> node_pool(200000);
int node_pool_index = 0;

Node* create_node(const Point& pos, Node* parent, int t) {
    if (node_pool_index >= (int)node_pool.size()) {
        node_pool.resize(node_pool.size() * 2);
    }
    Node* n = &node_pool[node_pool_index++];
    n->pos = pos;
    n->parent = parent;
    n->t = t;
    return n;
}

inline bool is_body_blocked(const Point& p, int next_t, int L) {
    if (use_flat_grid) {
        int idx = get_flat_index(p);
        int val = body_flat[idx];
        return (val != -1 && val < L - next_t);
    } else {
        int val = body_map.get(p);
        return (val != -1 && val < L - next_t);
    }
}

void rebuild_food_set() {
    food_set.clear();
    for (const auto& p : food) {
        food_set.insert(p);
    }
}

int count_reachable_cells(const Point& start_pos, int start_t, int L, int max_cells = 1000) {
    struct SpaceNode {
        Point pos;
        int t;
    };
    std::queue<SpaceNode> q;
    q.push({start_pos, start_t});

    int count = 0;

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        flat_visit_id++;
        int start_idx = get_flat_index(start_pos);
        visited_flat[start_idx] = flat_visit_id;

        while (!q.empty() && count < max_cells) {
            SpaceNode curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            count++;

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr.pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int idx = get_flat_index(neighbor);
                    if (visited_flat[idx] == flat_visit_id) continue;

                    int next_t = curr.t + 1;
                    int val = body_flat[idx];
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_flat[idx] = flat_visit_id;
                    q.push({neighbor, next_t});
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        visited_set.clear();
        visited_set.insert(start_pos);

        while (!q.empty() && count < max_cells) {
            SpaceNode curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            count++;

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr.pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
                    if (visited_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int next_t = curr.t + 1;
                    int val = body_map.get(neighbor);
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_set.insert(neighbor);
                    q.push({neighbor, next_t});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return count;
}

Node* find_path(bool target_food, const Point& target_pos, const Point& head, int L) {
    node_pool_index = 0;
    std::queue<Node*> q;

    Node* start_node = create_node(head, nullptr, 0);
    q.push(start_node);

    Node* target_node = nullptr;

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        flat_visit_id++;
        int start_idx = get_flat_index(head);
        visited_flat[start_idx] = flat_visit_id;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Node* curr = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (target_food) {
                if (food_set.count(curr->pos)) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (curr->pos == target_pos) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (node_pool_index >= 30000) {
                break;
            }

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {

                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
