                    int next_t = curr->t + 1;
                    int val = body_flat[idx];
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_flat[idx] = flat_visit_id;
                    q.push(create_node(neighbor, curr, next_t));
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        visited_set.clear();
        visited_set.insert(head);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Node* curr = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (target_food) {
                if (food_set.count(curr->pos)) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (curr->pos == target_pos) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (node_pool_index >= 30000) {
                break;
            }

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr->pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
                    if (visited_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int next_t = curr->t + 1;
                    int val = body_map.get(neighbor);
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_set.insert(neighbor);
                    q.push(create_node(neighbor, curr, next_t));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return target_node;
}

void simulate_body_after_path(const Node* target_node, const std::deque<Point>& current_body, std::deque<Point>& new_body, bool ate_food) {
    std::vector<Point> path;
    const Node* curr = target_node;
    while (curr != nullptr) {
        path.push_back(curr->pos);
        curr = curr->parent;
    }
    std::reverse(path.begin(), path.end());

    int k = path.size() - 1;
    int L = current_body.size();

    new_body.clear();
    for (int i = k; i >= 1; --i) {
        new_body.push_back(path[i]);
    }
    int remaining_limit = L - k + (ate_food ? 1 : 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < remaining_limit && i < L; ++i) {
        new_body.push_back(current_body[i]);
    }
}

void rebuild_body_flat(const std::deque<Point>& old_body, const std::deque<Point>& new_body) {
    for (const auto& p : old_body) {
        body_flat[get_flat_index(p)] = -1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_body.size(); ++i) {
        const Point& p = new_body[i];
        int idx = get_flat_index(p);
        if (body_flat[idx] == -1) {
            body_flat[idx] = i;
        }
    }
}

void rebuild_body_map(const std::deque<Point>& old_body, const std::deque<Point>& new_body) {
    body_map.clear();
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_body.size(); ++i) {
        body_map.put(new_body[i], i);
    }
}

struct Move {
    int axis = 0;
    int direction = 1;
    bool is_deadly = false;
};

Move select_move(const std::deque<Point>& body) {
    Point head = body.front();

    int current_reach = count_reachable_cells(head, 0, body.size(), 1000);

    Node* food_node = find_path(true, Point(), head, body.size());

    if (food_node != nullptr) {
        std::deque<Point> sim_body;
        simulate_body_after_path(food_node, body, sim_body, true);

        if (use_flat_grid) {
            rebuild_body_flat(body, sim_body);
        } else {
            rebuild_body_map(body, sim_body);
        }

        int food_reach = count_reachable_cells(sim_body.front(), food_node->t, sim_body.size(), 1000);

        if (use_flat_grid) {
            rebuild_body_flat(sim_body, body);
        } else {
            rebuild_body_map(sim_body, body);
        }

        int safety_threshold = std::min(current_reach, (int)body.size() + 5);

        if (food_reach >= safety_threshold) {
            Node* curr = food_node;
            while (curr->parent != nullptr && curr->parent->parent != nullptr) {
                curr = curr->parent;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
                if (curr->pos.coords[i] != head.coords[i]) {
                    return {i, curr->pos.coords[i] - head.coords[i], false};
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (body.size() > 1) {
        Node* tail_node = find_path(false, body.back(), head, body.size());
        if (tail_node != nullptr) {
            Node* curr = tail_node;
            while (curr->parent != nullptr && curr->parent->parent != nullptr) {
                curr = curr->parent;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
                if (curr->pos.coords[i] != head.coords[i]) {
                    return {i, curr->pos.coords[i] - head.coords[i], false};
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int best_axis = -1;
    int best_dir = 0;
    int max_space = -1;

    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
            Point neighbor = head;
            neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

            if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
            if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

            if (is_body_blocked(neighbor, 1, body.size())) continue;

            std::deque<Point> sim_body;
            Node dummy_start{head, nullptr, 0};
            Node dummy_neighbor{neighbor, &dummy_start, 1};
            simulate_body_after_path(&dummy_neighbor, body, sim_body, false);

            if (use_flat_grid) {
                rebuild_body_flat(body, sim_body);
            } else {
                rebuild_body_map(body, sim_body);
            }

            int space = count_reachable_cells(neighbor, 1, sim_body.size(), 1000);

            if (use_flat_grid) {
                rebuild_body_flat(sim_body, body);
            } else {
                rebuild_body_map(sim_body, body);
            }

            if (space > max_space) {
                max_space = space;
                best_axis = axis;
                best_dir = dir;
            }
        }
    }

    if (best_axis != -1) {
        return {best_axis, best_dir, false};
    }

    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
            Point neighbor = head;
            neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;
            if (neighbor.coords[axis] >= 0 && neighbor.coords[axis] < bounds[axis] && !obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) {
                return {axis, dir, true};
            }
        }
    }

    return {0, 1, true};
}

        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return true;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        return false;
    }

    void insert(const Point& p) {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        table[idx].p = p;
        table[idx].visit_id = current_visit_id;
    }
};

// Open-addressing hash map for snake body indices
struct PointMap {
    struct Slot {
        Point p;
        int val = -1;
        int visit_id = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Slot> table;
    int current_visit_id = 0;
    int mask = 0;

    PointMap(int capacity = 1024) {
        table.resize(capacity);
        mask = capacity - 1;
    }

    void clear() {
        current_visit_id++;
    }

    int get(const Point& p) const {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) return table[idx].val;
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    void put(const Point& p, int val) {
        std::size_t h = PointHash{}(p);
        int idx = h & mask;
        while (table[idx].visit_id == current_visit_id) {
            if (table[idx].p == p) {
                // Keep the minimum value (first occurrence from head)
                return;
            }
            idx = (idx + 1) & mask;
        }
        table[idx].p = p;
        table[idx].val = val;
        table[idx].visit_id = current_visit_id;
    }
};

// Global environment and configuration
int D;
int max_turns;
std::vector<int> bounds;
std::unordered_set<Point, PointHash> food; // for tracking source of truth

PointSet obstacles_set(1024);
PointSet food_set(1024);

bool use_flat_grid = false;
long long total_cells = 0;
std::vector<int> strides;
std::vector<int> visited_flat;
std::vector<int> body_flat;

PointSet visited_set(262144);
PointMap body_map(1024);

inline int get_flat_index(const Point& p) {
    int idx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
        idx += p.coords[i] * strides[i];
    }
    return idx;
}

int flat_visit_id = 0;

struct Node {
    Point pos;
    Node* parent = nullptr;
    int t = 0;
};

std::vector<Node> node_pool(200000);
int node_pool_index = 0;

Node* create_node(const Point& pos, Node* parent, int t) {
    if (node_pool_index >= (int)node_pool.size()) {
        node_pool.resize(node_pool.size() * 2);
    }
    Node* n = &node_pool[node_pool_index++];
    n->pos = pos;
    n->parent = parent;
    n->t = t;
    return n;
}

inline bool is_body_blocked(const Point& p, int next_t, int L) {
    if (use_flat_grid) {
        int idx = get_flat_index(p);
        int val = body_flat[idx];
        return (val != -1 && val < L - next_t);
    } else {
        int val = body_map.get(p);
        return (val != -1 && val < L - next_t);
    }
}

void rebuild_food_set() {
    food_set.clear();
    for (const auto& p : food) {
        food_set.insert(p);
    }
}

int count_reachable_cells(const Point& start_pos, int start_t, int L, int max_cells = 1000) {
    struct SpaceNode {
        Point pos;
        int t;
    };
    std::queue<SpaceNode> q;
    q.push({start_pos, start_t});

    int count = 0;

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        flat_visit_id++;
        int start_idx = get_flat_index(start_pos);
        visited_flat[start_idx] = flat_visit_id;

        while (!q.empty() && count < max_cells) {
            SpaceNode curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            count++;

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr.pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int idx = get_flat_index(neighbor);
                    if (visited_flat[idx] == flat_visit_id) continue;

                    int next_t = curr.t + 1;
                    int val = body_flat[idx];
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_flat[idx] = flat_visit_id;
                    q.push({neighbor, next_t});
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        visited_set.clear();
        visited_set.insert(start_pos);

        while (!q.empty() && count < max_cells) {
            SpaceNode curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            count++;

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr.pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
                    if (visited_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int next_t = curr.t + 1;
                    int val = body_map.get(neighbor);
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_set.insert(neighbor);
                    q.push({neighbor, next_t});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return count;
}

Node* find_path(bool target_food, const Point& target_pos, const Point& head, int L) {
    node_pool_index = 0;
    std::queue<Node*> q;

    Node* start_node = create_node(head, nullptr, 0);
    q.push(start_node);

    Node* target_node = nullptr;

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        flat_visit_id++;
        int start_idx = get_flat_index(head);
        visited_flat[start_idx] = flat_visit_id;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Node* curr = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (target_food) {
                if (food_set.count(curr->pos)) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (curr->pos == target_pos) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (node_pool_index >= 30000) {
                break;
            }

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr->pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int idx = get_flat_index(neighbor);
                    if (visited_flat[idx] == flat_visit_id) continue;

                    int next_t = curr->t + 1;
                    int val = body_flat[idx];
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_flat[idx] = flat_visit_id;
                    q.push(create_node(neighbor, curr, next_t));
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        visited_set.clear();
        visited_set.insert(head);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Node* curr = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (target_food) {
                if (food_set.count(curr->pos)) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (curr->pos == target_pos) {
                    target_node = curr;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (node_pool_index >= 30000) {
                break;
            }

            for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
                for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point neighbor = curr->pos;
                    neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

                    if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
                    if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;
                    if (visited_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

                    int next_t = curr->t + 1;
                    int val = body_map.get(neighbor);
                    if (val != -1 && val < L - next_t) continue;

                    visited_set.insert(neighbor);
                    q.push(create_node(neighbor, curr, next_t));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return target_node;
}

void simulate_body_after_path(const Node* target_node, const std::deque<Point>& current_body, std::deque<Point>& new_body, bool ate_food) {
    std::vector<Point> path;
    const Node* curr = target_node;
    while (curr != nullptr) {
        path.push_back(curr->pos);
        curr = curr->parent;
    }
    std::reverse(path.begin(), path.end());

    int k = path.size() - 1;
    int L = current_body.size();

    new_body.clear();
    for (int i = k; i >= 1; --i) {
        new_body.push_back(path[i]);
    }
    int remaining_limit = L - k + (ate_food ? 1 : 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < remaining_limit && i < L; ++i) {
        new_body.push_back(current_body[i]);
    }
}

void rebuild_body_flat(const std::deque<Point>& old_body, const std::deque<Point>& new_body) {
    for (const auto& p : old_body) {
        body_flat[get_flat_index(p)] = -1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_body.size(); ++i) {
        const Point& p = new_body[i];
        int idx = get_flat_index(p);
        if (body_flat[idx] == -1) {
            body_flat[idx] = i;
        }
    }
}

void rebuild_body_map(const std::deque<Point>& old_body, const std::deque<Point>& new_body) {
    body_map.clear();
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_body.size(); ++i) {
        body_map.put(new_body[i], i);
    }
}

struct Move {
    int axis = 0;
    int direction = 1;
    bool is_deadly = false;
};

Move select_move(const std::deque<Point>& body) {
    Point head = body.front();

    int current_reach = count_reachable_cells(head, 0, body.size(), 1000);

    Node* food_node = find_path(true, Point(), head, body.size());

    if (food_node != nullptr) {
        std::deque<Point> sim_body;
        simulate_body_after_path(food_node, body, sim_body, true);

        if (use_flat_grid) {
            rebuild_body_flat(body, sim_body);
        } else {
            rebuild_body_map(body, sim_body);
        }

        int food_reach = count_reachable_cells(sim_body.front(), food_node->t, sim_body.size(), 1000);

        if (use_flat_grid) {
            rebuild_body_flat(sim_body, body);
        } else {
            rebuild_body_map(sim_body, body);
        }

        int safety_threshold = std::min(current_reach, (int)body.size() + 5);

        if (food_reach >= safety_threshold) {
            Node* curr = food_node;
            while (curr->parent != nullptr && curr->parent->parent != nullptr) {
                curr = curr->parent;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
                if (curr->pos.coords[i] != head.coords[i]) {
                    return {i, curr->pos.coords[i] - head.coords[i], false};
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (body.size() > 1) {
        Node* tail_node = find_path(false, body.back(), head, body.size());
        if (tail_node != nullptr) {
            Node* curr = tail_node;
            while (curr->parent != nullptr && curr->parent->parent != nullptr) {
                curr = curr->parent;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
                if (curr->pos.coords[i] != head.coords[i]) {
                    return {i, curr->pos.coords[i] - head.coords[i], false};
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int best_axis = -1;
    int best_dir = 0;
    int max_space = -1;

    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
            Point neighbor = head;
            neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;

            if (neighbor.coords[axis] < 0 || neighbor.coords[axis] >= bounds[axis]) continue;
            if (obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) continue;

            if (is_body_blocked(neighbor, 1, body.size())) continue;

            std::deque<Point> sim_body;
            Node dummy_start{head, nullptr, 0};
            Node dummy_neighbor{neighbor, &dummy_start, 1};
            simulate_body_after_path(&dummy_neighbor, body, sim_body, false);

            if (use_flat_grid) {
                rebuild_body_flat(body, sim_body);
            } else {
                rebuild_body_map(body, sim_body);
            }

            int space = count_reachable_cells(neighbor, 1, sim_body.size(), 1000);

            if (use_flat_grid) {
                rebuild_body_flat(sim_body, body);
            } else {
                rebuild_body_map(sim_body, body);
            }

            if (space > max_space) {
                max_space = space;
                best_axis = axis;
                best_dir = dir;
            }
        }
    }

    if (best_axis != -1) {
        return {best_axis, best_dir, false};
    }

    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        for (int dir : {-1, 1}) {
            Point neighbor = head;
            neighbor.coords[axis] += dir;
            if (neighbor.coords[axis] >= 0 && neighbor.coords[axis] < bounds[axis] && !obstacles_set.count(neighbor)) {
                return {axis, dir, true};
            }
        }
    }

    return {0, 1, true};
}

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);

    if (!(std::cin >> D >> max_turns)) return 0;

    bounds.resize(D);
    for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
        std::cin >> bounds[i];
    }

    int snake_length;
    std::cin >> snake_length;

    Point start_pos;
    start_pos.D = D;
    for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
        std::cin >> start_pos.coords[i];
    }

    int F;
    if (!(std::cin >> F)) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < F; ++i) {
        Point p;
        p.D = D;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; ++j) {
            std::cin >> p.coords[j];
        }
        food.insert(p);
    }

    int O;
    if (!(std::cin >> O)) return 0;
    
    int obs_capacity = 1024;
    while (obs_capacity < O * 3) {
        obs_capacity *= 2;
    }
    obstacles_set = PointSet(obs_capacity);
    obstacles_set.current_visit_id = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < O; ++i) {
        Point p;
        p.D = D;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; ++j) {
            std::cin >> p.coords[j];
        }
        obstacles_set.insert(p);
    }

    total_cells = 1;
    use_flat_grid = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
        if (total_cells > 10000000 / bounds[i]) {
            use_flat_grid = false;
            break;
        }
        total_cells *= bounds[i];
    }

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        strides.resize(D);
        int cur = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; ++i) {
            strides[i] = cur;
            cur *= bounds[i];
        }
        visited_flat.assign(total_cells, 0);
        body_flat.assign(total_cells, -1);
    } else {
        int max_snake_len = snake_length + F;
        int capacity = 1024;
        while (capacity < max_snake_len * 3) {
            capacity *= 2;
        }
        body_map = PointMap(capacity);
    }

    int food_capacity = 1024;
    while (food_capacity < F * 3) {
        food_capacity *= 2;
    }
    food_set = PointSet(food_capacity);
    rebuild_food_set();

    std::deque<Point> body;
    for (int i = 0; i < snake_length; ++i) {
        body.push_back(start_pos);
    }

    if (use_flat_grid) {
        rebuild_body_flat(std::deque<Point>(), body);
    } else {
        rebuild_body_map(std::deque<Point>(), body);
    }

    for (int turn = 0; turn < max_turns; ++turn) {
        if (food.empty()) {
            break;
        }

        Move m = select_move(body);
        std::cout << m.axis << " " << m.direction << "\n";
        std::cout.flush();

        if (m.is_deadly) {
            break;
        }

        Point new_head = body.front();
        new_head.coords[m.axis] += m.direction;

        std::deque<Point> old_body = body;

        if (food.count(new_head)) {
            food.erase(new_head);
            rebuild_food_set();
            body.push_front(new_head);
        } else {
            body.push_front(new_head);
            body.pop_back();
        }

        if (use_flat_grid) {
            rebuild_body_flat(old_body, body);
        } else {
            rebuild_body_map(old_body, body);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

    }

    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public int GetMaxHeight() {
        for (int r = Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
            if (GetRow(r) != 0) return r + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public void GetHolesAndBumpiness(out int holes, out int bumpiness) {
        holes = 0;
        ulong filledAbove = 0;
        for (int r = Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
            filledAbove |= GetRow(r);
            holes += TestGame.PopCount((~GetRow(r)) & filledAbove & FullRowMask);
        }

        bumpiness = 0;
        int[] heights = new int[Width];
        for (int c = 0; c < Width; c++) {
            for (int r = Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if ((GetRow(r) & (1UL << c)) != 0) {
                    heights[c] = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < Width - 1; c++) {
            bumpiness += Math.Abs(heights[c] - heights[c + 1]);
        }
    }
}

    public static readonly double[][] PIECE_AVG_R = new double[7][] {
        new double[] { 0.0, 1.5, 0.0, 1.5 },
        new double[] { 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5 },
        new double[] { 0.25, 1.0, 0.75, 1.0 },
        new double[] { 0.5, 1.0, 0.5, 1.0 },
        new double[] { 0.5, 1.0, 0.5, 1.0 },
        new double[] { 0.75, 0.75, 0.25, 1.25 },

    };

    public static readonly int[] UNIQUE_ROTATIONS = new int[7] {
        2, // I
        1, // O
        4, // T
        2, // S

        4, // J
        4  // L

    public static int PopCount(ulong x) {
        x -= (x >> 1) & 0x5555555555555555UL;
        x = (x & 0x3333333333333333UL) + ((x >> 2) & 0x3333333333333333UL);
        x = (x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0fUL;
        return (int)((x * 0x0101010101010101UL) >> 56);
    }

    static int PlacePiece(ref BitBoard bb, int pieceIndex, int rotation, int col) {
        Block[] coords = PIECES[pieceIndex][rotation % 4];
        int pieceHeight = 0;
        foreach (var b in coords) {
            if (b.R > pieceHeight) pieceHeight = b.R;
        }
        pieceHeight += 1;

        uint[] pieceMasks = new uint[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < coords.Length; i++) {
            pieceMasks[coords[i].R] |= (1U << (col + coords[i].C));
        }

        int landingRow = bb.Height;
        for (int startRow = bb.Height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool overlap = false;
            for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < bb.Height && (bb.GetRow(boardRow) & pieceMasks[r]) != 0) {
                    overlap = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (overlap) {
                landingRow = startRow + 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (landingRow == bb.Height) landingRow = 0;

        // Place
        for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow < bb.Height) {
                bb.SetRow(boardRow, bb.GetRow(boardRow) | pieceMasks[r]);
            }
        }

        // Clear lines
        int linesCleared = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < bb.Height; r++) {
            if ((bb.GetRow(r) & bb.FullRowMask) == bb.FullRowMask) {
                for (int r2 = r; r2 < bb.Height - 1; r2++) {
                    bb.SetRow(r2, bb.GetRow(r2 + 1));
                }
                bb.SetRow(bb.Height - 1, 0);
                linesCleared++;
                r--;
            }
        }
        return linesCleared;
    }

    static double EvaluateState(ref BitBoard bb, double landingHeight, int erodedCells, bool survivalMode) {
        int max_height = 0;
        for (int r = bb.Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
            if (bb.GetRow(r) != 0) {
                max_height = r + 1;
                break;
            }
        }

        int aggregate_height = 0;
        int holes = 0;
        int bumpiness = 0;
        int rowTransitions = 0;
        int colTransitions = 0;
        int wellSum = 0;

        if (max_height == 0) {
            colTransitions = bb.Width;
            double scoreEmpty = -4.5 * landingHeight + 3.4 * erodedCells - 9.3 * colTransitions;
            return scoreEmpty;
        }

        int[] heights = new int[bb.Width];
        bool[] heightFound = new bool[bb.Width];
        int columnsFoundCount = 0;
        int[] columnWellDepths = new int[bb.Width];
        ulong filledAbove = 0;

        colTransitions = PopCount(bb.GetRow(0) ^ bb.FullRowMask);

        for (int r = 0; r < max_height; r++) {
            ulong val = bb.GetRow(r);
            ulong flanked = 1UL | (val << 1) | (1UL << (bb.Width + 1));
            ulong diff = flanked ^ (flanked >> 1);
            ulong mask = (1UL << (bb.Width + 1)) - 1;
            rowTransitions += PopCount(diff & mask);

            if (r < bb.Height - 1) {
                colTransitions += PopCount(val ^ bb.GetRow(r + 1));
            }
        }

        for (int r = max_height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
            ulong val = bb.GetRow(r);

            if (columnsFoundCount < bb.Width) {
                for (int c = 0; c < bb.Width; c++) {
                    if (!heightFound[c] && (val & (1UL << c)) != 0) {
                        heights[c] = r + 1;
                        heightFound[c] = true;
                        columnsFoundCount++;
                        aggregate_height += heights[c];
                    }
                }
            }

            filledAbove |= val;
            holes += PopCount((~val) & filledAbove & bb.FullRowMask);

            ulong wellsInRow = (~val) & ((val << 1) | 1UL) & ((val >> 1) | (1UL << (bb.Width - 1))) & bb.FullRowMask;
            for (int c = 0; c < bb.Width; c++) {
                if ((wellsInRow & (1UL << c)) != 0) {
                    columnWellDepths[c]++;
                    wellSum += columnWellDepths[c];
                } else {
                    columnWellDepths[c] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c < bb.Width - 1; c++) {
            bumpiness += Math.Abs(heights[c] - heights[c + 1]);
        }

        double wLH = -4.500158825082766;
        double wEPC = 3.4181268101392694;
        double wRT = -3.2178882868487753;
        double wCT = -9.348695305445199;
        double wH = -7.899265427351652;
        double wWS = -3.3855972247263626;
        double wMH = 0.0;
        double wB = 0.0;

        double heightRatio = (double)max_height / bb.Height;
        if (survivalMode || heightRatio > 0.6) {
            wH = -20.0;
            wCT = -15.0;
            wRT = -6.0;
            wLH = -8.0;
            wMH = -10.0;
            wB = -4.0;
            wEPC = 6.0;
        } else if (heightRatio > 0.3) {
            wH = -12.0;
            wCT = -10.0;
            wMH = -3.0;
            wB = -1.0;
            wLH = -5.0;
        }

        double score = wLH * landingHeight
                     + wEPC * erodedCells
                     + wRT * rowTransitions
                     + wCT * colTransitions
                     + wH * holes
                     + wWS * wellSum
                     + wMH * max_height
                     + wB * bumpiness;

        return score;
    }

    static (int bestRotation, int bestCol) GetBestMove(int pieceIndex, int depth, ref BitBoard bb) {
        double bestScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
        int bestRotation = 0;
        int bestCol = 0;
        int bbMaxHeight = bb.GetMaxHeight();

        // Calculate current holes and bumpiness
        bb.GetHolesAndBumpiness(out int currentHoles, out int currentBumpiness);

        // First pass: depth 1
        double bestDepth1Score = double.NegativeInfinity;
        int bestDepth1Rot = 0;
        int bestDepth1Col = 0;
        bool foundSafeMove = false;

        double bestOverallScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
        int bestOverallRot = 0;
        int bestOverallCol = 0;

        int uniqueRots = UNIQUE_ROTATIONS[pieceIndex];
        for (int rot = 0; rot < uniqueRots; rot++) {
            Block[] coords = PIECES[pieceIndex][rot];
            int pieceWidth = 0;
            int pieceHeight = 0;
            foreach (var b in coords) {
                if (b.C > pieceWidth) pieceWidth = b.C;
                if (b.R > pieceHeight) pieceHeight = b.R;
            }
            pieceWidth += 1;
            pieceHeight += 1;

            for (int col = 0; col <= bb.Width - pieceWidth; col++) {
                uint[] pieceMasks = new uint[4];
                for (int i = 0; i < coords.Length; i++) {
                    pieceMasks[coords[i].R] |= (1U << (col + coords[i].C));
                }

                int landingRow = bb.Height;
                int startScan = Math.Min(bb.Height - 1, bbMaxHeight);
                for (int startRow = startScan; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
                    bool overlap = false;
                    for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                        int boardRow = startRow + r;
                        if (boardRow < bb.Height && (bb.GetRow(boardRow) & pieceMasks[r]) != 0) {
                            overlap = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (overlap) {
                        landingRow = startRow + 1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (landingRow == bb.Height) landingRow = 0;

                if (landingRow + pieceHeight > bb.Height) {
                    continue;
                }

                BitBoard simulated = bb;
                for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                    int boardRow = landingRow + r;
                    simulated.SetRow(boardRow, simulated.GetRow(boardRow) | pieceMasks[r]);
                }

                int clearedCount = 0;
                int pieceCellsCleared = 0;
                for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                    int boardRow = landingRow + r;
                    if ((simulated.GetRow(boardRow) & simulated.FullRowMask) == simulated.FullRowMask) {
                        clearedCount++;
                        pieceCellsCleared += PopCount(pieceMasks[r]);
                    }
                }
                int erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceCellsCleared;

                for (int r = 0; r < simulated.Height; r++) {
                    if ((simulated.GetRow(r) & simulated.FullRowMask) == simulated.FullRowMask) {
                        for (int r2 = r; r2 < simulated.Height - 1; r2++) {
                            simulated.SetRow(r2, simulated.GetRow(r2 + 1));
                        }
                        simulated.SetRow(simulated.Height - 1, 0);
                        r--;
                    }
                }

                int simHoles = 0;
                ulong filledAbove = 0;
                for (int r = simulated.Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                    filledAbove |= simulated.GetRow(r);
                    simHoles += PopCount((~simulated.GetRow(r)) & filledAbove & simulated.FullRowMask);
                }

                double score = EvaluateState(ref simulated, landingRow + PIECE_AVG_R[pieceIndex][rot], erodedCells, false);

                if (score > bestOverallScore) {
                    bestOverallScore = score;
                    bestOverallRot = rot;
                    bestOverallCol = col;
                }

                if (simHoles <= currentHoles) {
                    foundSafeMove = true;
                    if (score > bestDepth1Score) {
                        bestDepth1Score = score;
                        bestDepth1Rot = rot;
                        bestDepth1Col = col;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (depth == 1 || bb.Width >= 16) {
            if (foundSafeMove && bestDepth1Score != double.NegativeInfinity) {
                return (bestDepth1Rot, bestDepth1Col);
            } else if (bestOverallScore != double.NegativeInfinity) {
                return (bestOverallRot, bestOverallCol);
            }
        }

        // Full Depth 2 Search
        for (int rot = 0; rot < uniqueRots; rot++) {
            Block[] coords = PIECES[pieceIndex][rot];
            int pieceWidth = 0;
            int pieceHeight = 0;
            foreach (var b in coords) {
                if (b.C > pieceWidth) pieceWidth = b.C;
                if (b.R > pieceHeight) pieceHeight = b.R;
            }
            pieceWidth += 1;
            pieceHeight += 1;

            for (int col = 0; col <= bb.Width - pieceWidth; col++) {
                uint[] pieceMasks = new uint[4];
                for (int i = 0; i < coords.Length; i++) {
                    pieceMasks[coords[i].R] |= (1U << (col + coords[i].C));
                }

                int landingRow = bb.Height;
                int startScan = Math.Min(bb.Height - 1, bbMaxHeight);
                for (int startRow = startScan; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
                    bool overlap = false;
                    for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                        int boardRow = startRow + r;
                        if (boardRow < bb.Height && (bb.GetRow(boardRow) & pieceMasks[r]) != 0) {
                            overlap = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (overlap) {
                        landingRow = startRow + 1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (landingRow == bb.Height) landingRow = 0;

                if (landingRow + pieceHeight > bb.Height) {
                    continue;
                }

                BitBoard simulated = bb;
                for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                    int boardRow = landingRow + r;
                    simulated.SetRow(boardRow, simulated.GetRow(boardRow) | pieceMasks[r]);
                }

                int clearedCount = 0;
                int pieceCellsCleared = 0;
                for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                    int boardRow = landingRow + r;
                    if ((simulated.GetRow(boardRow) & simulated.FullRowMask) == simulated.FullRowMask) {
                        clearedCount++;
                        pieceCellsCleared += PopCount(pieceMasks[r]);
                    }
                }
                int erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceCellsCleared;

                for (int r = 0; r < simulated.Height; r++) {
                    if ((simulated.GetRow(r) & simulated.FullRowMask) == simulated.FullRowMask) {
                        for (int r2 = r; r2 < simulated.Height - 1; r2++) {
                            simulated.SetRow(r2, simulated.GetRow(r2 + 1));
                        }
                        simulated.SetRow(simulated.Height - 1, 0);
                        r--;
                    }
                }

                int maxHeight = 0;
                for (int r = simulated.Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                    if (simulated.GetRow(r) != 0) {
                        maxHeight = r + 1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                bool survivalMode = (double)maxHeight / bb.Height > 0.7;

                double nextExpectation = 0;
                for (int nextPiece = 0; nextPiece < 7; nextPiece++) {
                    double bestNextScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
                    int nextUniqueRots = UNIQUE_ROTATIONS[nextPiece];
                    
                    for (int nextRot = 0; nextRot < nextUniqueRots; nextRot++) {
                        Block[] nextCoords = PIECES[nextPiece][nextRot];
                        int nextWidth = 0;
                        int nextHeight = 0;
                        foreach (var b in nextCoords) {
                            if (b.C > nextWidth) nextWidth = b.C;
                            if (b.R > nextHeight) nextHeight = b.R;
                        }
                        nextWidth += 1;
                        nextHeight += 1;

                        for (int nextCol = 0; nextCol <= simulated.Width - nextWidth; nextCol++) {
                            uint[] nextPieceMasks = new uint[4];
                            for (int i = 0; i < nextCoords.Length; i++) {
                                nextPieceMasks[nextCoords[i].R] |= (1U << (nextCol + nextCoords[i].C));
                            }

                            int nextLandingRow = simulated.Height;
                            int nextStartScan = Math.Min(simulated.Height - 1, maxHeight);
                            for (int startRow = nextStartScan; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
                                bool overlap = false;
                                for (int r = 0; r < nextHeight; r++) {
                                    int boardRow = startRow + r;
                                    if (boardRow < simulated.Height && (simulated.GetRow(boardRow) & nextPieceMasks[r]) != 0) {
                                        overlap = true;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                if (overlap) {
                                    nextLandingRow = startRow + 1;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (nextLandingRow == simulated.Height) nextLandingRow = 0;

                            if (nextLandingRow + nextHeight > simulated.Height) {
                                continue;
                            }

                            BitBoard nextSimulated = simulated;
                            for (int r = 0; r < nextHeight; r++) {
                                int boardRow = nextLandingRow + r;
                                nextSimulated.SetRow(boardRow, nextSimulated.GetRow(boardRow) | nextPieceMasks[r]);
                            }

                            int nextClearedCount = 0;
                            int nextPieceCellsCleared = 0;
                            for (int r = 0; r < nextHeight; r++) {
                                int boardRow = nextLandingRow + r;
                                if ((nextSimulated.GetRow(boardRow) & nextSimulated.FullRowMask) == nextSimulated.FullRowMask) {
                                    nextClearedCount++;
                                    nextPieceCellsCleared += PopCount(nextPieceMasks[r]);
                                }
                            }
                            int nextErodedCells = nextClearedCount * nextPieceCellsCleared;

                            for (int r = 0; r < nextSimulated.Height; r++) {
                                if ((nextSimulated.GetRow(r) & nextSimulated.FullRowMask) == nextSimulated.FullRowMask) {
                                    for (int r2 = r; r2 < nextSimulated.Height - 1; r2++) {
                                        nextSimulated.SetRow(r2, nextSimulated.GetRow(r2 + 1));
                                    }
                                    nextSimulated.SetRow(nextSimulated.Height - 1, 0);
                                    r--;
                                }
                            }

                            double nextStateScore = EvaluateState(ref nextSimulated, nextLandingRow + PIECE_AVG_R[nextPiece][nextRot], nextErodedCells, survivalMode);
                            if (nextStateScore > bestNextScore) {
                                    bestNextScore = nextStateScore;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (bestNextScore == double.NegativeInfinity) {
                        bestNextScore = -10000.0;
                    }
                    nextExpectation += bestNextScore;
                }
                
                double currentMoveScore = EvaluateState(ref simulated, landingRow + PIECE_AVG_R[pieceIndex][rot], erodedCells, survivalMode) + (nextExpectation / 7.0);

                if (currentMoveScore > bestScore) {
                    bestScore = currentMoveScore;
                    bestRotation = rot;
                    bestCol = col;
                }
            }
        }

        if (bestScore == double.NegativeInfinity) {
            bestRotation = 0;
            bestCol = 0;
        }

        return (bestRotation, bestCol);
    }

    static void Main() {
        int width = 10;
        int height = 20;
        BitBoard bb = new BitBoard();
        bb.Width = width;
        bb.Height = height;
        bb.FullRowMask = (1UL << width) - 1;
        Random rand = new Random(12345);

        int numPieces = 50000;
        Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        int piecesPlaced = 0;
        int linesCleared = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < numPieces; i++) {
            int pieceIndex = rand.Next(7);
            bb.GetHolesAndBumpiness(out int holes, out int bumpiness);
            int depth = (holes > 0 || bumpiness > 4 || bb.GetMaxHeight() >= height * 0.4) ? 2 : 1;
            
            (int rotation, int col) = GetBestMove(pieceIndex, depth, ref bb);
            
            int cleared = PlacePiece(ref bb, pieceIndex, rotation, col);
            linesCleared += cleared;
            piecesPlaced++;

            if (bb.GetMaxHeight() >= height) {
                Console.WriteLine($"Game Over at piece {i}! Max height exceeded.");
                break;
            }
        }
        sw.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"Placed {piecesPlaced} pieces, cleared {linesCleared} lines.");
        Console.WriteLine($"Total time: {sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds:F2} seconds.");
        Console.WriteLine($"Average time per piece: {sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds / piecesPlaced:F4} ms.");
    }
}

using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

struct Block {
    public int R;
    public int C;
    public Block(int r, int c) { R = r; C = c; }
}

public struct BitBoard {
    public int Width;
    public int Height;
    public ulong FullRowMask;
    public ulong Row0, Row1, Row2, Row3, Row4, Row5, Row6, Row7, Row8, Row9,
                 Row10, Row11, Row12, Row13, Row14, Row15, Row16, Row17, Row18, Row19,
                 Row20, Row21, Row22, Row23, Row24, Row25, Row26, Row27, Row28, Row29,
                 Row30, Row31, Row32, Row33, Row34, Row35;

    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public ulong GetRow(int r) {
        switch (r) {
            case 0: return Row0;
            case 1: return Row1;
            case 2: return Row2;
            case 3: return Row3;
            case 4: return Row4;
            case 5: return Row5;
            case 6: return Row6;
            case 7: return Row7;
            case 8: return Row8;
            case 9: return Row9;
            case 10: return Row10;
            case 11: return Row11;
            case 12: return Row12;
            case 13: return Row13;
            case 14: return Row14;
            case 15: return Row15;
            case 16: return Row16;
            case 17: return Row17;
            case 18: return Row18;
            case 19: return Row19;
            case 20: return Row20;
            case 21: return Row21;
            case 22: return Row22;
            case 23: return Row23;
            case 24: return Row24;
            case 25: return Row25;
            case 26: return Row26;
            case 27: return Row27;
            case 28: return Row28;
            case 29: return Row29;
            case 30: return Row30;
            case 31: return Row31;
            case 32: return Row32;
            case 33: return Row33;
            case 34: return Row34;
            case 35: return Row35;
            default: return 0;
        }
    }

    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public void SetRow(int r, ulong val) {
        switch (r) {
            case 0: Row0 = val; break;
            case 1: Row1 = val; break;
            case 2: Row2 = val; break;
            case 3: Row3 = val; break;
            case 4: Row4 = val; break;
            case 5: Row5 = val; break;
            case 6: Row6 = val; break;
            case 7: Row7 = val; break;
            case 8: Row8 = val; break;
            case 9: Row9 = val; break;
            case 10: Row10 = val; break;
            case 11: Row11 = val; break;
            case 12: Row12 = val; break;
            case 13: Row13 = val; break;
            case 14: Row14 = val; break;
            case 15: Row15 = val; break;
            case 16: Row16 = val; break;
            case 17: Row17 = val; break;
            case 18: Row18 = val; break;
            case 19: Row19 = val; break;
            case 20: Row20 = val; break;
            case 21: Row21 = val; break;
            case 22: Row22 = val; break;
            case 23: Row23 = val; break;
            case 24: Row24 = val; break;
            case 25: Row25 = val; break;
            case 26: Row26 = val; break;
            case 27: Row27 = val; break;
            case 28: Row28 = val; break;
            case 29: Row29 = val; break;
            case 30: Row30 = val; break;
            case 31: Row31 = val; break;
            case 32: Row32 = val; break;
            case 33: Row33 = val; break;
            case 34: Row34 = val; break;
            case 35: Row35 = val; break;
        }
    }

    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public int GetMaxHeight() {
        for (int r = Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
            if (GetRow(r) != 0) return r + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public void GetHolesAndBumpiness(out int holes, out int bumpiness) {
        holes = 0;
        ulong filledAbove = 0;
        for (int r = Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
            filledAbove |= GetRow(r);
            holes += TestGame.PopCount((~GetRow(r)) & filledAbove & FullRowMask);
        }

        bumpiness = 0;
        int[] heights = new int[Width];
        for (int c = 0; c < Width; c++) {
            for (int r = Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if ((GetRow(r) & (1UL << c)) != 0) {
                    heights[c] = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < Width - 1; c++) {
            bumpiness += Math.Abs(heights[c] - heights[c + 1]);
        }
    }
}

class TestGame {

            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(0, 1), new Block(0, 2), new Block(0, 3) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(1, 0), new Block(2, 0), new Block(3, 0) }
        },
        // O
        new Block[][] {

            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1) }
        },
        // T
        new Block[][] {

            new Block[] { new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1), new Block(1, 2), new Block(0, 1) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1), new Block(2, 1) }
        },

        new Block[][] {

            new Block[] { new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1), new Block(2, 0) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 1), new Block(1, 2) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1), new Block(2, 0) }
        },
        // Z
        new Block[][] {

            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1), new Block(2, 1) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 1), new Block(0, 2), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1) },

            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(0, 1), new Block(0, 2), new Block(1, 2) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 1), new Block(2, 0), new Block(2, 1) }
        },
        // L
        new Block[][] {
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 2), new Block(1, 0), new Block(1, 1), new Block(1, 2) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(1, 0), new Block(2, 0), new Block(2, 1) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(0, 1), new Block(0, 2), new Block(1, 0) },
            new Block[] { new Block(0, 0), new Block(0, 1), new Block(1, 1), new Block(2, 1) }
        }
    };

    public static readonly double[][] PIECE_AVG_R = new double[7][] {
        new double[] { 0.0, 1.5, 0.0, 1.5 },
        new double[] { 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5 },
        new double[] { 0.25, 1.0, 0.75, 1.0 },
        new double[] { 0.5, 1.0, 0.5, 1.0 },
        new double[] { 0.5, 1.0, 0.5, 1.0 },
        new double[] { 0.75, 0.75, 0.25, 1.25 },
        new double[] { 0.75, 1.25, 0.25, 0.75 }
    };

    public static readonly int[] UNIQUE_ROTATIONS = new int[7] {
        2, // I
        1, // O
        4, // T
        2, // S
        2, // Z
        4, // J
        4  // L
    };

    public static int PopCount(ulong x) {
        x -= (x >> 1) & 0x5555555555555555UL;
        x = (x & 0x3333333333333333UL) + ((x >> 2) & 0x3333333333333333UL);
        x = (x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0fUL;
        return (int)((x * 0x0101010101010101UL) >> 56);
    }

    static int PlacePiece(ref BitBoard bb, int pieceIndex, int rotation, int col) {
        Block[] coords = PIECES[pieceIndex][rotation % 4];
        int pieceHeight = 0;
        foreach (var b in coords) {
            if (b.R > pieceHeight) pieceHeight = b.R;
        }
        pieceHeight += 1;

        uint[] pieceMasks = new uint[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < coords.Length; i++) {
            pieceMasks[coords[i].R] |= (1U << (col + coords[i].C));
        }

        int landingRow = bb.Height;
        for (int startRow = bb.Height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool overlap = false;
            for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < bb.Height && (bb.GetRow(boardRow) & pieceMasks[r]) != 0) {
                    overlap = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (overlap) {
                landingRow = startRow + 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (landingRow == bb.Height) landingRow = 0;

        // Place
        for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow < bb.Height) {
                bb.SetRow(boardRow, bb.GetRow(boardRow) | pieceMasks[r]);
            }
        }

        // Clear lines
        int linesCleared = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < bb.Height; r++) {
            if ((bb.GetRow(r) & bb.FullRowMask) == bb.FullRowMask) {
                for (int r2 = r; r2 < bb.Height - 1; r2++) {
                    bb.SetRow(r2, bb.GetRow(r2 + 1));
                }
                bb.SetRow(bb.Height - 1, 0);
                linesCleared++;
                r--;
            }
        }
        return linesCleared;
    }

    static double EvaluateState(ref BitBoard bb, double landingHeight, int erodedCells, bool survivalMode) {
        int max_height = 0;
        for (int r = bb.Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
            if (bb.GetRow(r) != 0) {
                max_height = r + 1;
                break;
            }
        }

        int aggregate_height = 0;
        int holes = 0;
        int bumpiness = 0;
        int rowTransitions = 0;
        int colTransitions = 0;
        int wellSum = 0;

        if (max_height == 0) {
            colTransitions = bb.Width;
            double scoreEmpty = -4.5 * landingHeight + 3.4 * erodedCells - 9.3 * colTransitions;
            return scoreEmpty;
        }

        int[] heights = new int[bb.Width];
        bool[] heightFound = new bool[bb.Width];
        int columnsFoundCount = 0;
        int[] columnWellDepths = new int[bb.Width];
        ulong filledAbove = 0;

        colTransitions = PopCount(bb.GetRow(0) ^ bb.FullRowMask);

        for (int r = 0; r < max_height; r++) {
            ulong val = bb.GetRow(r);
            ulong flanked = 1UL | (val << 1) | (1UL << (bb.Width + 1));
            ulong diff = flanked ^ (flanked >> 1);
            ulong mask = (1UL << (bb.Width + 1)) - 1;
            rowTransitions += PopCount(diff & mask);

            if (r < bb.Height - 1) {
                colTransitions += PopCount(val ^ bb.GetRow(r + 1));
            }
        }

        for (int r = max_height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
            ulong val = bb.GetRow(r);

            if (columnsFoundCount < bb.Width) {
                for (int c = 0; c < bb.Width; c++) {
                    if (!heightFound[c] && (val & (1UL << c)) != 0) {
                        heights[c] = r + 1;
                        heightFound[c] = true;
                        columnsFoundCount++;
                        aggregate_height += heights[c];
                    }
                }
            }

            filledAbove |= val;
            holes += PopCount((~val) & filledAbove & bb.FullRowMask);

            ulong wellsInRow = (~val) & ((val << 1) | 1UL) & ((val >> 1) | (1UL << (bb.Width - 1))) & bb.FullRowMask;
            for (int c = 0; c < bb.Width; c++) {
                if ((wellsInRow & (1UL << c)) != 0) {
                    columnWellDepths[c]++;
                    wellSum += columnWellDepths[c];
                } else {
                    columnWellDepths[c] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c < bb.Width - 1; c++) {
            bumpiness += Math.Abs(heights[c] - heights[c + 1]);
        }

        double wLH = -4.500158825082766;
        double wEPC = 3.4181268101392694;
        double wRT = -3.2178882868487753;
        double wCT = -9.348695305445199;
        double wH = -7.899265427351652;
        double wWS = -3.3855972247263626;
        double wMH = 0.0;
        double wB = 0.0;

        double heightRatio = (double)max_height / bb.Height;
        if (survivalMode || heightRatio > 0.6) {
            wH = -20.0;
            wCT = -15.0;
            wRT = -6.0;
            wLH = -8.0;
            wMH = -10.0;
            wB = -4.0;
            wEPC = 6.0;
        } else if (heightRatio > 0.3) {
            wH = -12.0;
            wCT = -10.0;
            wMH = -3.0;
            wB = -1.0;
            wLH = -5.0;
        }

        double score = wLH * landingHeight
                     + wEPC * erodedCells
                     + wRT * rowTransitions
                     + wCT * colTransitions
                     + wH * holes
                     + wWS * wellSum
                     + wMH * max_height
                     + wB * bumpiness;

        return score;
    }

    static (int bestRotation, int bestCol) GetBestMove(int pieceIndex, int depth, ref BitBoard bb) {
        double bestScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
        int bestRotation = 0;
        int bestCol = 0;
        int bbMaxHeight = bb.GetMaxHeight();

        // Calculate current holes and bumpiness
        bb.GetHolesAndBumpiness(out int currentHoles, out int currentBumpiness);

        // First pass: depth 1
        double bestDepth1Score = double.NegativeInfinity;
        int bestDepth1Rot = 0;
        int bestDepth1Col = 0;
        bool foundSafeMove = false;

        double bestOverallScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
        int bestOverallRot = 0;
        int bestOverallCol = 0;

        int uniqueRots = UNIQUE_ROTATIONS[pieceIndex];
        for (int rot = 0; rot < uniqueRots; rot++) {
            Block[] coords = PIECES[pieceIndex][rot];
            int pieceWidth = 0;
            int pieceHeight = 0;
            foreach (var b in coords) {
                if (b.C > pieceWidth) pieceWidth = b.C;
                if (b.R > pieceHeight) pieceHeight = b.R;
            }
            pieceWidth += 1;
            pieceHeight += 1;

            for (int col = 0; col <= bb.Width - pieceWidth; col++) {
                uint[] pieceMasks = new uint[4];
                for (int i = 0; i < coords.Length; i++) {
                    pieceMasks[coords[i].R] |= (1U << (col + coords[i].C));
                }

                int landingRow = bb.Height;
                int startScan = Math.Min(bb.Height - 1, bbMaxHeight);
                for (int startRow = startScan; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
                    bool overlap = false;
                    for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                        int boardRow = startRow + r;
                        if (boardRow < bb.Height && (bb.GetRow(boardRow) & pieceMasks[r]) != 0) {
                            overlap = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (overlap) {
                        landingRow = startRow + 1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (landingRow == bb.Height) landingRow = 0;

                if (landingRow + pieceHeight > bb.Height) {
                    continue;
                }

                BitBoard simulated = bb;
                for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                    int boardRow = landingRow + r;
                    simulated.SetRow(boardRow, simulated.GetRow(boardRow) | pieceMasks[r]);
                }

                int clearedCount = 0;
                int pieceCellsCleared = 0;
                for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                    int boardRow = landingRow + r;
                    if ((simulated.GetRow(boardRow) & simulated.FullRowMask) == simulated.FullRowMask) {
                        clearedCount++;
                        pieceCellsCleared += PopCount(pieceMasks[r]);
                    }
                }
                int erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceCellsCleared;

                for (int r = 0; r < simulated.Height; r++) {
                    if ((simulated.GetRow(r) & simulated.FullRowMask) == simulated.FullRowMask) {
                        for (int r2 = r; r2 < simulated.Height - 1; r2++) {
                            simulated.SetRow(r2, simulated.GetRow(r2 + 1));
                        }
                        simulated.SetRow(simulated.Height - 1, 0);
                        r--;
                    }
                }

                int simHoles = 0;
                ulong filledAbove = 0;
                for (int r = simulated.Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                    filledAbove |= simulated.GetRow(r);
                    simHoles += PopCount((~simulated.GetRow(r)) & filledAbove & simulated.FullRowMask);
                }

                double score = EvaluateState(ref simulated, landingRow + PIECE_AVG_R[pieceIndex][rot], erodedCells, false);

                if (score > bestOverallScore) {
                    bestOverallScore = score;
                    bestOverallRot = rot;
                    bestOverallCol = col;
                }

                if (simHoles <= currentHoles) {
                    foundSafeMove = true;
                    if (score > bestDepth1Score) {
                        bestDepth1Score = score;
                        bestDepth1Rot = rot;
                        bestDepth1Col = col;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (depth == 1 || bb.Width >= 16) {
            if (foundSafeMove && bestDepth1Score != double.NegativeInfinity) {
                return (bestDepth1Rot, bestDepth1Col);
            } else if (bestOverallScore != double.NegativeInfinity) {
                return (bestOverallRot, bestOverallCol);
            }
        }

        // Full Depth 2 Search
        for (int rot = 0; rot < uniqueRots; rot++) {
            Block[] coords = PIECES[pieceIndex][rot];
            int pieceWidth = 0;
            int pieceHeight = 0;
            foreach (var b in coords) {
                if (b.C > pieceWidth) pieceWidth = b.C;
                if (b.R > pieceHeight) pieceHeight = b.R;
            }
            pieceWidth += 1;
            pieceHeight += 1;

            for (int col = 0; col <= bb.Width - pieceWidth; col++) {
                uint[] pieceMasks = new uint[4];
                for (int i = 0; i < coords.Length; i++) {
                    pieceMasks[coords[i].R] |= (1U << (col + coords[i].C));
                }

                int landingRow = bb.Height;
                int startScan = Math.Min(bb.Height - 1, bbMaxHeight);
                for (int startRow = startScan; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
                    bool overlap = false;
                    for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                        int boardRow = startRow + r;
                        if (boardRow < bb.Height && (bb.GetRow(boardRow) & pieceMasks[r]) != 0) {
                            overlap = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (overlap) {
                        landingRow = startRow + 1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (landingRow == bb.Height) landingRow = 0;

                if (landingRow + pieceHeight > bb.Height) {
                    continue;
                }

                BitBoard simulated = bb;
                for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                    int boardRow = landingRow + r;
                    simulated.SetRow(boardRow, simulated.GetRow(boardRow) | pieceMasks[r]);
                }

                int clearedCount = 0;
                int pieceCellsCleared = 0;
                for (int r = 0; r < pieceHeight; r++) {
                    int boardRow = landingRow + r;
                    if ((simulated.GetRow(boardRow) & simulated.FullRowMask) == simulated.FullRowMask) {
                        clearedCount++;
                        pieceCellsCleared += PopCount(pieceMasks[r]);
                    }
                }
                int erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceCellsCleared;

                for (int r = 0; r < simulated.Height; r++) {
                    if ((simulated.GetRow(r) & simulated.FullRowMask) == simulated.FullRowMask) {
                        for (int r2 = r; r2 < simulated.Height - 1; r2++) {
                            simulated.SetRow(r2, simulated.GetRow(r2 + 1));
                        }
                        simulated.SetRow(simulated.Height - 1, 0);
                        r--;
                    }
                }

                int maxHeight = 0;
                for (int r = simulated.Height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                    if (simulated.GetRow(r) != 0) {
                        maxHeight = r + 1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                bool survivalMode = (double)maxHeight / bb.Height > 0.7;

                double nextExpectation = 0;
                for (int nextPiece = 0; nextPiece < 7; nextPiece++) {
                    double bestNextScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
                    int nextUniqueRots = UNIQUE_ROTATIONS[nextPiece];
                    
                    for (int nextRot = 0; nextRot < nextUniqueRots; nextRot++) {
                        Block[] nextCoords = PIECES[nextPiece][nextRot];
                        int nextWidth = 0;
                        int nextHeight = 0;
                        foreach (var b in nextCoords) {
                            if (b.C > nextWidth) nextWidth = b.C;
                            if (b.R > nextHeight) nextHeight = b.R;
                        }
                        nextWidth += 1;
                        nextHeight += 1;

                        for (int nextCol = 0; nextCol <= simulated.Width - nextWidth; nextCol++) {
                            uint[] nextPieceMasks = new uint[4];
                            for (int i = 0; i < nextCoords.Length; i++) {
                                nextPieceMasks[nextCoords[i].R] |= (1U << (nextCol + nextCoords[i].C));
                            }

                            int nextLandingRow = simulated.Height;
                            int nextStartScan = Math.Min(simulated.Height - 1, maxHeight);
                            for (int startRow = nextStartScan; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
                                bool overlap = false;
                                for (int r = 0; r < nextHeight; r++) {
                                    int boardRow = startRow + r;
                                    if (boardRow < simulated.Height && (simulated.GetRow(boardRow) & nextPieceMasks[r]) != 0) {
                                        overlap = true;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                if (overlap) {
                                    nextLandingRow = startRow + 1;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (nextLandingRow == simulated.Height) nextLandingRow = 0;

                            if (nextLandingRow + nextHeight > simulated.Height) {
                                continue;
                            }

                            BitBoard nextSimulated = simulated;
                            for (int r = 0; r < nextHeight; r++) {
                                int boardRow = nextLandingRow + r;
                                nextSimulated.SetRow(boardRow, nextSimulated.GetRow(boardRow) | nextPieceMasks[r]);
                            }

                            int nextClearedCount = 0;
                            int nextPieceCellsCleared = 0;
                            for (int r = 0; r < nextHeight; r++) {
                                int boardRow = nextLandingRow + r;
                                if ((nextSimulated.GetRow(boardRow) & nextSimulated.FullRowMask) == nextSimulated.FullRowMask) {
                                    nextClearedCount++;
                                    nextPieceCellsCleared += PopCount(nextPieceMasks[r]);
                                }
                            }
                            int nextErodedCells = nextClearedCount * nextPieceCellsCleared;

                            for (int r = 0; r < nextSimulated.Height; r++) {
                                if ((nextSimulated.GetRow(r) & nextSimulated.FullRowMask) == nextSimulated.FullRowMask) {
                                    for (int r2 = r; r2 < nextSimulated.Height - 1; r2++) {
                                        nextSimulated.SetRow(r2, nextSimulated.GetRow(r2 + 1));
                                    }
                                    nextSimulated.SetRow(nextSimulated.Height - 1, 0);
                                    r--;
                                }
                            }

                            double nextStateScore = EvaluateState(ref nextSimulated, nextLandingRow + PIECE_AVG_R[nextPiece][nextRot], nextErodedCells, survivalMode);
                            if (nextStateScore > bestNextScore) {
                                    bestNextScore = nextStateScore;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (bestNextScore == double.NegativeInfinity) {
                        bestNextScore = -10000.0;
                    }
                    nextExpectation += bestNextScore;
                }
                
                double currentMoveScore = EvaluateState(ref simulated, landingRow + PIECE_AVG_R[pieceIndex][rot], erodedCells, survivalMode) + (nextExpectation / 7.0);

                if (currentMoveScore > bestScore) {
                    bestScore = currentMoveScore;
                    bestRotation = rot;
                    bestCol = col;
                }
            }
        }

        if (bestScore == double.NegativeInfinity) {
            bestRotation = 0;
            bestCol = 0;
        }

        return (bestRotation, bestCol);
    }

    static void Main() {
        int width = 10;
        int height = 20;
        BitBoard bb = new BitBoard();
        bb.Width = width;
        bb.Height = height;
        bb.FullRowMask = (1UL << width) - 1;
        Random rand = new Random(12345);

        int numPieces = 50000;
        Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        int piecesPlaced = 0;
        int linesCleared = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < numPieces; i++) {
            int pieceIndex = rand.Next(7);
            bb.GetHolesAndBumpiness(out int holes, out int bumpiness);
            int depth = (holes > 0 || bumpiness > 4 || bb.GetMaxHeight() >= height * 0.4) ? 2 : 1;
            
            (int rotation, int col) = GetBestMove(pieceIndex, depth, ref bb);
            
            int cleared = PlacePiece(ref bb, pieceIndex, rotation, col);
            linesCleared += cleared;
            piecesPlaced++;

            if (bb.GetMaxHeight() >= height) {
                Console.WriteLine($"Game Over at piece {i}! Max height exceeded.");
                break;
            }
        }
        sw.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"Placed {piecesPlaced} pieces, cleared {linesCleared} lines.");
        Console.WriteLine($"Total time: {sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds:F2} seconds.");
        Console.WriteLine($"Average time per piece: {sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds / piecesPlaced:F4} ms.");
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Rust code to play Lunar Lander in real-time.

Your Rust lunar lander controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from simple
training environments to very complex landing sites.

Control a lunar lander to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a 2D voxel map and continuous state updates, and must output thrust/turn
commands to land safely on the target.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time. If your code
doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the io buffer fills up, the ship will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes that
async code doesn't have. Multithreaded / asyncio code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Physics:**
- Gravity pulls lander down constantly
- Thrust applies force in lander's facing direction
- Fuel is limited
- Must land softly on target (low velocity)

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal numbers):**
Initial map:
```
width height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y target_x target_y
map rows (. = empty, # = obstacle, S = start, T = target, L = landing zone)
```

Then you recieve continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds):
```
x y vx vy angle angular_vel fuel_remaining
```
x and y are in meters, from the worlds top left, and y increases downward.
vx and vy are in m/s.
angle is in radians, 0 is facing up.
angular_vel is in radians per second. + is clockwise, - is counterclockwise.
fuel_remaining is seconds at max_thrust.

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following instructions at a frequency of at least 20hz:
```
thrust turn
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max thrust)
- turn: -1.0 to 1.0 (turning rate, negative = left, positive = right)

To be crystal clear: that's two decimal numbers seperated by a space, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (so it misses 2 consecutive updates), the engine
will automatically cut power. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

Map size can vary from 100x50 to multi-gb maps, so be efficient with memory and processing.

Thrust and gravity are in m/s/s. 100% engine burn burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

Lander size is approximatly 1x1m, and the 2D map grid size is 1m x 1m.

Turn is in radians per second. The lander can not rotate fully around and will clamp rotation to
facing down if attempted.

Y increases downward. Positive vy means moving downward. Gravity is +g.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 2m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries
- Complete landing within time limit

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into obstacle or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed time limit

Typical Prompt:
You are writing C++ code to play a 3D Lunar Lander game in real-time.

Your C++ controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from tiny (100m) to huge (100km).
The same code must work for all scales.

Control a lunar lander in full 3D space to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a terrain file path and continuous state updates via stdin, and must
output thrust/rotation commands to stdout in real-time.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time.
If your code doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the IO buffer fills up, the ship
will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes
that async code doesn't have. Multithreaded code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Coordinate System:**
- X: horizontal (East), Y: horizontal (North), Z: UP.
- Gravity acts in the -Z direction.
- All positions are in meters. Velocities in m/s. Angles in radians.

**Physics:**
- Gravity = 1.62 m/s² (lunar) in -Z direction.
- Thrust is along the lander's local "up" axis. When pitch=0 and yaw=0, thrust is
straight up (+Z). Tilting via pitch/yaw redirects thrust.
- Pitch: tilts the lander. +pitch tilts forward, redirecting thrust partially into -X.
Pitch is clamped to [-pi/2, pi/2].
- Yaw: rotates heading around Z.
- Roll: rolls around the thrust axis (cosmetic only, does not affect thrust direction).
- Rotation dynamics: commands apply angular acceleration (2 rad/s² per unit).
Angular rates are damped by 0.95 per tick.
- Fuel: 100% thrust burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

**Input format (stdin):**
Initial header (whitespace separated decimal numbers, except terrain path):
```
width depth height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y start_z target_x target_y target_z
terrain_file_path
STATE
```

The terrain_file_path is on its own line (the path may contain spaces).
Read the entire line with getline() or equivalent.

**Terrain file format (binary):**
The terrain file defines the 3D world as a binary file. It is a sequence of
uint16_t triplets (little-endian), one per (x, y) cell, stored in row-major order:

```cpp
for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
for (int y = 0; y < depth; y++) {
uint16_t a = read_uint16_le(); // ground rock top
uint16_t b = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock bottom
uint16_t c = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock top
}
}
```

For each column (x, y), the vertical structure is:
- z < a: SOLID ROCK (ground)
- a <= z < b: OPEN AIR
- b <= z < c: SOLID ROCK (floating terrain feature, overhang, arch, etc.)
- c <= z: OPEN AIR

If b == c, there is no floating rock in that column (just ground + open sky).
The file size is exactly width * depth * 6 bytes.

You have a startup grace period to parse this file before state updates begin.
The grace period is 5 seconds plus 10 seconds per gigabyte of terrain file.
For a 100x100 map this is ~5s. For a 100000x10000 map (~6GB) this is ~65s.
You may continue parsing in a background thread after the simulation begins,
but you MUST be reading stdin and writing stdout by then to avoid a crash.

Then continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds, whitespace separated):
```
x y z vx vy vz pitch yaw roll pitch_rate yaw_rate roll_rate fuel_remaining
```

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following at a frequency of at least 10hz:
```
thrust pitch_cmd yaw_cmd roll_cmd
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max_thrust)
- pitch_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (pitch angular acceleration command)
- yaw_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (yaw angular acceleration command)
- roll_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (roll angular acceleration command)

To be crystal clear: four decimal numbers separated by spaces, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (misses 2 consecutive updates), the
engine will cut thrust automatically. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

**Landing:**
- The target is at (target_x, target_y, target_z) which is just above the terrain.
- You must land within a small radius of the target with total speed < 3 m/s.
- Landing zone radius is approximately max(5, min(width,depth)*0.02) meters.

**Terrain collisions:**
- You collide if you enter any solid cell as defined by the terrain file.
- Out of bounds (x<0, x>=width, y<0, y>=depth, z<0, z>=height) is also a collision.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 3 m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into terrain or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed simulation time limit
