use std::io::{self, Read, Write, BufReader, BufWriter};
use std::thread;
use std::time::Instant;

// Fast LCG Random Number Generator
struct SimpleRng {
    state: u64,
}

impl SimpleRng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self { state: seed }
    }
    
    fn next(&mut self) -> usize {
        self.state = self.state.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);
        self.state as usize
    }
}

// Bounding box distance calculation helper
#[inline(always)]
fn sq_dist(a: &[f32; 3], b: &[f32; 3]) -> f32 {
    let dx = a[0] - b[0];
    let dy = a[1] - b[1];
    let dz = a[2] - b[2];
    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
}

// Flat KD-tree Node
struct KdNode {
    point: [f32; 3],
    id: u32,
    left: i32,
    right: i32,
    axis: u8,
}

// KD-tree for fast 3D nearest-neighbor search
struct KdTree {
    nodes: Vec<KdNode>,
    root: i32,
}

impl KdTree {
    fn build(centroids: &[[f32; 3]]) -> Self {
        let mut nodes = Vec::with_capacity(centroids.len());
        let mut indices: Vec<usize> = (0..centroids.len()).collect();
        let root = Self::build_recursive(&mut indices, centroids, &mut nodes);
        Self { nodes, root }
    }
    
    fn build_recursive(
        indices: &mut [usize],
        centroids: &[[f32; 3]],
        nodes: &mut Vec<KdNode>,
    ) -> i32 {
        if indices.is_empty() {
            return -1;
        }
        
        // Find split axis based on the dimension with the largest spread
        let mut min = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
        let mut max = [f32::NEG_INFINITY; 3];
        for &idx in indices.iter() {
            let p = centroids[idx];
            for i in 0..3 {
                if p[i] < min[i] { min[i] = p[i]; }
                if p[i] > max[i] { max[i] = p[i]; }
            }
        }
        
        let mut axis = 0;
        let mut max_spread = max[0] - min[0];
        for i in 1..3 {
            let spread = max[i] - min[i];
            if spread > max_spread {
                max_spread = spread;
                axis = i;
            }
        }
        
        let mid = indices.len() / 2;
        indices.select_nth_unstable_by(mid, |&a, &b| {
            centroids[a][axis].partial_cmp(&centroids[b][axis]).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
        });
        
        let centroid_idx = indices[mid];
        let node_idx = nodes.len() as i32;
        nodes.push(KdNode {
            point: centroids[centroid_idx],
            id: centroid_idx as u32,
            left: -1,
            right: -1,
            axis: axis as u8,
        });
        
        let left = Self::build_recursive(&mut indices[..mid], centroids, nodes);
        let right = Self::build_recursive(&mut indices[mid + 1..], centroids, nodes);
        
        nodes[node_idx as usize].left = left;
        nodes[node_idx as usize].right = right;
        
        node_idx
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn find_nearest(&self, query: &[f32; 3]) -> (u32, f32) {
        let mut best_id = 0;
        let mut best_dist = f32::INFINITY;
        self.nearest_neighbor(self.root, query, &mut best_id, &mut best_dist);
        (best_id, best_dist)
    }
    
    fn nearest_neighbor(
        &self,
        root: i32,
        query: &[f32; 3],
        best_id: &mut u32,
        best_dist: &mut f32,
    ) {
        if root == -1 {
            return;
        }
        let node = &self.nodes[root as usize];
        let dist = sq_dist(query, &node.point);
        if dist < *best_dist {
            *best_dist = dist;
            *best_id = node.id;
        }
        
        let axis = node.axis as usize;
        let diff = query[axis] - node.point[axis];
        
        let (first, second) = if diff < 0.0 {
            (node.left, node.right)
        } else {
            (node.right, node.left)
        };
        
        self.nearest_neighbor(first, query, best_id, best_dist);
        
        if diff * diff < *best_dist {
            self.nearest_neighbor(second, query, best_id, best_dist);
        }
    }
}

// Randomly choose initial centroids from sample using candidate-based k-means++
fn initialize_centroids(sample: &[[f32; 3]], n_clusters: usize, rng: &mut SimpleRng) -> Vec<[f32; 3]> {
    let mut centroids = Vec::with_capacity(n_clusters);
    if sample.is_empty() {
        for _ in 0..n_clusters {
            centroids.push([0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        }
        return centroids;
    }
    
    if sample.len() <= n_clusters {
        for i in 0..n_clusters {
            centroids.push(sample[i % sample.len()]);
        }
        return centroids;
    }
    
    // Choose a candidate subset from the sample
    let candidate_size = std::cmp::min(sample.len(), 2 * n_clusters);
    let mut candidates = Vec::with_capacity(candidate_size);
    let mut indices: Vec<usize> = (0..sample.len()).collect();
    for i in (1..indices.len()).rev() {
        let j = rng.next() % (i + 1);
        indices.swap(i, j);
    }
    for i in 0..candidate_size {
        candidates.push(sample[indices[i]]);
    }
    
    // Run k-means++ on candidates
    // Pick first centroid randomly
    let first_idx = rng.next() % candidate_size;
    centroids.push(candidates[first_idx]);
    
    // Maintain the minimum distance squared from each candidate to any chosen centroid
    let mut min_dists = vec![f32::INFINITY; candidate_size];
    for i in 0..candidate_size {
        min_dists[i] = sq_dist(&candidates[i], &centroids[0]);
    }
    
    for _ in 1..n_clusters {
        let mut sum = 0.0f64;
        for &d in min_dists.iter() {
            sum += d as f64;
        }
        
        if sum == 0.0 {
            // All remaining candidates are identical to chosen centroids, just pick a random candidate
            let idx = rng.next() % candidate_size;
            centroids.push(candidates[idx]);
            continue;
        }
        
        // Generate random float between 0 and sum
        let random_fraction = (rng.next() % 1000000) as f64 / 1000000.0;
        let mut r = random_fraction * sum;
        let mut chosen_idx = 0;
        for (i, &d) in min_dists.iter().enumerate() {
            r -= d as f64;
            if r <= 0.0 {
                chosen_idx = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        centroids.push(candidates[chosen_idx]);
        
        // Update minimum distances
        let new_centroid = &centroids[centroids.len() - 1];
        for i in 0..candidate_size {
            let d = sq_dist(&candidates[i], new_centroid);
            if d < min_dists[i] {
                min_dists[i] = d;
            }
        }
    }
    
    centroids
}

// Parallel assignment step for standard k-means iteration
fn k_means_iteration(
    points: &[[f32; 3]],
    tree: &KdTree,
    n_clusters: usize,
    num_threads: usize,
) -> (Vec<[f32; 3]>, Vec<usize>) {
    let chunk_size = (points.len() + num_threads - 1) / num_threads;
    
    thread::scope(|s| {
        let mut handles = Vec::with_capacity(num_threads);
        for chunk in points.chunks(chunk_size) {
            handles.push(s.spawn(move || {
                let mut local_sums = vec![[0.0f32; 3]; n_clusters];
                let mut local_counts = vec![0usize; n_clusters];
                for pt in chunk {
                    let (centroid_id, _) = tree.find_nearest(pt);
                    let c = centroid_id as usize;
                    local_sums[c][0] += pt[0];
                    local_sums[c][1] += pt[1];
                    local_sums[c][2] += pt[2];
                    local_counts[c] += 1;
                }
                (local_sums, local_counts)
            }));
        }
        
        let mut global_sums = vec![[0.0f32; 3]; n_clusters];
        let mut global_counts = vec![0usize; n_clusters];
        for handle in handles {
            let (local_sums, local_counts) = handle.join().unwrap();
            for i in 0..n_clusters {
                global_sums[i][0] += local_sums[i][0];
                global_sums[i][1] += local_sums[i][1];
                global_sums[i][2] += local_sums[i][2];
                global_counts[i] += local_counts[i];
            }
        }
        (global_sums, global_counts)
    })
}

// Train centroids on the sample using accelerated standard k-means
fn train_centroids(
    sample: &[[f32; 3]],
    n_clusters: usize,
    num_threads: usize,
    rng: &mut SimpleRng,
) -> (Vec<[f32; 3]>, Vec<usize>) {
    let mut centroids = initialize_centroids(sample, n_clusters, rng);
    let mut counts = vec![0usize; n_clusters];
    
    // Calculate bounding box and coordinate spread for convergence check
    let mut min_val = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
    let mut max_val = [f32::NEG_INFINITY; 3];
    for pt in sample {
        for i in 0..3 {
            if pt[i] < min_val[i] { min_val[i] = pt[i]; }
            if pt[i] > max_val[i] { max_val[i] = pt[i]; }
        }
    }
    let dx = max_val[0] - min_val[0];
    let dy = max_val[1] - min_val[1];
    let dz = max_val[2] - min_val[2];
    let spread_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
    let tolerance = 1e-6 * spread_sq;
    
    let max_iterations = 25;
    for iter in 0..max_iterations {
        let tree = KdTree::build(&centroids);
        let (sums, new_counts) = k_means_iteration(sample, &tree, n_clusters, num_threads);
        
        let mut max_shift = 0.0f32;
        let mut updated_centroids = centroids.clone();
        
        for i in 0..n_clusters {
            if new_counts[i] > 0 {
                let new_centroid = [
                    sums[i][0] / new_counts[i] as f32,
                    sums[i][1] / new_counts[i] as f32,
                    sums[i][2] / new_counts[i] as f32,
                ];
                let shift = sq_dist(&centroids[i], &new_centroid);
                if shift > max_shift {
                    max_shift = shift;
                }
                updated_centroids[i] = new_centroid;
            } else {
                // Reinitialize empty cluster with a random sample point
                if !sample.is_empty() {
                    let random_pt = sample[rng.next() % sample.len()];
                    updated_centroids[i] = random_pt;
                }
                max_shift = f32::INFINITY;
            }
        }
        
        centroids = updated_centroids;
        counts = new_counts;
        
        if max_shift < tolerance {
            eprintln!("K-means converged at iteration {}", iter + 1);
            break;
        }
    }
    (centroids, counts)
}

// Parallel assignment for a batch during streaming
fn parallel_assign_batch(
    batch: &[[f32; 3]],
    tree: &KdTree,
    n_clusters: usize,
    num_threads: usize,
) -> (Vec<u32>, Vec<[f32; 3]>, Vec<usize>) {
    let chunk_size = (batch.len() + num_threads - 1) / num_threads;
    
    thread::scope(|s| {
        let mut handles = Vec::with_capacity(num_threads);
        for chunk in batch.chunks(chunk_size) {
            handles.push(s.spawn(move || {
                let mut assignments = Vec::with_capacity(chunk.len());
                let mut local_sums = vec![[0.0f32; 3]; n_clusters];
                let mut local_counts = vec![0usize; n_clusters];
                for pt in chunk {
                    let (id, _) = tree.find_nearest(pt);
                    assignments.push(id);
                    let c = id as usize;
                    local_sums[c][0] += pt[0];
                    local_sums[c][1] += pt[1];
                    local_sums[c][2] += pt[2];
                    local_counts[c] += 1;
                }
                (assignments, local_sums, local_counts)
            }));
        }
        
        let mut global_assignments = Vec::with_capacity(batch.len());
        let mut global_sums = vec![[0.0f32; 3]; n_clusters];
        let mut global_counts = vec![0usize; n_clusters];
        
        for handle in handles {
            let (assignments, local_sums, local_counts) = handle.join().unwrap();
            global_assignments.extend(assignments);
            for i in 0..n_clusters {
                global_sums[i][0] += local_sums[i][0];
                global_sums[i][1] += local_sums[i][1];
                global_sums[i][2] += local_sums[i][2];
                global_counts[i] += local_counts[i];
            }
        }
        (global_assignments, global_sums, global_counts)
    })
}

// Read header in text format
fn read_header<R: Read>(reader: &mut R) -> io::Result<(usize, usize)> {
    let mut header = String::new();
    let mut byte = [0u8; 1];
    while reader.read_exact(&mut byte).is_ok() {
        if byte[0] == b'\n' {
            break;
        }
        header.push(byte[0] as char);
    }
    let parts: Vec<&str> = header.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "Invalid header format"));
    }
    let num_points = parts[0].parse::<usize>().map_err(|e| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, e))?;
    let num_clusters = parts[1].parse::<usize>().map_err(|e| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, e))?;
    Ok((num_points, num_clusters))
}

// Fast read block helper
fn read_points_chunk<R: Read>(
    reader: &mut R,
    limit: usize,
) -> io::Result<Vec<[f32; 3]>> {
    let mut points = Vec::with_capacity(limit);
    let chunk_size = 65536;
    let mut byte_buf = vec![0u8; chunk_size * 12];
    
    let mut remaining = limit;
    while remaining > 0 {
        let to_read = std::cmp::min(remaining, chunk_size);
        let bytes_to_read = to_read * 12;
        
        let mut total_read = 0;
        while total_read < bytes_to_read {
            match reader.read(&mut byte_buf[total_read..bytes_to_read]) {
                Ok(0) => break,
                Ok(n) => total_read += n,
                Err(ref e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {}
                Err(e) => return Err(e),
            }
        }
        
        let points_read = total_read / 12;
        if points_read == 0 {
            break;
        }
        
        for i in 0..points_read {
            let offset = i * 12;
            let x = f32::from_le_bytes([
                byte_buf[offset],
                byte_buf[offset + 1],
                byte_buf[offset + 2],
                byte_buf[offset + 3],
            ]);
            let y = f32::from_le_bytes([
                byte_buf[offset + 4],
                byte_buf[offset + 5],
                byte_buf[offset + 6],
                byte_buf[offset + 7],
            ]);
            let z = f32::from_le_bytes([
                byte_buf[offset + 8],
                byte_buf[offset + 9],
                byte_buf[offset + 10],
                byte_buf[offset + 11],
            ]);
            points.push([x, y, z]);
        }
        
        if points_read < to_read {
            break;
        }
        remaining -= points_read;
    }
    
    Ok(points)
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(io::stdin());
    
    // Read dataset header
    let (num_points, n_clusters) = read_header(&mut reader)?;
    if num_points == 0 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    
    let n_clusters = if n_clusters == 0 { 1 } else { n_clusters };
    
    let num_threads = std::thread::available_parallelism()
        .map(|n| n.get())
        .unwrap_or(4);
        
    eprintln!("Processing {} points, {} clusters, using {} threads", num_points, n_clusters, num_threads);
    
    let mut rng = SimpleRng::new(1337);
    
    let in_memory_threshold = 5_000_000;
    
    if num_points <= in_memory_threshold {
        // --- IN-MEMORY STRATEGY ---
        let start_time = Instant::now();
        let points = read_points_chunk(&mut reader, num_points)?;
        eprintln!("Loaded points in {:?}", start_time.elapsed());
        
        let train_start = Instant::now();
        let (centroids, _) = train_centroids(&points, n_clusters, num_threads, &mut rng);
        eprintln!("Trained centroids in {:?}", train_start.elapsed());
        
        let write_start = Instant::now();
        let tree = KdTree::build(&centroids);
        let stdout = io::stdout();
        let mut writer = BufWriter::new(stdout.lock());
        
        let chunk_size = 65536;
        for chunk in points.chunks(chunk_size) {
            let mut output_bytes = Vec::with_capacity(chunk.len() * 4);
            for pt in chunk {
                let (id, _) = tree.find_nearest(pt);
                output_bytes.extend_from_slice(&id.to_le_bytes());
            }
            writer.write_all(&output_bytes)?;
        }
        writer.flush()?;
        eprintln!("Wrote output in {:?}", write_start.elapsed());
    } else {
        // --- STREAMING STRATEGY ---
        // Dynamically choose sample size for training
        let sample_size = std::cmp::min(num_points, std::cmp::max(200 * n_clusters, 1_000_000));
        eprintln!("Streaming mode: training centroids on a sample of size {}", sample_size);
        
        let start_time = Instant::now();
        let sample = read_points_chunk(&mut reader, sample_size)?;
        eprintln!("Loaded training sample in {:?}", start_time.elapsed());
        
        let train_start = Instant::now();
        let (mut centroids, counts) = train_centroids(&sample, n_clusters, num_threads, &mut rng);
        eprintln!("Trained centroids in {:?}", train_start.elapsed());
        
        let mut tree = KdTree::build(&centroids);
        let stdout = io::stdout();
        let mut writer = BufWriter::new(stdout.lock());
        
        // Write assignments for the initial sample points first
        let write_start = Instant::now();
        let chunk_size = 65536;
        for chunk in sample.chunks(chunk_size) {
            let mut output_bytes = Vec::with_capacity(chunk.len() * 4);
            for pt in chunk {
                let (id, _) = tree.find_nearest(pt);
                output_bytes.extend_from_slice(&id.to_le_bytes());
            }
            writer.write_all(&output_bytes)?;
        }
        writer.flush()?;
        drop(sample); // Free memory immediately
        
        // Stream the remaining points in batches
        let batch_size = if num_points > 100_000_000 { 1_048_576 } else { 262_144 };
        let mut weights: Vec<f32> = counts.into_iter().map(|c| c as f32).collect();
        
        let mut remaining = num_points - sample_size;
        while remaining > 0 {
            let to_read = std::cmp::min(remaining, batch_size);
            let batch = read_points_chunk(&mut reader, to_read)?;
            if batch.is_empty() {
                break;
            }
            
            // Assign points in parallel and get statistics for updating
            let (assignments, local_sums, local_counts) = parallel_assign_batch(&batch, &tree, n_clusters, num_threads);
            
            // Online update of centroids (MacQueen's sequential k-means)
            for i in 0..n_clusters {
                let k = local_counts[i];
                if k > 0 {
                    let w = weights[i];
                    let new_w = w + k as f32;
                    centroids[i][0] = (w * centroids[i][0] + local_sums[i][0]) / new_w;
                    centroids[i][1] = (w * centroids[i][1] + local_sums[i][1]) / new_w;
                    centroids[i][2] = (w * centroids[i][2] + local_sums[i][2]) / new_w;
                    weights[i] = new_w;
                }
            }
            
            // Rebuild tree with updated centroids
            tree = KdTree::build(&centroids);
            
            // Output assignments for the batch
            let mut output_bytes = Vec::with_capacity(assignments.len() * 4);
            for id in assignments {
                output_bytes.extend_from_slice(&id.to_le_bytes());
            }
            writer.write_all(&output_bytes)?;
            
            remaining -= batch.len();
        }
        writer.flush()?;
        eprintln!("Streaming and assignments complete in {:?}", write_start.elapsed());
    }
    
    Ok(())
}

struct FastParser<'a> {
    bytes: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
}

impl<'a> FastParser<'a> {
    fn new(bytes: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
        Self { bytes, pos: 0 }
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn next_usize(&mut self) -> Option<usize> {
        while self.pos < self.bytes.len() && self.bytes[self.pos] <= b' ' {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
        if self.pos >= self.bytes.len() {
            return None;
        }
        let mut val = 0;
        while self.pos < self.bytes.len() && self.bytes[self.pos] > b' ' {
            val = val * 10 + (self.bytes[self.pos] - b'0') as usize;
            self.pos += 1;
        }
        Some(val)
    }
}

struct FastRng {
    state: u64,
}

impl FastRng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        let mut seed = seed;
        if seed == 0 {
            seed = 1;
        }
        Self { state: seed }
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let mut x = self.state;
        x ^= x << 13;
        x ^= x >> 7;
        x ^= x << 17;
        self.state = x;
        x
    }
}

struct Graph {
    num_vertices: usize,
    num_edges: usize,
    edges: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
    v_beg_idx: Vec<usize>,
    v_edges: Vec<usize>,
    v_adj: Vec<usize>,
    v_degree: Vec<usize>,
}

struct SharedState {
    global_best_size: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize,
    best_cover: std::sync::Mutex<Vec<usize>>,
    stop_flag: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool,
}

struct Solver {
    v_num: usize,
    e_num: usize,
    graph: std::sync::Arc<Graph>,
    v_in_c: Vec<bool>,
    dscore: Vec<i32>,
    time_stamp: Vec<u64>,
    remove_cand: Vec<usize>,
    index_in_remove_cand: Vec<usize>,
    remove_cand_size: usize,
    uncov_stack: Vec<usize>,
    index_in_uncov_stack: Vec<usize>,
    uncov_stack_fill_pointer: usize,
    c_size: usize,
    rng: FastRng,
}

impl Solver {
    fn new(graph: std::sync::Arc<Graph>, seed: u64) -> Self {
        let v_num = graph.num_vertices;
        let e_num = graph.num_edges;
        Self {
            v_num,
            e_num,
            graph,
            v_in_c: vec![false; v_num],
            dscore: vec![0; v_num],
            time_stamp: vec![0; v_num],
            remove_cand: vec![0; v_num],
            index_in_remove_cand: vec![0; v_num],
            remove_cand_size: 0,
            uncov_stack: vec![0; e_num],
            index_in_uncov_stack: vec![0; e_num],
            uncov_stack_fill_pointer: 0,
            c_size: 0,
            rng: FastRng::new(seed),
        }
    }

    fn init_sol(&mut self) {
        self.c_size = 0;
        for e in 0..self.e_num {
            let (v1, v2) = self.graph.edges[e];
            if !self.v_in_c[v1] && !self.v_in_c[v2] {
                if self.graph.v_degree[v1] > self.graph.v_degree[v2] {
                    self.v_in_c[v1] = true;
                } else {
                    self.v_in_c[v2] = true;
                }
                self.c_size += 1;
            }
        }

        for e in 0..self.e_num {
            let (v1, v2) = self.graph.edges[e];
            let in_1 = self.v_in_c[v1];
            let in_2 = self.v_in_c[v2];
            if in_1 && !in_2 {
                self.dscore[v1] -= 1;
            } else if in_2 && !in_1 {
                self.dscore[v2] -= 1;
            }
        }

        for v in 0..self.v_num {
            if self.v_in_c[v] && self.dscore[v] == 0 {
                self.remove(v);
                self.c_size -= 1;
            }
        }

        self.reset_remove_cand();
    }

    fn reset_remove_cand(&mut self) {
        let mut j = 0;
        for v in 0..self.v_num {
            if self.v_in_c[v] {
                self.remove_cand[j] = v;
                self.index_in_remove_cand[v] = j;
                j += 1;
            } else {
                self.index_in_remove_cand[v] = 0;
            }
        }
        self.remove_cand_size = j;
    }

    fn update_target_size(&mut self) {
        self.c_size -= 1;

        let mut best_remove_v = self.remove_cand[0];

        if self.dscore[best_remove_v] != 0 {
            for i in 0..(self.remove_cand_size - 1) {
                let v = self.remove_cand[i];

                if self.dscore[v] == 0 {
                    best_remove_v = v;
                    break;
                }

                if self.dscore[v] > self.dscore[best_remove_v] {
                    best_remove_v = v;
                }
            }
        }

        self.remove(best_remove_v);

        self.remove_cand_size -= 1;
        let last_remove_cand_v = self.remove_cand[self.remove_cand_size];
        let index = self.index_in_remove_cand[best_remove_v];
        self.remove_cand[index] = last_remove_cand_v;
        self.index_in_remove_cand[last_remove_cand_v] = index;
    }

    fn choose_remove_v(&mut self) -> usize {
        let cand_count = 50;
        let r = self.rng.next() as usize;
        let mut best_v = self.remove_cand[r % self.remove_cand_size];

        for _ in 0..(cand_count - 1) {
            let r_idx = self.rng.next() as usize;
            let v = self.remove_cand[r_idx % self.remove_cand_size];

            if self.dscore[v] < self.dscore[best_v] {
                continue;
            } else if self.dscore[v] > self.dscore[best_v] {
                best_v = v;
            } else if self.time_stamp[v] < self.time_stamp[best_v] {
                best_v = v;
            }
        }
        best_v
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn uncover(&mut self, e: usize) {
        self.index_in_uncov_stack[e] = self.uncov_stack_fill_pointer;
        self.uncov_stack[self.uncov_stack_fill_pointer] = e;
        self.uncov_stack_fill_pointer += 1;
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn cover(&mut self, e: usize) {
        self.uncov_stack_fill_pointer -= 1;
        let last_uncov_edge = self.uncov_stack[self.uncov_stack_fill_pointer];
        let index = self.index_in_uncov_stack[e];
        self.uncov_stack[index] = last_uncov_edge;
        self.index_in_uncov_stack[last_uncov_edge] = index;
    }

    fn add(&mut self, v: usize) {
        self.v_in_c[v] = true;
        self.dscore[v] = -self.dscore[v];

        let beg = self.graph.v_beg_idx[v];
        let edge_count = self.graph.v_degree[v];

        for i in 0..edge_count {
            let e = self.graph.v_edges[beg + i];
            let n = self.graph.v_adj[beg + i];

            if !self.v_in_c[n] {
                self.dscore[n] -= 1;
                self.cover(e);
            } else {
                self.dscore[n] += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    fn remove(&mut self, v: usize) {
        self.v_in_c[v] = false;
        self.dscore[v] = -self.dscore[v];

        let beg = self.graph.v_beg_idx[v];
        let edge_count = self.graph.v_degree[v];

        for i in 0..edge_count {
            let e = self.graph.v_edges[beg + i];
            let n = self.graph.v_adj[beg + i];

            if !self.v_in_c[n] {
                self.dscore[n] += 1;
                self.uncover(e);
            } else {
                self.dscore[n] -= 1;
            }
        }
    }

    fn cover_ls(&mut self, shared: &SharedState, start_time: &std::time::Instant, max_stagnation: u64) {
        let mut step: u64 = 1;
        let mut steps_since_improvement: u64 = 0;
        let try_step = 10000;

        let mut local_best_size = self.c_size;

        loop {
            if self.uncov_stack_fill_pointer == 0 {
                let current_size = self.c_size;

                if current_size < local_best_size {
                    local_best_size = current_size;
                    steps_since_improvement = 0;
                }

                let mut global_best = shared.global_best_size.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
                while current_size < global_best {
                    match shared.global_best_size.compare_exchange_weak(
                        global_best,
                        current_size,
                        std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst,
                        std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed,
                    ) {
                        Ok(_) => {
                            let mut lock = shared.best_cover.lock().unwrap();
                            if lock.len() == 0 || current_size < lock.len() {
                                lock.clear();
                                for v in 0..self.v_num {
                                    if self.v_in_c[v] {
                                        lock.push(v);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                        Err(actual) => {
                            global_best = actual;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if shared.stop_flag.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
                    return;
                }

                self.update_target_size();
                continue;
            }

            if step % try_step == 0 {
                if shared.stop_flag.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
                    return;
                }
                if start_time.elapsed().as_secs_f64() > 4.5 {
                    shared.stop_flag.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
                    return;
                }
                if steps_since_improvement > max_stagnation {
                    return;
                }
            }

            let remove_v = self.choose_remove_v();
            self.remove(remove_v);

            let r_edge_idx = (self.rng.next() as usize) % self.uncov_stack_fill_pointer;
            let e = self.uncov_stack[r_edge_idx];
            let (v1, v2) = self.graph.edges[e];

            let add_v = if self.dscore[v1] > self.dscore[v2] ||
                           (self.dscore[v1] == self.dscore[v2] && self.time_stamp[v1] < self.time_stamp[v2]) {
                v1
            } else {
                v2
            };

            self.add(add_v);

            let index = self.index_in_remove_cand[remove_v];
            self.index_in_remove_cand[remove_v] = 0;

            self.remove_cand[index] = add_v;
            self.index_in_remove_cand[add_v] = index;

            self.time_stamp[add_v] = step;
            self.time_stamp[remove_v] = step;

            step += 1;
            steps_since_improvement += 1;
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let start_time = std::time::Instant::now();

    let mut input_bytes = Vec::new();
    std::io::Read::read_to_end(&mut std::io::stdin(), &mut input_bytes).unwrap();
    let mut parser = FastParser::new(&input_bytes);

    let num_vertices = match parser.next_usize() {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => return,
    };
    let num_edges = parser.next_usize().unwrap();

    let mut edges = Vec::with_capacity(num_edges);
    let mut v_degree = vec![0; num_vertices];
    for _ in 0..num_edges {
        let u = parser.next_usize().unwrap();
        let v = parser.next_usize().unwrap();
        edges.push((u, v));
        v_degree[u] += 1;
        v_degree[v] += 1;
    }

    let mut v_beg_idx = Vec::with_capacity(num_vertices + 1);
    v_beg_idx.push(0);
    let mut acc = 0;
    for &deg in &v_degree {
        acc += deg;
        v_beg_idx.push(acc);
    }

    let total_deg = v_beg_idx[num_vertices];
    let mut v_edges = vec![0; total_deg];
    let mut v_adj = vec![0; total_deg];

    let mut v_degree_tmp = vec![0; num_vertices];
    for (e, &(v1, v2)) in edges.iter().enumerate() {
        v_edges[v_beg_idx[v1] + v_degree_tmp[v1]] = e;
        v_edges[v_beg_idx[v2] + v_degree_tmp[v2]] = e;

        v_adj[v_beg_idx[v1] + v_degree_tmp[v1]] = v2;
        v_adj[v_beg_idx[v2] + v_degree_tmp[v2]] = v1;

        v_degree_tmp[v1] += 1;
        v_degree_tmp[v2] += 1;
    }

    let graph = std::sync::Arc::new(Graph {
        num_vertices,
        num_edges,
        edges,
        v_beg_idx,
        v_edges,
        v_adj,
        v_degree,
    });

    let shared = std::sync::Arc::new(SharedState {
        global_best_size: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(num_vertices),
        best_cover: std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        stop_flag: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
    });

    let num_threads = 32;

    let max_stagnation = std::cmp::max(5_000_000 / num_threads as u64, (500 * num_vertices as u64) / num_threads as u64);

    let mut handles = Vec::new();

    for i in 0..num_threads {
        let graph_clone = graph.clone();
        let shared_clone = shared.clone();
        let seed = 123456789 + i as u64 * 987654321;

        let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut solver = Solver::new(graph_clone, seed);
            solver.init_sol();

            let current_size = solver.c_size;
            let mut global_best = shared_clone.global_best_size.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
            while current_size < global_best {
                match shared_clone.global_best_size.compare_exchange_weak(
                    global_best,
                    current_size,
                    std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst,
                    std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed,
                ) {
                    Ok(_) => {
                        let mut lock = shared_clone.best_cover.lock().unwrap();
                        if lock.len() == 0 || current_size < lock.len() {
                            lock.clear();
                            for v in 0..solver.v_num {
                                if solver.v_in_c[v] {
                                    lock.push(v);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    Err(actual) => {
                        global_best = actual;
                    }
                }
            }

            solver.cover_ls(&shared_clone, &start_time, max_stagnation);
        });
        handles.push(handle);
    }

    for handle in handles {
        let _ = handle.join();
    }

    let final_cover = shared.best_cover.lock().unwrap().clone();
    println!("{}", final_cover.len());
    let mut first = true;
    for &v in &final_cover {
        if !first {
            print!(" ");
        }
        first = false;
        print!("{}", v);
    }
    println!();
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Python code to solve the 3-SAT (Boolean Satisfiability) problem, which is NP-Complete.

**What is 3-SAT?**
You have N boolean variables (x1, x2, ..., xN), each of which is either True or False.
You are given M "clauses". Each clause is a constraint containing exactly 3 "literals".
A literal is either:
- A positive integer (e.g. 5) meaning "variable 5 must be True", or
- A negative integer (e.g. -5) meaning "variable 5 must be False".

A clause is **satisfied** if ANY of its 3 literals evaluates to True.
The formula is **satisfiable** if ALL clauses can be satisfied simultaneously
by some assignment of True/False to the variables.

**Example:**
Variables: x1, x2, x3
Clause "1 -2 3" means: x1=True OR x2=False OR x3=True.
If x1=True, x2=True, x3=False → clause satisfied (x1=True is enough).

Your task: find an assignment of True/False to every variable that satisfies
every clause. All test instances are guaranteed to be satisfiable.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
num_variables num_clauses
lit1 lit2 lit3
lit1 lit2 lit3
...
```
Variables are 1-indexed. Negative literals mean negation.

**Output format (stdout):**
```
SAT
v1 v2 v3 ... vN
```
Where each vi is 1 (True) or 0 (False) for variable i, space-separated.

**Grading:**
- Output "SAT" on the first line, then the assignment on the second line.
- Every clause must be satisfied by your assignment.
- Timeouts, crashes, wrong format, or unsatisfied clauses all score 0.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Handle up to 20M variables and 85M clauses.
3. Complete within 5 minutes.

import sys
import array
import random

def solve_sat():
    # 1. Parse header (num_vars, num_clauses)
    num_vars = 0
    num_clauses = 0
    while True:
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line:
            break
        line_stripped = line.strip()
        if not line_stripped or line_stripped.startswith('c'):
            continue
        # Check if DIMACS style line
        if line_stripped.startswith('p'):
            parts = line_stripped.split()
            num_vars = int(parts[2])
            num_clauses = int(parts[3])
            break
        else:
            parts = line_stripped.split()
            num_vars = int(parts[0])
            num_clauses = int(parts[1])
            break
            
    if num_clauses == 0:
        sys.stdout.write("SAT\n")
        sys.stdout.write(" ".join(["0"] * num_vars) + "\n")
        return

    # 2. Parse clauses chunk by chunk to be memory efficient
    clauses_arr = array.array('i')
    chunk_size = 50 * 1024 * 1024  # 50 MB chunk
    leftover = ""
    
    while True:
        chunk = sys.stdin.read(chunk_size)
        if not chunk:
            break
        text = leftover + chunk
        last_space = text.rfind(' ')
        last_newline = text.rfind('\n')
        split_pos = max(last_space, last_newline)
        if split_pos != -1:
            current_text = text[:split_pos]
            leftover = text[split_pos:]
        else:
            current_text = text
            leftover = ""
        
        clauses_arr.extend(map(int, current_text.split()))
        
    if leftover:
        clauses_arr.extend(map(int, leftover.split()))
        
    # 3. CRS construction
    # Count occurrences
    counts = [0] * (num_vars + 1)
    for lit in clauses_arr:
        counts[abs(lit)] += 1
        
    # Compute start pointers
    starts = [0] * (num_vars + 2)
    for i in range(1, num_vars + 2):
        starts[i] = starts[i-1] + counts[i-1]
        
    # Build occs
    occs = [0] * (3 * num_clauses)
    cursor = list(starts)
    
    for c_idx in range(num_clauses):
        idx = 3 * c_idx
        c_shifted = c_idx << 1
        
        # Lit 1
        lit = clauses_arr[idx]
        v = abs(lit)
        occs[cursor[v]] = c_shifted | (1 if lit > 0 else 0)
        cursor[v] += 1
        
        # Lit 2
        lit = clauses_arr[idx+1]
        v = abs(lit)
        occs[cursor[v]] = c_shifted | (1 if lit > 0 else 0)
        cursor[v] += 1
        
        # Lit 3
        lit = clauses_arr[idx+2]
        v = abs(lit)
        occs[cursor[v]] = c_shifted | (1 if lit > 0 else 0)
        cursor[v] += 1
        
    starts = array.array('i', starts)
    occs = array.array('i', occs)
    
    # 4. Initialize assignment using majority vote
    counts_pol = [0] * (num_vars + 1)
    for lit in clauses_arr:
        if lit > 0:
            counts_pol[lit] += 1
        else:
            counts_pol[-lit] -= 1
            
    # We use a bytearray for assignment for speed and native translation
    assignment = bytearray(num_vars + 1)
    for i in range(1, num_vars + 1):
        assignment[i] = 1 if counts_pol[i] >= 0 else 0
        
    # 5. Initialize satisfaction counts for each clause
    sat_count = array.array('b', [0] * num_clauses)
    unsat_list = []
    unsat_index = array.array('i', [-1] * num_clauses)
    
    for c in range(num_clauses):
        idx = 3 * c
        l1, l2, l3 = clauses_arr[idx], clauses_arr[idx+1], clauses_arr[idx+2]
        
        v1, v2, v3 = abs(l1), abs(l2), abs(l3)
        val1 = assignment[v1] if l1 > 0 else 1 - assignment[v1]
        val2 = assignment[v2] if l2 > 0 else 1 - assignment[v2]
        val3 = assignment[v3] if l3 > 0 else 1 - assignment[v3]
        
        cnt = val1 + val2 + val3
        sat_count[c] = cnt
        if cnt == 0:
            unsat_index[c] = len(unsat_list)
            unsat_list.append(c)
            
    # 6. WalkSAT Solver Loop
    max_steps = 10 * num_vars
    step = 0
    p_noise = 0.5
    
    # Cache local references
    local_randint = random.randint
    local_choice = random.choice
    local_random = random.random
    
    while unsat_list and step < max_steps:
        step += 1
        # Pick random unsatisfied clause
        c = unsat_list[local_randint(0, len(unsat_list) - 1)]
        
        idx = 3 * c
        v1 = abs(clauses_arr[idx])
        v2 = abs(clauses_arr[idx+1])
        v3 = abs(clauses_arr[idx+2])
        
        # Calculate break counts
        # Inlined get_break_cnt(v1)
        b1 = 0
        curr_val1 = assignment[v1]
        for idx1 in range(starts[v1], starts[v1+1]):
            packed = occs[idx1]
            if (packed & 1 == curr_val1) and sat_count[packed >> 1] == 1:
                b1 += 1
                
        # Inlined get_break_cnt(v2)
        b2 = 0
        curr_val2 = assignment[v2]
        for idx2 in range(starts[v2], starts[v2+1]):
            packed = occs[idx2]
            if (packed & 1 == curr_val2) and sat_count[packed >> 1] == 1:
                b2 += 1
                
        # Inlined get_break_cnt(v3)
        b3 = 0
        curr_val3 = assignment[v3]
        for idx3 in range(starts[v3], starts[v3+1]):
            packed = occs[idx3]
            if (packed & 1 == curr_val3) and sat_count[packed >> 1] == 1:
                b3 += 1
                
        # WalkSAT heuristic
        zero_breaks = []
        if b1 == 0: zero_breaks.append(v1)
        if b2 == 0: zero_breaks.append(v2)
        if b3 == 0: zero_breaks.append(v3)
        
        if zero_breaks:
            flip_v = local_choice(zero_breaks)
        else:
            if local_random() < p_noise:
                flip_v = local_choice((v1, v2, v3))
            else:
                min_b = min(b1, b2, b3)
                best_vars = []
                if b1 == min_b: best_vars.append(v1)
                if b2 == min_b: best_vars.append(v2)
                if b3 == min_b: best_vars.append(v3)
                flip_v = local_choice(best_vars)
                
        # Flip flip_v
        new_val = 1 - assignment[flip_v]
        assignment[flip_v] = new_val
        
        # Update sat_count and unsatisfied list/index
        start_idx = starts[flip_v]
        end_idx = starts[flip_v+1]
        for idx_occ in range(start_idx, end_idx):
            packed = occs[idx_occ]
            clause_idx = packed >> 1
            is_pos = packed & 1
            is_true_now = (is_pos == new_val)
            
            old_sc = sat_count[clause_idx]
            if is_true_now:
                sat_count[clause_idx] = old_sc + 1
                if old_sc == 0:
                    pos = unsat_index[clause_idx]
                    last_c = unsat_list[-1]
                    unsat_list[pos] = last_c
                    unsat_index[last_c] = pos
                    unsat_list.pop()
                    unsat_index[clause_idx] = -1
            else:
                sat_count[clause_idx] = old_sc - 1
                if old_sc == 1:
                    unsat_index[clause_idx] = len(unsat_list)
                    unsat_list.append(clause_idx)
                    
    # Output the result
    sys.stdout.write("SAT\n")
    # Output assignment space-separated, converting efficiently using translate
    trans = bytes.maketrans(b'\x00\x01', b'01')
    out = bytearray(2 * num_vars)
    out[1::2] = b' ' * num_vars
    out[0::2] = assignment[1:].translate(trans)
    out[-1] = ord('\n')
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve_sat()

You are writing C# code to solve the Quadratic Assignment Problem (QAP), which is NP-hard.

**Input format (stdin):**
```

...

```
All values are integers. Matrices are N×N. Indices are 0-based in the output.

**Output format (stdout):**
```
total_cost
p0 p1 p2 ... p(N-1)
```
Where p is a permutation of 0..N-1 and p[i] is the location assigned to facility i.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Output a valid permutation.
3. Handle N from very small up to ~2000 within 5 minutes.
4. Heuristics are acceptable for large N; lower cost scores higher.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;

public class Program
{
    // Fast Scanner class to optimize reading large inputs (N up to 2000) from stdin.
    public class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly TextReader _reader;
        private readonly char[] _buffer = new char[65536];
        private int _bufferLength = 0;
        private int _bufferPointer = 0;

        public FastScanner()
        {
            _reader = Console.In;
        }

        private bool ReadNextBuffer()
        {
            _bufferLength = _reader.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
            _bufferPointer = 0;
            return _bufferLength > 0;
        }

        private int ReadChar()
        {
            if (_bufferPointer >= _bufferLength)
            {
                if (!ReadNextBuffer()) return -1;
            }
            return _buffer[_bufferPointer++];
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c = ReadChar();
            while (c != -1 && c <= 32)
            {
                c = ReadChar();
            }
            if (c == -1) return -1;

            bool neg = false;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                neg = true;
                c = ReadChar();
            }

            int res = 0;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
            {
                res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = ReadChar();
            }

            return neg ? -res : res;
        }
    }

    // Fast Xorshift Pseudo-Random Number Generator to optimize SA transitions.
    public class FastRandom
    {
        private uint _x;
        public FastRandom(uint seed)
        {
            _x = seed != 0 ? seed : 5489U;
        }
        public int Next(int max)
        {
            _x ^= _x << 13;
            _x ^= _x >> 17;
            _x ^= _x << 5;
            return (int)(_x % (uint)max);
        }
        public double NextDouble()
        {
            _x ^= _x << 13;
            _x ^= _x >> 17;
            _x ^= _x << 5;
            return (double)_x / uint.MaxValue;
        }
    }

    public static void Main()
    {
        // Enforce culture invariant parsing/formatting
        System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture = System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

        FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner();
        int N = scanner.NextInt();
        if (N <= 0) return;

        int[] flow = new int[N * N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++)
        {
            flow[i] = scanner.NextInt();
        }

        int[] dist = new int[N * N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++)
        {
            dist[i] = scanner.NextInt();
        }

        Stopwatch stopwatch = new Stopwatch();
        stopwatch.Start();

        // Check if both flow and dist matrices are symmetric.
        // If they are symmetric, the swap delta evaluation runs twice as fast.
        bool isSymmetric = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < N; j++)
            {
                if (flow[i * N + j] != flow[j * N + i] || dist[i * N + j] != dist[j * N + i])
                {
                    isSymmetric = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!isSymmetric) break;
        }

        int[] bestP;
        long bestCost;

        if (N <= 10)
        {
            SolveExact(N, flow, dist, out bestP, out bestCost);
        }
        else
        {
            SolveHeuristic(N, flow, dist, isSymmetric, stopwatch, out bestP, out bestCost);
        }

        // Output results to stdout
        Console.WriteLine(bestCost);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            Console.Write(bestP[i] + (i == N - 1 ? "" : " "));
        }
        Console.WriteLine();
    }

    // Dynamic budget allocation based on the instance size N to prevent global timeouts
    // while ensuring maximum exploration time for larger, harder instances.
    private static double GetBudgetMs(int N)
    {
        if (N <= 10) return 100;
        if (N <= 20) return 500;
        if (N <= 50) return 2000;
        if (N <= 100) return 5000;
        if (N <= 200) return 15000;
        if (N <= 500) return 45000;
        if (N <= 1000) return 90000;
        return 280000; // Under 5 minutes (300 seconds) for N up to 2000
    }

    // Exact Backtracking DFS Solver for very small N (N <= 10).
    private static void SolveExact(int N, int[] flow, int[] dist, out int[] bestP, out long bestCost)
    {
        bestP = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) bestP[i] = i;
        bestCost = long.MaxValue;

        int[] currentP = new int[N];
        bool[] used = new bool[N];
        SolveExactDfs(0, N, flow, dist, currentP, used, ref bestCost, bestP);
    }

    private static void SolveExactDfs(int step, int N, int[] flow, int[] dist, int[] currentP, bool[] used, ref long bestCost, int[] bestP)
    {
        if (step == N)
        {
            long cost = ComputeCost(currentP, flow, dist, N);
            if (cost < bestCost)
            {
                bestCost = cost;
                Array.Copy(currentP, bestP, N);
            }
            return;
        }

        for (int v = 0; v < N; v++)
        {
            if (!used[v])
            {
                used[v] = true;
                currentP[step] = v;
                SolveExactDfs(step + 1, N, flow, dist, currentP, used, ref bestCost, bestP);
                used[v] = false;
            }
        }
    }

    // Multi-Start Simulated Annealing (MSSA) Metaheuristic Solver for N > 10.
    private static void SolveHeuristic(int N, int[] flow, int[] dist, bool isSymmetric, Stopwatch stopwatch, out int[] bestOverallP, out long bestOverallCost)
    {
        FastRandom rand = new FastRandom(1337);

        // Get initial permutation using sorting-based flow-distance alignment heuristic.
        int[] fdP = GetFdSortedPermutation(N, flow, dist);
        
        bestOverallP = new int[N];
        Array.Copy(fdP, bestOverallP, N);
        bestOverallCost = ComputeCost(fdP, flow, dist, N);

        double totalBudgetMs = GetBudgetMs(N); 
        int startId = 1;

        while (true)
        {
            double elapsed = stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;
            double remaining = totalBudgetMs - elapsed;
            if (remaining < 500) break; // Terminate if insufficient time remains

            // Allocate time for this start using a geometric progression.
            double durationMs = Math.Max(200, remaining * 0.35);

            int[] startP;
            double tempScale;
            if (startId == 1)
            {
                startP = fdP;
                tempScale = 0.05; // Low temperature start to refine F-D constructive solution
            }
            else if (startId % 2 == 1)
            {
                startP = GetRandomizedFdPermutation(fdP, N, rand);
                tempScale = 0.3;  // Moderate temperature start for perturbation of F-D solution
            }
            else
            {
                startP = GetRandomPermutation(N, rand);
                tempScale = 0.5;  // Higher temperature start for global exploration from random state
            }

            double initialT = EstimateT0(N, startP, flow, dist, isSymmetric, rand) * tempScale;
            double finalT = initialT * 0.00001;
            if (finalT < 1e-6) finalT = 1e-6;

            RunSimulatedAnnealing(N, flow, dist, isSymmetric, startP, initialT, finalT, durationMs, rand, bestOverallP, ref bestOverallCost, stopwatch);

            startId++;
        }

        // Final local search polish on the best overall found permutation.
        PolishSolution(bestOverallP, ref bestOverallCost, flow, dist, N, isSymmetric, totalBudgetMs, stopwatch, rand);
    }

    // Constructive Heuristic: aligns high flow facilities to central locations with small distances.
    private static int[] GetFdSortedPermutation(int N, int[] flow, int[] dist)
    {
        long[] flowSums = new long[N];
        int[] facilities = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            facilities[i] = i;
            long sum = 0;
            int offset = i * N;
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) sum += flow[offset + j];
            flowSums[i] = sum;
        }

        long[] negatedFlowSums = new long[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) negatedFlowSums[i] = -flowSums[i];
        Array.Sort(negatedFlowSums, facilities);

        long[] distSums = new long[N];
        int[] locations = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            locations[i] = i;
            long sum = 0;
            int offset = i * N;
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) sum += dist[offset + j];
            distSums[i] = sum;
        }
        Array.Sort(distSums, locations);

        int[] p = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            p[facilities[i]] = locations[i];
        }
        return p;
    }

    private static int[] GetRandomizedFdPermutation(int[] fdP, int N, FastRandom rand)
    {
        int[] p = new int[N];
        Array.Copy(fdP, p, N);
        int swaps = Math.Max(1, N * 5 / 100);
        for (int s = 0; s < swaps; s++)
        {
            int u = rand.Next(N);
            int v = rand.Next(N);
            while (u == v) v = rand.Next(N);
            int tmp = p[u];
            p[u] = p[v];
            p[v] = tmp;
        }
        return p;
    }

    private static int[] GetRandomPermutation(int N, FastRandom rand)
    {
        int[] p = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) p[i] = i;
        for (int i = N - 1; i > 0; i--)
        {
            int j = rand.Next(i + 1);
            int tmp = p[i];
            p[i] = p[j];
            p[j] = tmp;
        }
        return p;
    }

    // Estimate the starting temperature T0 based on average positive delta values of random moves.
    private static double EstimateT0(int N, int[] p, int[] flow, int[] dist, bool isSymmetric, FastRandom rand)
    {
        long sumPosDelta = 0;
        int countPosDelta = 0;
        int samples = Math.Min(200, N * (N - 1) / 2);
        if (samples < 10) samples = 10;

        for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++)
        {
            int u = rand.Next(N);
            int v = rand.Next(N);
            while (u == v) v = rand.Next(N);

            long delta = EvaluateSwap(u, v, p, flow, dist, N, isSymmetric);
            if (delta > 0)
            {
                sumPosDelta += delta;
                countPosDelta++;
            }
        }

        if (countPosDelta > 0)
        {
            return (double)sumPosDelta / countPosDelta;
        }
        return 1.0;
    }

    // Core Simulated Annealing search loop.
    private static void RunSimulatedAnnealing(
        int N, int[] flow, int[] dist, bool isSymmetric,
        int[] initialP, double initialT, double finalT, double durationMs,
        FastRandom rand, int[] bestOverallP, ref long bestOverallCost,
        Stopwatch stopwatch)
    {
        int[] currentP = new int[N];
        Array.Copy(initialP, currentP, N);

        long currentCost = ComputeCost(currentP, flow, dist, N);

        int[] bestStartP = new int[N];
        Array.Copy(currentP, bestStartP, N);
        long bestStartCost = currentCost;

        double startTime = stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;
        double endTime = startTime + durationMs;

        double T = initialT;
        int iter = 0;

        while (true)
        {
            iter++;
            if (iter % 2000 == 0) // Periodically update temperature and check timeout
            {
                double curTime = stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;
                if (curTime >= endTime) break;

                double progress = (curTime - startTime) / durationMs;
                if (progress > 1.0) progress = 1.0;

                T = initialT * Math.Pow(finalT / initialT, progress);
            }

            int u = rand.Next(N);
            int v = rand.Next(N);
            while (u == v) v = rand.Next(N);

            long delta = EvaluateSwap(u, v, currentP, flow, dist, N, isSymmetric);

            if (delta <= 0)
            {
                int tmp = currentP[u];
                currentP[u] = currentP[v];
                currentP[v] = tmp;
                currentCost += delta;

                if (currentCost < bestStartCost)
                {
                    bestStartCost = currentCost;
                    Array.Copy(currentP, bestStartP, N);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                double pAccept = Math.Exp(-delta / T);
                if (rand.NextDouble() < pAccept)
                {
                    int tmp = currentP[u];
                    currentP[u] = currentP[v];
                    currentP[v] = tmp;
                    currentCost += delta;
                }
            }
        }

        if (bestStartCost < bestOverallCost)
        {
            bestOverallCost = bestStartCost;
            Array.Copy(bestStartP, bestOverallP, N);
        }
    }

    // Local improvement polishing to land in the exact local minimum basin.
    private static void PolishSolution(
        int[] p, ref long cost, int[] flow, int[] dist, int N, bool isSymmetric,
        double timeLimitMs, Stopwatch stopwatch, FastRandom rand)
    {
        if (N <= 300)
        {
            bool improved = true;
            for (int pass = 0; pass < 10 && improved; pass++)
            {
                improved = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
                {
                    if (stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds >= timeLimitMs) return;
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < N; j++)
                    {
                        long delta = EvaluateSwap(i, j, p, flow, dist, N, isSymmetric);
                        if (delta < 0)
                        {
                            int tmp = p[i];
                            p[i] = p[j];
                            p[j] = tmp;
                            cost += delta;
                            improved = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            int maxFailures = 5 * N;
            int failures = 0;
            while (failures < maxFailures)
            {
                if (stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds >= timeLimitMs) return;

                int u = rand.Next(N);
                int v = rand.Next(N);
                while (u == v) v = rand.Next(N);

                long delta = EvaluateSwap(u, v, p, flow, dist, N, isSymmetric);
                if (delta < 0)
                {
                    int tmp = p[u];
                    p[u] = p[v];
                    p[v] = tmp;
                    cost += delta;
                    failures = 0;
                }
                else
                {
                    failures++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Compute QAP cost from scratch.
    private static long ComputeCost(int[] p, int[] flow, int[] dist, int N)
    {
        long cost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            int pi = p[i];
            int flow_i_offset = i * N;
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
            {
                cost += (long)flow[flow_i_offset + j] * dist[pi * N + p[j]];
            }
        }
        return cost;
    }

    // Highly optimized O(N) evaluation of a 2-opt swap delta.
    private static long EvaluateSwap(int u, int v, int[] p, int[] flow, int[] dist, int N, bool isSymmetric)
    {
        if (u > v) { int tmp = u; u = v; v = tmp; }

        int pu = p[u];
        int pv = p[v];
        long delta = 0;

        int flow_u_offset = u * N;
        int flow_v_offset = v * N;
        int dist_pu_offset = pu * N;
        int dist_pv_offset = pv * N;

        if (isSymmetric)
        {
            // Symmetric optimized loop (about twice as fast)
            for (int k = 0; k < u; k++)
            {
                int pk = p[k];
                delta += (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + k] - flow[flow_v_offset + k]) * (dist[dist_pv_offset + pk] - dist[dist_pu_offset + pk]);
            }
            for (int k = u + 1; k < v; k++)
            {
                int pk = p[k];
                delta += (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + k] - flow[flow_v_offset + k]) * (dist[dist_pv_offset + pk] - dist[dist_pu_offset + pk]);
            }
            for (int k = v + 1; k < N; k++)
            {
                int pk = p[k];
                delta += (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + k] - flow[flow_v_offset + k]) * (dist[dist_pv_offset + pk] - dist[dist_pu_offset + pk]);
            }

            delta *= 2;
            delta += (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + u] - flow[flow_v_offset + v]) * (dist[pv * N + pv] - dist[pu * N + pu]);
        }
        else
        {
            // General asymmetric loop
            int flow_k_offset = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < u; k++)
            {
                int pk = p[k];
                int dist_pk_offset = pk * N;
                delta += (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + k] - flow[flow_v_offset + k]) * (dist[dist_pv_offset + pk] - dist[dist_pu_offset + pk])
                       + (long)(flow[flow_k_offset + u] - flow[flow_k_offset + v]) * (dist[dist_pk_offset + pv] - dist[dist_pk_offset + pu]);
                flow_k_offset += N;
            }
            flow_k_offset = (u + 1) * N;
            for (int k = u + 1; k < v; k++)
            {
                int pk = p[k];
                int dist_pk_offset = pk * N;
                delta += (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + k] - flow[flow_v_offset + k]) * (dist[dist_pv_offset + pk] - dist[dist_pu_offset + pk])
                       + (long)(flow[flow_k_offset + u] - flow[flow_k_offset + v]) * (dist[dist_pk_offset + pv] - dist[dist_pk_offset + pu]);
                flow_k_offset += N;
            }
            flow_k_offset = (v + 1) * N;
            for (int k = v + 1; k < N; k++)
            {
                int pk = p[k];
                int dist_pk_offset = pk * N;
                delta += (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + k] - flow[flow_v_offset + k]) * (dist[dist_pv_offset + pk] - dist[dist_pu_offset + pk])
                       + (long)(flow[flow_k_offset + u] - flow[flow_k_offset + v]) * (dist[dist_pk_offset + pv] - dist[dist_pk_offset + pu]);
                flow_k_offset += N;
            }

            delta += (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + u] - flow[flow_v_offset + v]) * (dist[pv * N + pv] - dist[pu * N + pu])
                   + (long)(flow[flow_u_offset + v] - flow[flow_v_offset + u]) * (dist[pv * N + pu] - dist[pu * N + pv]);
        }

        return delta;
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Python code to solve the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP).

**Problem:**
You have a depot and N customers with coordinates and demands. You must create up to K vehicle
routes starting and ending at the depot. Each customer must be visited exactly once and the sum
of demands on any route must not exceed the vehicle capacity. Minimize total travel distance.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
N K CAPACITY
depot_x depot_y
x1 y1 demand1
x2 y2 demand2
...
xN yN demandN
```

**Output format (stdout):**
```
total_distance
num_routes
route_1
route_2
...
```
Each route line should list customer indices (0-based) in visit order.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Output valid routes that cover all customers exactly once.
3. Respect vehicle capacity on every route.
4. Heuristics are acceptable for large instances; shorter distance scores higher.

Write complete, runnable Python code.
 Prompt Changes:
Prompt parameters change between subpasses (increasing difficulty)

Plan delivery routes for a fleet of vehicles so that every customer is visited and the total distance travelled is minimised. Each vehicle has a capacity limit, so the AI must decide which customers go on which truck and in what order.

This is the Vehicle Routing Problem, a generalisation of the Travelling Salesman Problem. Subpasses increase the number of customers and vehicles. The baseline uses a simple nearest-neighbour heuristic.

import sys
import math

def calculate_distance(p1, p2):
    return math.sqrt((p1[0] - p2[0])**2 + (p1[1] - p2[1])**2)

def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    ptr = 0
    N = int(input_data[ptr])
    K = int(input_data[ptr+1])
    CAPACITY = int(input_data[ptr+2])
    ptr += 3
    
    depot = (float(input_data[ptr]), float(input_data[ptr+1]))
    ptr += 2
    
    customers = []
    for i in range(N):
        customers.append({
            'id': i,
            'pos': (float(input_data[ptr]), float(input_data[ptr+1])),
            'demand': int(input_data[ptr+2])
        })
        ptr += 3
        
    savings = []
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i + 1, N):
            dist_i0 = calculate_distance(customers[i]['pos'], depot)
            dist_0j = calculate_distance(depot, customers[j]['pos'])
            dist_ij = calculate_distance(customers[i]['pos'], customers[j]['pos'])
            s = dist_i0 + dist_0j - dist_ij
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
    
    routes = [[i] for i in range(N)]
    route_demands = [customers[i]['demand'] for i in range(N)]
    route_map = {i: i for i in range(N)}
    route_ends = {i: (i, i) for i in range(N)}
    
    for s, i, j in savings:
        r1 = route_map[i]
        r2 = route_map[j]
        
        if r1 == r2:
            continue
            
        if route_demands[r1] + route_demands[r2] > CAPACITY:
            continue
            
        start1, end1 = route_ends[r1]
        start2, end2 = route_ends[r2]
        
        merged = False
        if end1 == i and start2 == j:
            new_route = routes[r1] + routes[r2]
            new_ends = (start1, end2)
            merged = True
        elif end1 == i and end2 == j:
            new_route = routes[r1] + routes[r2][::-1]
            new_ends = (start1, start2)
            merged = True
        elif start1 == i and start2 == j:
            new_route = routes[r1][::-1] + routes[r2]
            new_ends = (end1, end2)
            merged = True
        elif start1 == i and end2 == j:
            new_route = routes[r2] + routes[r1]
            new_ends = (start2, end1)
            merged = True
            
        if merged:
            routes[r1] = new_route
            route_demands[r1] += route_demands[r2]
            route_ends[r1] = new_ends
            routes[r2] = []
            route_demands[r2] = 0
            for node in new_route:
                route_map[node] = r1
            
    final_routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    
    total_dist = 0
    for route in final_routes:
        total_dist += calculate_distance(depot, customers[route[0]]['pos'])
        for k in range(len(route) - 1):
            total_dist += calculate_distance(customers[route[k]]['pos'], customers[route[k+1]]['pos'])
        total_dist += calculate_distance(customers[route[-1]]['pos'], depot)
        
    print(f"{total_dist:.4f}")
    print(len(final_routes))
    for route in final_routes:
        print(" ".join(map(str, route)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();

    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(Ok(l)) => l,
        _ => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<usize> = first_line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 { return; }
    let num_vertices = parts[0];
    let num_edges = parts[1];

    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); num_vertices];
    for _ in 0..num_edges {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let edge: Vec<usize> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
            if edge.len() >= 2 {
                adj[edge[0]].push(edge[1]);
                adj[edge[1]].push(edge[0]);
            }
        }
    }

    let mut covered = vec![false; num_vertices];
    let mut dominating_set = Vec::new();
    let mut num_covered = 0;

    while num_covered < num_vertices {
        let mut best_v = None;
        let mut max_cover_count = 0;

        for v in 0..num_vertices {
            let mut cover_count = 0;
            if !covered[v] {
                cover_count += 1;
            }
            for &neighbor in &adj[v] {
                if !covered[neighbor] {
                    cover_count += 1;
                }
            }

            if cover_count > max_cover_count {
                max_cover_count = cover_count;
                best_v = Some(v);
            }
        }

        if let Some(v) = best_v {
            dominating_set.push(v);
            if !covered[v] {
                covered[v] = true;
                num_covered += 1;
            }
            for &neighbor in &adj[v] {
                if !covered[neighbor] {
                    covered[neighbor] = true;
                    num_covered += 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    println!("{}", dominating_set.len());
    let output: Vec<String> = dominating_set.iter().map(|v| v.to_string()).collect();
    println!("{}", output.join(" "));
}

This is NP-hard. The test uses planted instances with a known optimal answer for strict pass/fail grading. Subpasses increase the graph size.

Approach: The Maximum Independent Set problem is NP-hard. The provided C++ solution uses a backtracking algorithm with pruning (via a bitset for efficient set operations and a degree-based heuristic) to find the exact maximum independent set.

View C++ Code (1951 chars)
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <bitset>

using namespace std;

// Maximum number of vertices for the problem constraints.
// Using a bitset for the adjacency matrix and sets.
const int MAXN = 100;
bitset<MAXN> adj[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> best_set;
int max_k = 0;

void solve(bitset<MAXN> P, bitset<MAXN> current_set, int k) {
    if (P.none()) {
        if (k > max_k) {
            max_k = k;
            best_set = current_set;
        }
        return;
    }

    // Pruning: if current k + remaining possible vertices <= max_k, return.
    if (k + (int)P.count() <= max_k) {
        return;
    }

    // Heuristic: pick the vertex with the highest degree in the subgraph P.
    int v = -1;
    int max_degree = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        if (P.test(i)) {
            int degree = (int)(adj[i] & P).count();
            if (degree > max_degree) {
                max_degree = degree;
                v = i;
            }
        }
    }

    if (v == -1) return;

    // Branch 1: include v in the independent set
    bitset<MAXN> next_P = P & ~adj[v];
    next_P.reset(v);
    solve(next_P, current_set | bitset<MAXN>().set(v), k + 1);

    // Branch 2: exclude v
    P.reset(v);
    solve(P, current_set, k);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, m;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m)) return 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        if (u >= 0 && u < n && v >= 0 && v < n && u != v) {
            adj[u].set(v);
            adj[v].set(u);
        }
    }

    bitset<MAXN> P;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) P.set(i);

    solve(P, bitset<MAXN>(), 0);

    cout << max_k << "\n";
    bool first = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (best_set.test(i)) {
            if (!first) cout << " ";
            cout << i;
            first = false;
        }
    }
    cout << endl;

    return 0;
}
