class Graph
{
    public int N;
    public bool[] Present;
    public HashSet<int>[] In;
    public HashSet<int>[] Out;

    public Graph(int n)
    {
        N = n;
        Present = new bool[n];
        In = new HashSet<int>[n];
        Out = new HashSet<int>[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            In[i] = new HashSet<int>();
            Out[i] = new HashSet<int>();
        }
    }

    public Graph Clone()
    {
        Graph copy = new Graph(N);
        Array.Copy(Present, copy.Present, N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            if (Present[i])
            {
                copy.In[i] = new HashSet<int>(In[i]);
                copy.Out[i] = new HashSet<int>(Out[i]);
            }
        }
        return copy;
    }

    public void AddEdge(int u, int v)
    {
        if (u == v)
        {
            Out[u].Add(u);
            In[u].Add(u);
            return;
        }
        Out[u].Add(v);
        In[v].Add(u);
    }

    public void RemoveEdge(int u, int v)
    {
        Out[u].Remove(v);
        In[v].Remove(u);
    }

    public void RemoveVertex(int u)
    {
        if (!Present[u]) return;
        Present[u] = false;
        foreach (int v in Out[u])
        {
            if (v != u) In[v].Remove(u);
        }
        foreach (int v in In[u])
        {
            if (v != u) Out[v].Remove(u);
        }
        Out[u].Clear();
        In[u].Clear();
    }
}

class Preprocessor
{
    public Graph G;
    public List<int> Solution;
    private Queue<int> queue;
    private bool[] inQueue;

    public Preprocessor(Graph g, List<int> solution)
    {
        G = g;
        Solution = solution;
        queue = new Queue<int>();
        inQueue = new bool[G.N];
        for (int i = 0; i < G.N; i++)
        {
            if (G.Present[i])
            {
                queue.Enqueue(i);
                inQueue[i] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    public void Enqueue(int u)
    {
        if (G.Present[u] && !inQueue[u])
        {
            queue.Enqueue(u);
            inQueue[u] = true;
        }
    }

    public bool Run()
    {
        bool changed = false;
        while (queue.Count > 0)
        {
            int u = queue.Dequeue();
            inQueue[u] = false;

            if (!G.Present[u]) continue;

            // 1. LOOP rule
            if (G.Out[u].Contains(u))
            {
                Solution.Add(u);
                List<int> neighbors = new List<int>();
                foreach (int v in G.In[u]) if (v != u) neighbors.Add(v);
                foreach (int v in G.Out[u]) if (v != u) neighbors.Add(v);

                G.RemoveVertex(u);
                changed = true;

                foreach (int v in neighbors) Enqueue(v);
                continue;
            }

            // 2. IN0 / OUT0 rule
            if (G.In[u].Count == 0 || G.Out[u].Count == 0)
            {
                List<int> neighbors = new List<int>();
                foreach (int v in G.In[u]) neighbors.Add(v);
                foreach (int v in G.Out[u]) neighbors.Add(v);

                G.RemoveVertex(u);
                changed = true;

                foreach (int v in neighbors) Enqueue(v);
                continue;
            }

            // 3. IN1 rule
            if (G.In[u].Count == 1)
            {
                int p = -1;
                foreach (int val in G.In[u]) { p = val; break; }
                List<int> successors = new List<int>(G.Out[u]);
                G.RemoveVertex(u);
                changed = true;

                foreach (int w in successors)
                {
                    G.AddEdge(p, w);
                }

                Enqueue(p);
                foreach (int w in successors) Enqueue(w);
                continue;
            }

            // 4. OUT1 rule
            if (G.Out[u].Count == 1)
            {
                int s = -1;
                foreach (int val in G.Out[u]) { s = val; break; }
                List<int> predecessors = new List<int>(G.In[u]);
                G.RemoveVertex(u);
                changed = true;

                foreach (int p in predecessors)
                {
                    G.AddEdge(p, s);
                }

                Enqueue(s);
                foreach (int p in predecessors) Enqueue(p);
                continue;
            }
        }
        return changed;
    }
}

class SCC
{
    private readonly Graph G;
    private readonly int[] dfn;
    private readonly int[] low;
    private readonly bool[] inStack;
    private readonly int[] stack;
    private int stackTop;
    private int timer;
    public List<List<int>> Components;

    public SCC(Graph g)
    {
        G = g;
        dfn = new int[G.N];
        low = new int[G.N];
        inStack = new bool[G.N];
        stack = new int[G.N];
        for (int i = 0; i < dfn.Length; i++) dfn[i] = -1;
        Components = new List<List<int>>();
    }

    public void Run()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < G.N; i++)
        {
            if (G.Present[i] && dfn[i] == -1)
            {
                DFS(i);
            }
        }
    }

    private void DFS(int u)
    {
        dfn[u] = low[u] = timer++;
        stack[stackTop++] = u;
        inStack[u] = true;

        foreach (int v in G.Out[u])
        {
            if (!G.Present[v]) continue;
            if (dfn[v] == -1)
            {
                DFS(v);
                low[u] = Math.Min(low[u], low[v]);
            }
            else if (inStack[v])
            {
                low[u] = Math.Min(low[u], dfn[v]);
            }
        }

        if (low[u] == dfn[u])
        {
            List<int> component = new List<int>();
            while (true)
            {
                int v = stack[--stackTop];
                inStack[v] = false;
                component.Add(v);
                if (v == u) break;
            }
            Components.Add(component);
        }
    }
}

class FastScanner
{
    private readonly Stream stream;
    private readonly byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
    private int head, tail;

    public FastScanner()
    {
        stream = Console.OpenStandardInput();
    }

    private byte Read()
    {
        if (head >= tail)
        {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail <= 0) return 0;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }

    public int NextInt()
    {
        byte c = Read();
        while (c <= 32)
        {
            if (c == 0) return -1;
            c = Read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32)
        {
            if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
            {
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            }
            c = Read();
        }
        return res;
    }
}

This is a classic NP-complete problem. Each test instance has exactly one valid solution, so grading is strict pass/fail. Subpasses increase the universe and set sizes.

import random
import time
import sys

def solve_exact_cover_set(U, sets):
    S = len(sets)
    element_sets = [[] for _ in range(U)]
    for s_idx, s in enumerate(sets):
        for e in s:
            element_sets[e].append(s_idx)
            
    uncovered_elements = set(range(U))
    set_active = [True] * S
    element_counts = [len(element_sets[e]) for e in range(U)]
    solution = []
    calls = 0
    
    def backtrack():
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if not uncovered_elements:
            return True
            
        best_e = -1
        min_count = S + 1
        for e in uncovered_elements:
            count = element_counts[e]
            if count < min_count:
                min_count = count
                best_e = e
                if min_count == 0:
                    return False
                if min_count == 1:
                    break
                    
        if best_e == -1:
            return True
            
        candidates = [s for s in element_sets[best_e] if set_active[s]]
        for s in candidates:
            solution.append(s)
            
            deactivated = []
            for e in sets[s]:
                for s_prime in element_sets[e]:
                    if set_active[s_prime]:
                        set_active[s_prime] = False
                        deactivated.append(s_prime)
                        for elem in sets[s_prime]:
                            element_counts[elem] -= 1
                            
            for e in sets[s]:
                uncovered_elements.remove(e)
                
            if backtrack():
                return True
                
            for e in sets[s]:
                uncovered_elements.add(e)
                
            for s_prime in deactivated:
                set_active[s_prime] = True
                for elem in sets[s_prime]:
                    element_counts[elem] += 1
                    
            solution.pop()
            
        return False

    if backtrack():
        return sorted(solution), calls
    else:
        return None, calls

def solve_exact_cover_swap(U, sets):
    S = len(sets)
    element_sets = [[] for _ in range(U)]
    for s_idx, s in enumerate(sets):
        for e in s:
            element_sets[e].append(s_idx)
            
    uncovered_list = list(range(U))
    uncovered_pos = list(range(U))
    num_uncovered = U
    
    set_active = [True] * S
    element_counts = [len(element_sets[e]) for e in range(U)]
    solution = []
    calls = 0
    
    def backtrack(num_uncovered):
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if num_uncovered == 0:
            return True
            
        best_e = -1
        min_count = S + 1
        for i in range(num_uncovered):
            e = uncovered_list[i]
            count = element_counts[e]
            if count < min_count:
                min_count = count
                best_e = e
                if min_count == 0:
                    return False
                if min_count == 1:
                    break
                    
        if best_e == -1:
            return True
            
        candidates = [s for s in element_sets[best_e] if set_active[s]]
        for s in candidates:
            solution.append(s)
            
            deactivated = []
            for e in sets[s]:
                for s_prime in element_sets[e]:
                    if set_active[s_prime]:
                        set_active[s_prime] = False
                        deactivated.append(s_prime)
                        for elem in sets[s_prime]:
                            element_counts[elem] -= 1
                            
            for e in sets[s]:
                pos = uncovered_pos[e]
                num_uncovered -= 1
                last_el = uncovered_list[num_uncovered]
                uncovered_list[pos] = last_el
                uncovered_pos[last_el] = pos
                
            if backtrack(num_uncovered):
                return True
                
            for e in sets[s]:
                uncovered_list[num_uncovered] = e
                uncovered_pos[e] = num_uncovered
                num_uncovered += 1
                
            for s_prime in deactivated:
                set_active[s_prime] = True
                for elem in sets[s_prime]:
                    element_counts[elem] += 1
                    
            solution.pop()
            
        return False

    if backtrack(num_uncovered):
        return sorted(solution), calls
    else:
        return None, calls

def generate_planted_instance(U, S, density=0.1):
    elements = list(range(U))
    random.shuffle(elements)
    
    num_sol_sets = random.randint(max(1, U // 10), max(2, U // 2))
    sol_sets = [[] for _ in range(num_sol_sets)]
    for i, e in enumerate(elements):
        sol_sets[i % num_sol_sets].append(e)
        
    sol_sets = [s for s in sol_sets if s]
    num_sol_sets = len(sol_sets)
    
    other_sets = []
    remaining = S - num_sol_sets
    for _ in range(remaining):
        size = max(1, int(random.gauss(U * density, U * density * 0.5)))
        size = min(U, max(1, size))
        s = random.sample(range(U), size)
        other_sets.append(s)
        
    all_sets = sol_sets + other_sets
    indices = list(range(len(all_sets)))
    random.shuffle(indices)
    
    shuffled_sets = [all_sets[i] for i in indices]
    return shuffled_sets

def main():
    U = 200
    S = 1000
    print(f"Generating instance with U={U}, S={S}...")
    sets = generate_planted_instance(U, S, density=0.08)
    
    print("Running set-based algorithm...")
    t0 = time.time()
    sol_set, calls_set = solve_exact_cover_set(U, sets)
    t1 = time.time()
    time_set = t1 - t0
    print(f"Set-based: {time_set:.6f} seconds, {calls_set} calls")
    
    print("Running swap-based algorithm...")
    t0 = time.time()
    sol_swap, calls_swap = solve_exact_cover_swap(U, sets)
    t1 = time.time()
    time_swap = t1 - t0
    print(f"Swap-based: {time_swap:.6f} seconds, {calls_swap} calls")
    
    assert sol_set == sol_swap, f"Solutions differ! Set: {sol_set}, Swap: {sol_swap}"
    print("Solutions match!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

struct Lcg {
    state: u64,
}

impl Lcg {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self { state: if seed == 0 { 1 } else { seed } }
    }
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.state ^= self.state << 13;
        self.state ^= self.state >> 7;
        self.state ^= self.state << 17;
        self.state
    }
    fn next_range(&mut self, min: usize, max: usize) -> usize {
        let range = max - min;
        min + (self.next() as usize % range)
    }
    fn shuffle<T>(&mut self, slice: &mut [T]) {
        for i in (1..slice.len()).rev() {
            let j = self.next_range(0, i + 1);
            slice.swap(i, j);
        }
    }
}

fn run_kernighan_lin(n: usize, adj: &[Vec<usize>], matrix: &[Vec<bool>], seed: u64) -> (u32, Vec<usize>) {
    let mut rng = Lcg::new(seed);
    let mut best_cut = u32::MAX;
    let mut best_partition = Vec::new();

    // Run 30 random starts
    for _ in 0..30 {
        let mut vertices: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
        rng.shuffle(&mut vertices);
        let mut in_a = vec![false; n];
        for &v in &vertices[0..n/2] {
            in_a[v] = true;
        }

        let mut improved = true;
        while improved {
            improved = false;
            let mut d = vec![0i32; n];
            for i in 0..n {
                let mut ext = 0;
                let mut int = 0;
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if in_a[neighbor] == in_a[i] {
                        int += 1;
                    } else {
                        ext += 1;
                    }
                }
                d[i] = ext - int;
            }

            let mut locked = vec![false; n];
            let mut swaps = Vec::new();
            let mut temp_in_a = in_a.clone();
            let mut temp_d = d.clone();

            for _ in 0..(n / 2) {
                let mut max_gain = i32::MIN;
                let mut best_a = 0;
                let mut best_b = 0;
                let mut found = false;

                for a in 0..n {
                    if temp_in_a[a] && !locked[a] {
                        for b in 0..n {
                            if !temp_in_a[b] && !locked[b] {
                                let w = if matrix[a][b] { 1 } else { 0 };
                                let gain = temp_d[a] + temp_d[b] - 2 * w;
                                if gain > max_gain {
                                    max_gain = gain;
                                    best_a = a;
                                    best_b = b;
                                    found = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if !found {
                    break;
                }

                locked[best_a] = true;
                locked[best_b] = true;
                temp_in_a[best_a] = false;
                temp_in_a[best_b] = true;
                swaps.push((best_a, best_b, max_gain));

                for i in 0..n {
                    if !locked[i] {
                        let w_a = if matrix[i][best_a] { 1 } else { 0 };
                        let w_b = if matrix[i][best_b] { 1 } else { 0 };
                        if temp_in_a[i] {
                            temp_d[i] += 2 * w_a - 2 * w_b;
                        } else {
                            temp_d[i] += 2 * w_b - 2 * w_a;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            let mut cum_gain = 0;
            let mut max_cum_gain = 0;
            let mut best_k = 0;
            for (i, &(_, _, gain)) in swaps.iter().enumerate() {
                cum_gain += gain;
                if cum_gain > max_cum_gain {
                    max_cum_gain = cum_gain;
                    best_k = i + 1;
                }
            }

            if max_cum_gain > 0 {
                for i in 0..best_k {
                    let (a, b, _) = swaps[i];
                    in_a.swap(a, b);
                }
                improved = true;
            }
        }

        let mut cut = 0;
        for i in 0..n {
            if in_a[i] {
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if !in_a[neighbor] {
                        cut += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if cut < best_cut {
            best_cut = cut;
            best_partition = (0..n).filter(|&i| in_a[i]).collect();
        }
    }

    (best_cut, best_partition)
}

struct Solver {
    n: usize,
    ordered_adj: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    order: Vec<usize>,
    assignment: Vec<u8>,
    d_a: Vec<u32>,
    d_b: Vec<u32>,
    best_cut: u32,
    best_partition: Vec<usize>,
    p_a: Vec<u32>,
    p_b: Vec<u32>,
}

impl Solver {
    fn new(n: usize, adj: Vec<Vec<usize>>, initial_cut: u32, initial_partition: Vec<usize>) -> Self {
        let mut order = Vec::with_capacity(n);
        let mut inv_order = vec![0; n];
        let mut visited = vec![false; n];

        order.push(0);
        visited[0] = true;
        let mut conn = vec![0; n];
        for &v in &adj[0] {
            conn[v] += 1;
        }

        for _ in 1..n {
            let mut best_v = None;
            let mut max_conn = -1;
            for v in 0..n {
                if !visited[v] {
                    if conn[v] as i32 > max_conn {
                        max_conn = conn[v] as i32;
                        best_v = Some(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            let u = best_v.unwrap();
            visited[u] = true;
            order.push(u);
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if !visited[v] {
                    conn[v] += 1;
                }
            }
        }

        for i in 0..n {
            inv_order[order[i]] = i;
        }

        let mut ordered_adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
        for i in 0..n {
            let u = order[i];
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                ordered_adj[i].push(inv_order[v]);
            }
        }

        let mut assignment = vec![2; n];
        assignment[0] = 0;

        let mut d_a = vec![0; n];
        for &v_pos in &ordered_adj[0] {
            if v_pos > 0 {
                d_a[v_pos] += 1;
            }
        }

        Self {
            n,
            ordered_adj,
            order,
            assignment,
            d_a,
            d_b: vec![0; n],
            best_cut: initial_cut,
            best_partition: initial_partition,
            p_a: Vec::with_capacity(n),
            p_b: Vec::with_capacity(n),
        }
    }

    fn check_bound(&mut self, next_k: usize, cut_so_far: u32, size_a: usize, size_b: usize) -> bool {
        let a_rem = self.n / 2 - size_a;
        let b_rem = self.n / 2 - size_b;

        let mut simple_sum = 0;
        for j in next_k..self.n {
            simple_sum += std::cmp::min(self.d_a[j], self.d_b[j]);
        }

        if cut_so_far + simple_sum >= self.best_cut {
            return false;
        }

        self.p_a.clear();
        self.p_b.clear();
        let mut base_sum = 0;

        for j in next_k..self.n {
            let da = self.d_a[j];
            let db = self.d_b[j];
            if da >= db {
                base_sum += db;
                self.p_a.push(da - db);
            } else {
                base_sum += da;
                self.p_b.push(db - da);
            }
        }

        if self.p_a.len() > a_rem {
            self.p_a.sort_unstable();
            let needed = self.p_a.len() - a_rem;
            for i in 0..needed {
                base_sum += self.p_a[i];
            }
        } else if self.p_b.len() > b_rem {
            self.p_b.sort_unstable();
            let needed = self.p_b.len() - b_rem;
            for i in 0..needed {
                base_sum += self.p_b[i];
            }
        }

        cut_so_far + base_sum < self.best_cut
    }

    fn dfs(&mut self, k: usize, cut_so_far: u32, size_a: usize, size_b: usize) {
        if k == self.n {
            if cut_so_far < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = cut_so_far;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if self.assignment[i] == 0 {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        let a_rem = self.n / 2 - size_a;
        let b_rem = self.n / 2 - size_b;

        if a_rem == 0 {
            let mut final_cut = cut_so_far;
            for j in k..self.n {
                final_cut += self.d_a[j];
            }
            if final_cut < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = final_cut;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if i < k && self.assignment[i] == 0 {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        if b_rem == 0 {
            let mut final_cut = cut_so_far;
            for j in k..self.n {
                final_cut += self.d_b[j];
            }
            if final_cut < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = final_cut;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if (i < k && self.assignment[i] == 0) || i >= k {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        let prefer_a = self.d_a[k] >= self.d_b[k];

        if prefer_a {
            if size_a < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_b[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 0;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if size_b < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_a[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 1;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            if size_b < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_a[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 1;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if size_a < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_b[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 0;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();

    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(Ok(l)) => l,
        _ => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<&str> = first_line.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    let n: usize = parts[0].parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = parts[1].parse().unwrap();

    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut matrix = vec![vec![false; n]; n];

    let mut edge_count = 0;
    while edge_count < m {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let pts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
            if pts.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            if pts.len() >= 2 {
                let u: usize = pts[0].parse().unwrap();
                let v: usize = pts[1].parse().unwrap();
                if u < n && v < n && u != v {
                    if !matrix[u][v] {
                        matrix[u][v] = true;
                        matrix[v][u] = true;
                        adj[u].push(v);
                        adj[v].push(u);
                    }
                }
            }
            edge_count += 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    if n == 0 {
        println!("0");
        println!();
        return;
    }

    if n % 2 != 0 {
        panic!("n must be even");
    }

    // Run Kernighan-Lin heuristic to get an initial upper bound
    let (kl_cut, kl_part) = run_kernighan_lin(n, &adj, &matrix, 42);

    // Run exact Branch & Bound solver to find and prove the optimal minimum cut bisection
    let mut solver = Solver::new(n, adj, kl_cut, kl_part);
    if solver.n > 1 {
        solver.dfs(1, 0, 1, 0);
    }

    println!("{}", solver.best_cut);
    let mut part_a = solver.best_partition.clone();
    part_a.sort_unstable();
    for (i, &v) in part_a.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            print!(" ");
        }
        print!("{}", v);
    }
    println!();
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

struct Lcg {
    state: u64,
}

impl Lcg {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self { state: if seed == 0 { 1 } else { seed } }
    }
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.state ^= self.state << 13;
        self.state ^= self.state >> 7;
        self.state ^= self.state << 17;
        self.state
    }
    fn next_range(&mut self, min: usize, max: usize) -> usize {
        let range = max - min;
        min + (self.next() as usize % range)
    }
    fn shuffle<T>(&mut self, slice: &mut [T]) {
        for i in (1..slice.len()).rev() {
            let j = self.next_range(0, i + 1);
            slice.swap(i, j);
        }
    }
}

fn run_kernighan_lin(n: usize, adj: &[Vec<usize>], matrix: &[Vec<bool>], seed: u64) -> (u32, Vec<usize>) {
    let mut rng = Lcg::new(seed);
    let mut best_cut = u32::MAX;
    let mut best_partition = Vec::new();

    // Run 30 random starts
    for _ in 0..30 {
        let mut vertices: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
        rng.shuffle(&mut vertices);
        let mut in_a = vec![false; n];
        for &v in &vertices[0..n/2] {
            in_a[v] = true;
        }

        let mut improved = true;
        while improved {
            improved = false;
            let mut d = vec![0i32; n];
            for i in 0..n {
                let mut ext = 0;
                let mut int = 0;
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if in_a[neighbor] == in_a[i] {
                        int += 1;
                    } else {
                        ext += 1;
                    }
                }
                d[i] = ext - int;
            }

            let mut locked = vec![false; n];
            let mut swaps = Vec::new();
            let mut temp_in_a = in_a.clone();
            let mut temp_d = d.clone();

            for _ in 0..(n / 2) {
                let mut max_gain = i32::MIN;
                let mut best_a = 0;
                let mut best_b = 0;
                let mut found = false;

                for a in 0..n {
                    if temp_in_a[a] && !locked[a] {
                        for b in 0..n {
                            if !temp_in_a[b] && !locked[b] {
                                let w = if matrix[a][b] { 1 } else { 0 };
                                let gain = temp_d[a] + temp_d[b] - 2 * w;
                                if gain > max_gain {
                                    max_gain = gain;
                                    best_a = a;
                                    best_b = b;
                                    found = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if !found {
                    break;
                }

                locked[best_a] = true;
                locked[best_b] = true;
                temp_in_a[best_a] = false;
                temp_in_a[best_b] = true;
                swaps.push((best_a, best_b, max_gain));

                for i in 0..n {
                    if !locked[i] {
                        let w_a = if matrix[i][best_a] { 1 } else { 0 };
                        let w_b = if matrix[i][best_b] { 1 } else { 0 };
                        if temp_in_a[i] {
                            temp_d[i] += 2 * w_a - 2 * w_b;
                        } else {
                            temp_d[i] += 2 * w_b - 2 * w_a;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            let mut cum_gain = 0;
            let mut max_cum_gain = 0;
            let mut best_k = 0;
            for (i, &(_, _, gain)) in swaps.iter().enumerate() {
                cum_gain += gain;
                if cum_gain > max_cum_gain {
                    max_cum_gain = cum_gain;
                    best_k = i + 1;
                }
            }

            if max_cum_gain > 0 {
                for i in 0..best_k {
                    let (a, b, _) = swaps[i];
                    in_a.swap(a, b);
                }
                improved = true;
            }
        }

        let mut cut = 0;
        for i in 0..n {
            if in_a[i] {
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if !in_a[neighbor] {
                        cut += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if cut < best_cut {
            best_cut = cut;
            best_partition = (0..n).filter(|&i| in_a[i]).collect();
        }
    }

    (best_cut, best_partition)
}

            for i in 0..needed {

            }

    let n: usize = parts[0].parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = parts[1].parse().unwrap();

    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut matrix = vec![vec![false; n]; n];

    let mut edge_count = 0;
    while edge_count < m {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let pts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
            if pts.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            if pts.len() >= 2 {
                let u: usize = pts[0].parse().unwrap();
                let v: usize = pts[1].parse().unwrap();
                if u < n && v < n && u != v {
                    if !matrix[u][v] {
                        matrix[u][v] = true;
                        matrix[v][u] = true;
                        adj[u].push(v);
                        adj[v].push(u);
                    }

        } else {

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

struct Lcg {
    state: u64,
}

impl Lcg {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self { state: if seed == 0 { 1 } else { seed } }
    }
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.state ^= self.state << 13;
        self.state ^= self.state >> 7;
        self.state ^= self.state << 17;
        self.state
    }
    fn next_range(&mut self, min: usize, max: usize) -> usize {
        let range = max - min;
        min + (self.next() as usize % range)
    }
    fn shuffle<T>(&mut self, slice: &mut [T]) {
        for i in (1..slice.len()).rev() {
            let j = self.next_range(0, i + 1);
            slice.swap(i, j);
        }
    }
}

fn run_kernighan_lin(n: usize, adj: &[Vec<usize>], matrix: &[Vec<bool>], seed: u64) -> (u32, Vec<usize>) {
    let mut rng = Lcg::new(seed);
    let mut best_cut = u32::MAX;
    let mut best_partition = Vec::new();

    // Run 30 random starts
    for _ in 0..30 {
        let mut vertices: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
        rng.shuffle(&mut vertices);
        let mut in_a = vec![false; n];
        for &v in &vertices[0..n/2] {
            in_a[v] = true;
        }

        let mut improved = true;
        while improved {
            improved = false;
            let mut d = vec![0i32; n];
            for i in 0..n {
                let mut ext = 0;
                let mut int = 0;
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if in_a[neighbor] == in_a[i] {
                        int += 1;
                    } else {
                        ext += 1;
                    }
                }
                d[i] = ext - int;
            }

            let mut locked = vec![false; n];
            let mut swaps = Vec::new();
            let mut temp_in_a = in_a.clone();
            let mut temp_d = d.clone();

            for _ in 0..(n / 2) {
                let mut max_gain = i32::MIN;
                let mut best_a = 0;
                let mut best_b = 0;
                let mut found = false;

                for a in 0..n {
                    if temp_in_a[a] && !locked[a] {
                        for b in 0..n {
                            if !temp_in_a[b] && !locked[b] {
                                let w = if matrix[a][b] { 1 } else { 0 };
                                let gain = temp_d[a] + temp_d[b] - 2 * w;
                                if gain > max_gain {
                                    max_gain = gain;
                                    best_a = a;
                                    best_b = b;
                                    found = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if !found {
                    break;
                }

                locked[best_a] = true;
                locked[best_b] = true;
                temp_in_a[best_a] = false;
                temp_in_a[best_b] = true;
                swaps.push((best_a, best_b, max_gain));

                for i in 0..n {
                    if !locked[i] {
                        let w_a = if matrix[i][best_a] { 1 } else { 0 };
                        let w_b = if matrix[i][best_b] { 1 } else { 0 };
                        if temp_in_a[i] {
                            temp_d[i] += 2 * w_a - 2 * w_b;
                        } else {
                            temp_d[i] += 2 * w_b - 2 * w_a;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            let mut cum_gain = 0;
            let mut max_cum_gain = 0;
            let mut best_k = 0;
            for (i, &(_, _, gain)) in swaps.iter().enumerate() {
                cum_gain += gain;
                if cum_gain > max_cum_gain {
                    max_cum_gain = cum_gain;
                    best_k = i + 1;
                }
            }

            if max_cum_gain > 0 {
                for i in 0..best_k {
                    let (a, b, _) = swaps[i];
                    in_a.swap(a, b);
                }
                improved = true;
            }
        }

        let mut cut = 0;
        for i in 0..n {
            if in_a[i] {
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if !in_a[neighbor] {
                        cut += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if cut < best_cut {
            best_cut = cut;
            best_partition = (0..n).filter(|&i| in_a[i]).collect();
        }
    }

    (best_cut, best_partition)
}

struct Solver {
    n: usize,
    ordered_adj: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    order: Vec<usize>,
    assignment: Vec<u8>,
    d_a: Vec<u32>,
    d_b: Vec<u32>,
    best_cut: u32,
    best_partition: Vec<usize>,
    p_a: Vec<u32>,
    p_b: Vec<u32>,
}

impl Solver {
    fn new(n: usize, adj: Vec<Vec<usize>>, initial_cut: u32, initial_partition: Vec<usize>) -> Self {
        let mut order = Vec::with_capacity(n);
        let mut inv_order = vec![0; n];
        let mut visited = vec![false; n];

        order.push(0);
        visited[0] = true;
        let mut conn = vec![0; n];
        for &v in &adj[0] {
            conn[v] += 1;
        }

        for _ in 1..n {
            let mut best_v = None;
            let mut max_conn = -1;
            for v in 0..n {
                if !visited[v] {
                    if conn[v] as i32 > max_conn {
                        max_conn = conn[v] as i32;
                        best_v = Some(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            let u = best_v.unwrap();
            visited[u] = true;
            order.push(u);
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if !visited[v] {
                    conn[v] += 1;
                }
            }
        }

        for i in 0..n {
            inv_order[order[i]] = i;
        }

        let mut ordered_adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
        for i in 0..n {
            let u = order[i];
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                ordered_adj[i].push(inv_order[v]);
            }
        }

        let mut assignment = vec![2; n];
        assignment[0] = 0;

        let mut d_a = vec![0; n];
        for &v_pos in &ordered_adj[0] {
            if v_pos > 0 {
                d_a[v_pos] += 1;
            }
        }

        Self {
            n,
            ordered_adj,
            order,
            assignment,
            d_a,
            d_b: vec![0; n],
            best_cut: initial_cut,
            best_partition: initial_partition,
            p_a: Vec::with_capacity(n),
            p_b: Vec::with_capacity(n),
        }
    }

    fn check_bound(&mut self, next_k: usize, cut_so_far: u32, size_a: usize, size_b: usize) -> bool {
        let a_rem = self.n / 2 - size_a;
        let b_rem = self.n / 2 - size_b;

        let mut simple_sum = 0;
        for j in next_k..self.n {
            simple_sum += std::cmp::min(self.d_a[j], self.d_b[j]);
        }

        if cut_so_far + simple_sum >= self.best_cut {
            return false;
        }

        self.p_a.clear();
        self.p_b.clear();
        let mut base_sum = 0;

        for j in next_k..self.n {
            let da = self.d_a[j];
            let db = self.d_b[j];
            if da >= db {
                base_sum += db;
                self.p_a.push(da - db);
            } else {
                base_sum += da;
                self.p_b.push(db - da);
            }
        }

        if self.p_a.len() > a_rem {
            self.p_a.sort_unstable();
            let needed = self.p_a.len() - a_rem;
            for i in 0..needed {
                base_sum += self.p_a[i];
            }
        } else if self.p_b.len() > b_rem {
            self.p_b.sort_unstable();
            let needed = self.p_b.len() - b_rem;
            for i in 0..needed {
                base_sum += self.p_b[i];
            }
        }

        cut_so_far + base_sum < self.best_cut
    }

    fn dfs(&mut self, k: usize, cut_so_far: u32, size_a: usize, size_b: usize) {
        if k == self.n {
            if cut_so_far < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = cut_so_far;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if self.assignment[i] == 0 {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        let a_rem = self.n / 2 - size_a;
        let b_rem = self.n / 2 - size_b;

        if a_rem == 0 {
            let mut final_cut = cut_so_far;
            for j in k..self.n {
                final_cut += self.d_a[j];
            }
            if final_cut < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = final_cut;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if i < k && self.assignment[i] == 0 {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        if b_rem == 0 {
            let mut final_cut = cut_so_far;
            for j in k..self.n {
                final_cut += self.d_b[j];
            }
            if final_cut < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = final_cut;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if (i < k && self.assignment[i] == 0) || i >= k {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        let prefer_a = self.d_a[k] >= self.d_b[k];

        if prefer_a {
            if size_a < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_b[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 0;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if size_b < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_a[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 1;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            if size_b < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_a[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 1;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if size_a < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_b[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 0;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            let mut max_cum_gain = 0;
            let mut best_k = 0;
            for (i, &(_, _, gain)) in swaps.iter().enumerate() {
                cum_gain += gain;
                if cum_gain > max_cum_gain {
                    max_cum_gain = cum_gain;
                    best_k = i + 1;
                }
            }

            if max_cum_gain > 0 {
                for i in 0..best_k {
                    let (a, b, _) = swaps[i];
                    in_a.swap(a, b);
                }
                improved = true;
            }
        }

        let mut cut = 0;
        for i in 0..n {
            if in_a[i] {
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if !in_a[neighbor] {
                        cut += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if cut < best_cut {
            best_cut = cut;
            best_partition = (0..n).filter(|&i| in_a[i]).collect();
        }
    }

    (best_cut, best_partition)
}

struct Solver {
    n: usize,
    ordered_adj: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    order: Vec<usize>,
    assignment: Vec<u8>,
    d_a: Vec<u32>,
    d_b: Vec<u32>,
    best_cut: u32,
    best_partition: Vec<usize>,
    p_a: Vec<u32>,
    p_b: Vec<u32>,
}

impl Solver {
    fn new(n: usize, adj: Vec<Vec<usize>>, initial_cut: u32, initial_partition: Vec<usize>) -> Self {
        let mut order = Vec::with_capacity(n);
        let mut inv_order = vec![0; n];
        let mut visited = vec![false; n];

        order.push(0);
        visited[0] = true;
        let mut conn = vec![0; n];
        for &v in &adj[0] {
            conn[v] += 1;
        }

        for _ in 1..n {
            let mut best_v = None;
            let mut max_conn = -1;
            for v in 0..n {
                if !visited[v] {
                    if conn[v] as i32 > max_conn {
                        max_conn = conn[v] as i32;
                        best_v = Some(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            let u = best_v.unwrap();
            visited[u] = true;
            order.push(u);
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if !visited[v] {
                    conn[v] += 1;
                }
            }
        }

        for i in 0..n {
            inv_order[order[i]] = i;
        }

        let mut ordered_adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
        for i in 0..n {
            let u = order[i];
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                ordered_adj[i].push(inv_order[v]);
            }
        }

        let mut assignment = vec![2; n];
        assignment[0] = 0;

        let mut d_a = vec![0; n];
        for &v_pos in &ordered_adj[0] {
            if v_pos > 0 {
                d_a[v_pos] += 1;
            }
        }

        Self {
            n,
            ordered_adj,
            order,
            assignment,
            d_a,
            d_b: vec![0; n],
            best_cut: initial_cut,
            best_partition: initial_partition,
            p_a: Vec::with_capacity(n),
            p_b: Vec::with_capacity(n),
        }
    }

    fn check_bound(&mut self, next_k: usize, cut_so_far: u32, size_a: usize, size_b: usize) -> bool {
        let a_rem = self.n / 2 - size_a;
        let b_rem = self.n / 2 - size_b;

        let mut simple_sum = 0;
        for j in next_k..self.n {
            simple_sum += std::cmp::min(self.d_a[j], self.d_b[j]);
        }

        if cut_so_far + simple_sum >= self.best_cut {
            return false;
        }

        self.p_a.clear();
        self.p_b.clear();
        let mut base_sum = 0;

        for j in next_k..self.n {
            let da = self.d_a[j];
            let db = self.d_b[j];
            if da >= db {
                base_sum += db;
                self.p_a.push(da - db);
            } else {
                base_sum += da;
                self.p_b.push(db - da);
            }
        }

        if self.p_a.len() > a_rem {
            self.p_a.sort_unstable();
            let needed = self.p_a.len() - a_rem;
            for i in 0..needed {
                base_sum += self.p_a[i];
            }
        } else if self.p_b.len() > b_rem {
            self.p_b.sort_unstable();
            let needed = self.p_b.len() - b_rem;
            for i in 0..needed {
                base_sum += self.p_b[i];
            }
        }

        cut_so_far + base_sum < self.best_cut
    }

    fn dfs(&mut self, k: usize, cut_so_far: u32, size_a: usize, size_b: usize) {
        if k == self.n {
            if cut_so_far < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = cut_so_far;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if self.assignment[i] == 0 {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        let a_rem = self.n / 2 - size_a;
        let b_rem = self.n / 2 - size_b;

        if a_rem == 0 {
            let mut final_cut = cut_so_far;
            for j in k..self.n {
                final_cut += self.d_a[j];
            }
            if final_cut < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = final_cut;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if i < k && self.assignment[i] == 0 {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        if b_rem == 0 {
            let mut final_cut = cut_so_far;
            for j in k..self.n {
                final_cut += self.d_b[j];
            }
            if final_cut < self.best_cut {
                self.best_cut = final_cut;
                self.best_partition.clear();
                for i in 0..self.n {
                    if (i < k && self.assignment[i] == 0) || i >= k {
                        self.best_partition.push(self.order[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        let prefer_a = self.d_a[k] >= self.d_b[k];

        if prefer_a {
            if size_a < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_b[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 0;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if size_b < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_a[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 1;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            if size_b < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_a[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 1;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a, size_b + 1);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_b[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if size_a < self.n / 2 {
                let new_cut = cut_so_far + self.d_b[k];
                if new_cut < self.best_cut {
                    self.assignment[k] = 0;
                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] += 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if self.check_bound(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b) {
                        self.dfs(k + 1, new_cut, size_a + 1, size_b);
                    }

                    for &v_pos in &self.ordered_adj[k] {
                        if v_pos > k {
                            self.d_a[v_pos] -= 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();

    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(Ok(l)) => l,
        _ => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<&str> = first_line.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    let n: usize = parts[0].parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = parts[1].parse().unwrap();

    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut matrix = vec![vec![false; n]; n];

    let mut edge_count = 0;
    while edge_count < m {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let pts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
            if pts.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            if pts.len() >= 2 {
                let u: usize = pts[0].parse().unwrap();
                let v: usize = pts[1].parse().unwrap();
                if u < n && v < n && u != v {
                    if !matrix[u][v] {
                        matrix[u][v] = true;
                        matrix[v][u] = true;
                        adj[u].push(v);
                        adj[v].push(u);
                    }
                }
            }
            edge_count += 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    if n == 0 {
        println!("0");
        println!();
        return;
    }

    if n % 2 != 0 {
        panic!("n must be even");
    }

    // Run Kernighan-Lin heuristic to get an initial upper bound
    let (kl_cut, kl_part) = run_kernighan_lin(n, &adj, &matrix, 42);

    // Run exact Branch & Bound solver to find and prove the optimal minimum cut bisection
    let mut solver = Solver::new(n, adj, kl_cut, kl_part);
    if solver.n > 1 {
        solver.dfs(1, 0, 1, 0);
    }

    println!("{}", solver.best_cut);
    let mut part_a = solver.best_partition.clone();
    part_a.sort_unstable();
    for (i, &v) in part_a.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            print!(" ");
        }
        print!("{}", v);
    }
    println!();
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

struct Lcg {
    state: u64,
}

impl Lcg {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self { state: if seed == 0 { 1 } else { seed } }
    }
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.state ^= self.state << 13;
        self.state ^= self.state >> 7;
        self.state ^= self.state << 17;
        self.state
    }
    fn next_range(&mut self, min: usize, max: usize) -> usize {
        let range = max - min;
        min + (self.next() as usize % range)
    }
    fn shuffle<T>(&mut self, slice: &mut [T]) {
        for i in (1..slice.len()).rev() {
            let j = self.next_range(0, i + 1);
            slice.swap(i, j);
        }
    }
}

fn run_kernighan_lin(n: usize, adj: &[Vec<usize>], matrix: &[Vec<bool>], seed: u64) -> (u32, Vec<usize>) {
    let mut rng = Lcg::new(seed);
    let mut best_cut = u32::MAX;
    let mut best_partition = Vec::new();

    // Run 30 random starts
    for _ in 0..30 {
        let mut vertices: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
        rng.shuffle(&mut vertices);
        let mut in_a = vec![false; n];
        for &v in &vertices[0..n/2] {
            in_a[v] = true;
        }

        let mut improved = true;
        while improved {
            improved = false;
            let mut d = vec![0i32; n];
            for i in 0..n {
                let mut ext = 0;
                let mut int = 0;
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if in_a[neighbor] == in_a[i] {
                        int += 1;
                    } else {
                        ext += 1;
                    }
                }
                d[i] = ext - int;
            }

            let mut locked = vec![false; n];
            let mut swaps = Vec::new();
            let mut temp_in_a = in_a.clone();
            let mut temp_d = d.clone();

            for _ in 0..(n / 2) {
                let mut max_gain = i32::MIN;
                let mut best_a = 0;
                let mut best_b = 0;
                let mut found = false;

                for a in 0..n {
                    if temp_in_a[a] && !locked[a] {
                        for b in 0..n {
                            if !temp_in_a[b] && !locked[b] {
                                let w = if matrix[a][b] { 1 } else { 0 };
                                let gain = temp_d[a] + temp_d[b] - 2 * w;
                                if gain > max_gain {
                                    max_gain = gain;
                                    best_a = a;
                                    best_b = b;
                                    found = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if !found {
                    break;
                }

                locked[best_a] = true;
                locked[best_b] = true;
                temp_in_a[best_a] = false;
                temp_in_a[best_b] = true;
                swaps.push((best_a, best_b, max_gain));

                for i in 0..n {
                    if !locked[i] {
                        let w_a = if matrix[i][best_a] { 1 } else { 0 };
                        let w_b = if matrix[i][best_b] { 1 } else { 0 };
                        if temp_in_a[i] {
                            temp_d[i] += 2 * w_a - 2 * w_b;
                        } else {
                            temp_d[i] += 2 * w_b - 2 * w_a;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            let mut cum_gain = 0;
            let mut max_cum_gain = 0;
            let mut best_k = 0;
            for (i, &(_, _, gain)) in swaps.iter().enumerate() {
                cum_gain += gain;
                if cum_gain > max_cum_gain {
                    max_cum_gain = cum_gain;
                    best_k = i + 1;
                }
            }

            if max_cum_gain > 0 {
                for i in 0..best_k {
                    let (a, b, _) = swaps[i];
                    in_a.swap(a, b);
                }
                improved = true;
            }
        }

        let mut cut = 0;
        for i in 0..n {
            if in_a[i] {
                for &neighbor in &adj[i] {
                    if !in_a[neighbor] {
                        cut += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if cut < best_cut {
            best_cut = cut;
            best_partition = (0..n).filter(|&i| in_a[i]).collect();
        }
    }

    (best_cut, best_partition)
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();

    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(Ok(l)) => l,
        _ => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<&str> = first_line.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    let n: usize = parts[0].parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = parts[1].parse().unwrap();

    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut matrix = vec![vec![false; n]; n];

    let mut edge_count = 0;
    while edge_count < m {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let pts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
            if pts.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            if pts.len() >= 2 {
                let u: usize = pts[0].parse().unwrap();
                let v: usize = pts[1].parse().unwrap();
                if u < n && v < n && u != v {
                    if !matrix[u][v] {
                        matrix[u][v] = true;
                        matrix[v][u] = true;
                        adj[u].push(v);
                        adj[v].push(u);
                    }
                }
            }
            edge_count += 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    if n == 0 {
        println!("0");
        println!();
        return;
    }

    if n % 2 != 0 {
        panic!("n must be even");
    }

    // Run Kernighan-Lin heuristic to get an initial upper bound
    let (kl_cut, kl_part) = run_kernighan_lin(n, &adj, &matrix, 42);

    // Run exact Branch & Bound solver to find and prove the optimal minimum cut bisection
    let mut solver = Solver::new(n, adj, kl_cut, kl_part);
    if solver.n > 1 {
        solver.dfs(1, 0, 1, 0);
    }

    println!("{}", solver.best_cut);
    let mut part_a = solver.best_partition.clone();
    part_a.sort_unstable();
    for (i, &v) in part_a.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            print!(" ");
        }
        print!("{}", v);
    }
    println!();
}

View C++ Code (2358 chars)
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

/**
 * The problem is equivalent to the Maximum Weight Independent Set problem.
 * Given n variables and constraints (x_u + x_v <= 1), we can view this
 * as a graph where each constraint is an edge between u and v.
 * We want to select a subset of vertices such that no two are connected
 * by an edge, maximizing the sum of their weights.
 */

struct Solver {
    int n;
    std::vector<long long> weights;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> adj;
    
    long long max_weight = -1;
    std::vector<int> best_assignment;
    std::vector<int> current_assignment;

    Solver(int n, std::vector<long long> weights, int m) : n(n), weights(weights) {
        adj.resize(n);
        current_assignment.assign(n, 0);
        best_assignment.assign(n, 0);
    }

    void add_constraint(int u, int v) {
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
    }

    bool is_safe(int v) {
        for (int neighbor : adj[v]) {
            if (current_assignment[neighbor] == 1) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    void solve(int idx, long long current_weight) {
        if (idx == n) {
            if (current_weight > max_weight) {
                max_weight = current_weight;
                best_assignment = current_assignment;
            }
            return;
        }

        // Try excluding variable idx
        current_assignment[idx] = 0;
        solve(idx + 1, current_weight);

        // Try including variable idx if safe
        if (is_safe(idx)) {
            current_assignment[idx] = 1;
            solve(idx + 1, current_weight + weights[idx]);
            current_assignment[idx] = 0; // backtrack
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, m;
    if (!(std::cin >> n >> m)) return 0;

    std::vector<long long> c(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) std::cin >> c[i];

    Solver solver(n, c, m);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        std::cin >> u >> v;
        solver.add_constraint(u, v);
    }

    solver.solve(0, 0);

    std::cout << solver.max_weight << std::endl;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << solver.best_assignment[i] << (i == n - 1 ? "" : " ");
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

Test 42: Geometry Shaders (SPIR-V Assembly) Score: 8.00 / 15
Typical Prompt:
You are writing a SPIR-V assembly geometry shader. It will be assembled with
spirv-as (Vulkan 1.0) and rendered using a fixed vertex shader and fragment shader.

**Geometry shader requirements:**
- `OpCapability Geometry`
- `OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450`
- `OpEntryPoint Geometry %main "main"` listing ALL interface variables
- `OpExecutionMode %main ` (InputPoints/InputLines/Triangles/InputLinesAdjacency/InputTrianglesAdjacency)
- `OpExecutionMode %main ` (OutputPoints/OutputLineStrip/OutputTriangleStrip)
- `OpExecutionMode %main OutputVertices ` (max vertices emitted)
- `OpExecutionMode %main Invocations 1`

**Input from vertex shader (per-vertex arrays):**
The input gl_Position is in a gl_PerVertex block (must be decorated with Block + BuiltIn Position).
```
%gl_PerVertex_in = OpTypeStruct %v4float
OpDecorate %gl_PerVertex_in Block
OpMemberDecorate %gl_PerVertex_in 0 BuiltIn Position
; Array size depends on input primitive:
; InputPoints: 1, InputLines: 2, Triangles: 3
; InputLinesAdjacency: 4, InputTrianglesAdjacency: 6
%arr_pv_in = OpTypeArray %gl_PerVertex_in %uint_N
%ptr_in_arr_pv = OpTypePointer Input %arr_pv_in
%gl_in = OpVariable %ptr_in_arr_pv Input
; Access: OpAccessChain %ptr_in_v4 %gl_in %int_i %int_0 -> gl_in[i].gl_Position
```

User-defined inputs are also arrays of the same size:
```
layout(location = 0) in vec3 worldPos[]; ; positions in clip space
layout(location = 1) in vec3 normal[]; ; vertex normals
layout(location = 2) in vec3 color[]; ; per-vertex colors
```

**Output (per emitted vertex):**
The output gl_Position is in a gl_PerVertex block:
```
%gl_PerVertex_out = OpTypeStruct %v4float
OpDecorate %gl_PerVertex_out Block
OpMemberDecorate %gl_PerVertex_out 0 BuiltIn Position
%ptr_out_pv = OpTypePointer Output %gl_PerVertex_out
%gl_out = OpVariable %ptr_out_pv Output
; Store: OpAccessChain %ptr_out_v4 %gl_out %int_0 -> gl_out.gl_Position
```
```
layout(location = 0) out vec3 outColor; ; color for fragment shader
```

**Emit vertices with:** `OpEmitVertex` after storing gl_Position and outColor.
**End primitive with:** `OpEndPrimitive` after emitting a complete strip.

**Available UBO (set=0, binding=0) - accessible from geometry shader:**
Same layout as test 41 (model/view/proj matrices, lightPos, cameraPos, params).

**Write ONLY the complete SPIR-V assembly text for the geometry shader.**


**Input primitive:** InputPoints (1 vertex per invocation, array size 1)
**Geometry:** 25 colored points in a 5x5 grid spread across [-0.8, 0.8].

**Task:** Expand each point into a small colored quad (4 vertices as triangle strip).
1. Read gl_in[0].gl_Position (the point position).
2. Read color[0] (the point's color).
3. Define a half-size: h = 0.04.
4. Emit 4 vertices forming a quad centered on the point:
- (x-h, y-h), (x+h, y-h), (x-h, y+h), (x+h, y+h)
- All with z=0, w=1, and the same color.
5. Output as triangle strip, max 4 vertices.
 Prompt Changes:
Prompt parameters change between subpasses (increasing difficulty)

Each subpass specifies a different input primitive type and a transformation task. The rendered output is compared pixel-by-pixel against a reference image. Writing geometry shaders in raw SPIR-V assembly requires precise control of vertex emission and primitive topology.

%ptr_p0 = OpAccessChain %ptr_in_v4 %gl_in %int_0 %int_0
%P0 = OpLoad %v4float %ptr_p0
%ptr_p1 = OpAccessChain %ptr_in_v4 %gl_in %int_1 %int_0
%P1 = OpLoad %v4float %ptr_p1
%ptr_p2 = OpAccessChain %ptr_in_v4 %gl_in %int_2 %int_0
%P2 = OpLoad %v4float %ptr_p2
%ptr_p3 = OpAccessChain %ptr_in_v4 %gl_in %int_3 %int_0
%P3 = OpLoad %v4float %ptr_p3

; Compute Tangents
%T0_all = OpFSub %v4float %P2 %P0
%T0 = OpVectorTimesScalar %v4float %T0_all %float_0_5
%T1_all = OpFSub %v4float %P3 %P1
%T1 = OpVectorTimesScalar %v4float %T1_all %float_0_5

; Load colors
%ptr_c1 = OpAccessChain %ptr_in_v3 %color %int_1
%color1 = OpLoad %v3float %ptr_c1
%ptr_c2 = OpAccessChain %ptr_in_v3 %color %int_2
%color2 = OpLoad %v3float %ptr_c2

; Pre-compute differences for interpolation
%delta_pos = OpFSub %v4float %P2 %P1
%delta_tan = OpFSub %v4float %T1 %T0
%delta_color = OpFSub %v3float %color2 %color1

; Get pointer to gl_Position in output block once
%ptr_out_pos0 = OpAccessChain %ptr_out_v4 %gl_out %int_0

; --- Point 0: t = 0.0 ---
; Perp 0
%tan0_x = OpCompositeExtract %float %T0 0
%tan0_y = OpCompositeExtract %float %T0 1
%neg_tan0_y = OpFNegate %float %tan0_y
%perp0_dir = OpCompositeConstruct %v4float %neg_tan0_y %tan0_x %float_0 %float_0
%perp0_norm = OpExtInst %v4float %glsl Normalize %perp0_dir
%offset0 = OpVectorTimesScalar %v4float %perp0_norm %float_0_02

%pos0_plus = OpFAdd %v4float %P1 %offset0
%pos0_minus = OpFSub %v4float %P1 %offset0

; Emit Vertex 0
OpStore %ptr_out_pos0 %pos0_plus
OpStore %outColor %color1
OpEmitVertex

; Emit Vertex 1
OpStore %ptr_out_pos0 %pos0_minus
OpStore %outColor %color1
OpEmitVertex


; --- Point 1: t = 0.25 ---
%interp_pos1 = OpVectorTimesScalar %v4float %delta_pos %float_0_25
%pos1 = OpFAdd %v4float %P1 %interp_pos1

%tan1 = OpFAdd %v4float %T0 %interp_tan1

%color_out1 = OpFAdd %v3float %color1 %interp_color1

%offset1 = OpVectorTimesScalar %v4float %perp1_norm %float_0_02

%pos1_plus = OpFAdd %v4float %pos1 %offset1
%pos1_minus = OpFSub %v4float %pos1 %offset1

; Emit Vertex 2

OpStore %outColor %color_out1
OpEmitVertex

OpEmitVertex

    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;   // world-space position
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;   // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;   // texture coordinates in [0,1]
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;   // tangent vector
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;          // offset 0   (column-major)
    float4x4 view;           // offset 64
    float4x4 projection;     // offset 128
    float4 lightPos;         // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
    float4 cameraPos;        // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    float4 params;           // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    float3 V = normalize(cameraPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    float3 R = reflect(-L, N);

    float diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    float specular = pow(max(dot(R, V), 0.0), 32.0);

    float intensity = 0.2 + 0.5 * diffuse + 0.8 * specular;

    return float4(intensity, intensity, intensity, 1.0);
}

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;   // world-space position
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;   // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;   // texture coordinates in [0,1]
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;   // tangent vector
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;          // offset 0   (column-major)
    float4x4 view;           // offset 64
    float4x4 projection;     // offset 128
    float4 lightPos;         // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
    float4 cameraPos;        // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    float4 params;           // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    float3 V = normalize(cameraPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    float3 H = normalize(L + V);

    float diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    float specular = pow(max(dot(N, H), 0.0), 64.0);

    float intensity = 0.1 + 0.6 * diffuse + 0.8 * specular;

    return float4(intensity, intensity, intensity, 1.0);
}

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;   // world-space position
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;   // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;   // texture coordinates in [0,1]
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;   // tangent vector
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;          // offset 0   (column-major)
    float4x4 view;           // offset 64
    float4x4 projection;     // offset 128
    float4 lightPos;         // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
    float4 cameraPos;        // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    float4 params;           // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    float d = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);

    float band;
    if (d >= 0.75) {
        band = 1.0;
    } else if (d >= 0.5) {
        band = 0.7;
    } else if (d >= 0.25) {
        band = 0.4;
    } else {
        band = 0.2;
    }

    return float4(input.color * band, 1.0);
}

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;
    float4x4 view;
    float4x4 projection;
    float4 lightPos;
    float4 cameraPos;
    float4 params;
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0 {
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);

    float diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);

    float2 grid = floor(input.uv * 8.0);
    float parity = fmod(abs(grid.x + grid.y), 2.0);
    float baseColor = (parity < 0.5) ? 0.9 : 0.2;

    float factor = 0.5 + 0.5 * diffuse;

    float3 finalColor = baseColor * factor;
    return float4(finalColor, 1.0);
}

View HLSL (1900 chars)
struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;   // world-space position
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;   // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;   // texture coordinates in [0,1]
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;   // tangent vector
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;          // offset 0   (column-major)
    float4x4 view;           // offset 64
    float4x4 projection;     // offset 128
    float4 lightPos;         // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
    float4 cameraPos;        // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    float4 params;           // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    // Normalize the interpolated world-space normal
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);

    // Compute direction from the world position to the light position
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);

    // Lambertian diffuse factor
    float diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);

    // 6x6 UV polka-dot pattern
    float2 scaledUV = input.uv * 6.0;
    float2 cellUV = frac(scaledUV);
    float2 cellCenter = float2(0.5, 0.5);
    float d = distance(cellUV, cellCenter);

    // Check if within the circle of radius 0.3
    float isDot = (d <= 0.3) ? 1.0 : 0.0;

    // Dot color is yellow (1.0, 0.8, 0.0), background is dark blue (0.1, 0.1, 0.3)
    float3 dotColor = float3(1.0, 0.8, 0.0);
    float3 bgColor = float3(0.1, 0.1, 0.3);
    float3 baseColor = lerp(bgColor, dotColor, isDot);

    // Apply Lambertian shading with factor (0.3 + 0.7*diffuse)
    float3 finalColor = baseColor * (0.3 + 0.7 * diffuse);

    // Output alpha 1.0
    return float4(finalColor, 1.0);
}

    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;

}
